  if (state?.runMode === "infinite" && state.elapsed >= 1200) maxParticles = mobile ? 160 : 220;
  if (state.particles.length > maxParticles) {
    state.particles.splice(0, state.particles.length - maxParticles);
  }
}

function trimRuntimeObjects() {
  const mobile = isMobileLike();
  const maxProjectiles = mobile ? 160 : 230;
  const maxEnemyProjectiles = mobile ? 36 : 54;
  const maxMassProjectiles = mobile ? 28 : 42;
  const maxAreas = mobile ? 85 : 125;
  const maxFalls = mobile ? 42 : 64;
  const maxGems = mobile ? 360 : 520;
  if (state.projectiles.length > maxProjectiles) state.projectiles.splice(0, state.projectiles.length - maxProjectiles);
  if ((state.enemyProjectiles || []).length > maxEnemyProjectiles) state.enemyProjectiles.splice(0, state.enemyProjectiles.length - maxEnemyProjectiles);
  if ((state.massProjectiles || []).length > maxMassProjectiles) state.massProjectiles.splice(0, state.massProjectiles.length - maxMassProjectiles);
  if (state.areas.length > maxAreas) state.areas.splice(0, state.areas.length - maxAreas);
  if (state.falls.length > maxFalls) state.falls.splice(0, state.falls.length - maxFalls);
  if (state.gems.length > maxGems) compactOldGems(maxGems);
  trimMiniScienceOrbs();
}

function trimMiniScienceOrbs() {
  const maxMini = isMobileLike() ? 90 : 120;
  const minis = state.gems.filter(g => g.kind === "mini_xp");
  const overflow = minis.length - maxMini;
  if (overflow <= 0) return;
  let removed = 0;
  state.gems = state.gems.filter(g => {
    if (g.kind !== "mini_xp" || removed >= overflow) return true;
    removed += 1;
    return false;
  });
}

function compactOldGems(maxGems) {
  const overflow = state.gems.length - maxGems;
  if (overflow <= 0) return;
  const removed = state.gems.splice(0, overflow);
  let total = 0;
  let x = 0;
  let y = 0;
  for (const gem of removed) {
    if (gem.kind === "heal_pea") {
      state.gems.push(gem);
      continue;
    }
    total += gem.value || 0;
    x += gem.x * (gem.value || 1);
    y += gem.y * (gem.value || 1);
  }
  if (total > 0) {
    state.gems.unshift({
      x: x / total,
      y: y / total,
      value: total,
      radius: 10,
      kind: "large_xp",
      pull: false,
    });
  }
}

function triggerMidnightTransition() {
  state.mode = "midnight";
  state.midnightStarted = true;
  state.midnightTimer = 1.7;
  state.midnightText = "심야 방송이 시작되었다.";
  addScreenShake(0.45);
  state.spawnTimer = 0.25;
  playAudioCue("midnight");
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: W / 2, y: H / 2 - 40, text: state.midnightText, color: "#ff7777", life: 1.7, maxLife: 1.7, size: 24 });
}

function updateMidnightTransition(dt) {
  state.midnightTimer -= dt;
  addScreenShake(0.08);
  updateEffects(dt);
  syncHud();
  if (state.midnightTimer <= 0) {
    state.mode = "play";
    addScreenShake(0.24);
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: W / 2, y: 92, text: "심화 구간 진입", color: "#ff8d8d", life: 0.9, maxLife: 0.9, size: 18 });
  }
}

function updatePlayer(dt) {
  const p = state.player;
  const prevX = p.x;
  const prevY = p.y;
  let mx = 0;
  let my = 0;

  if (keys.has("KeyA") || keys.has("ArrowLeft")) mx -= 1;
  if (keys.has("KeyD") || keys.has("ArrowRight")) mx += 1;
  if (keys.has("KeyW") || keys.has("ArrowUp")) my -= 1;
  if (keys.has("KeyS") || keys.has("ArrowDown")) my += 1;
  mx += touchMove.x;
  my += touchMove.y;

  const len = Math.hypot(mx, my);
  if (len > 0) {
    mx /= len;
    my /= len;
    p.facingX = mx;
    p.facingY = my;
    if (Math.abs(mx) > 0.15) p.visualFacingX = mx < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    p.moveDirX = mx;
    p.moveDirY = my;
  }

  const speed = (p.baseSpeed + state.stats.speed) * GLOBAL_PLAYER_MOVE_MULTIPLIER * getPlayerSlowFactor();
  p.x = clamp(p.x + mx * speed * dt, 18, W - 18);
  p.y = clamp(p.y + my * speed * dt, 28, H - 18);
  state.run.distanceMoved = (state.run.distanceMoved || 0) + Math.hypot(p.x - prevX, p.y - prevY);
  p.velocityX = (p.x - prevX) / Math.max(dt, 0.001);
  p.velocityY = (p.y - prevY) / Math.max(dt, 0.001);
  p.moving = Math.hypot(p.velocityX, p.velocityY) > 18;
  p.stillTime = p.moving ? 0 : p.stillTime + dt;
  state.run.bestStationaryStreak = Math.max(state.run.bestStationaryStreak || 0, p.stillTime || 0);
  p.invuln = Math.max(0, p.invuln - dt);
}

function getPlayerSlowFactor() {
  let factor = 1;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.type === "sticky" && dist(state.player, e) < 82) factor *= 0.82;
  }
  return Math.max(0.62, factor);
}

function isLavoisierCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "lavoisier";
}

function isMendelCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "mendel";
}

function isWegenerCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "wegener";
}

function isPasteurCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "pasteur";
}

function isGalileoCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "galileo";
}

function getGalileoProjectileSpeedMultiplier() {
  return isGalileoCharacter() ? 1.24 : 1;
}

function isSchrodingerCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "schrodinger";
}

function isCurieCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "curie";
}

function isDoanStudentCharacter(id = state?.characterId) {
  return id === "default" || id === "college_doan";
}

function getEffectDuration(base) {
  return base * (isLavoisierCharacter() ? 1.3 : 1) * (1 + ((state?.avatarItemStats || {}).duration || 0));
}

function getStatusDuration(base) {
  return base * (1 + ((state?.avatarItemStats || {}).statusDuration || 0));
}

function applyLavoisierPassive(damage, direct = false) {
  return damage;
}

function updateOxygenTankHealing(dt) {
  if (state.stats.regen <= 0) return;
  const healPerSecond = [0, 0.3, 0.6, 1.0][Math.min(3, state.stats.regen)] || 0;
  if (healPerSecond <= 0) return;
  const heal = healPerSecond * dt * getHealingMultiplier();
  const before = state.player.hp;
  state.player.hp = Math.min(state.player.maxHp, state.player.hp + heal);
  recordPlayerHealing(state.player, before);
  state.regenTick += dt;
  if (state.player.hp > before && state.regenTick >= 0.7) {
    state.regenTick = 0;
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y - 28, text: `+${(healPerSecond * getHealingMultiplier()).toFixed(1)}`, color: "#6dff9f", life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55 });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "air", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, radius: 30, life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45 });
  }
}

function spawnEnemies(dt) {
  const cap = getEnemyCap();
  if (state.enemies.length >= cap) return;
  state.spawnTimer -= dt;
  const t = state.elapsed;
  const interval = getSpawnInterval(t);
  if (state.spawnTimer > 0) return;
  state.spawnTimer = interval;

  const count = Math.min(getSpawnCount(t), cap - state.enemies.length);
  let rangedSpawnedThisWave = 0;
  const rangedAllowed = areRangedStudentsEnabled();
  const activeRangedCount = rangedAllowed ? state.enemies.filter(e => e.type === "ranged_student").length : 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    let type = getSpawnType(t);
    if (type === "ranged_student") {
      if (rangedSpawnedThisWave >= 1 || activeRangedCount + rangedSpawnedThisWave >= 3) {
        type = getNonRangedSpawnType(t);
      } else {
        rangedSpawnedThisWave += 1;
      }
    }
    addEnemy(type);
  }
}

function areRangedStudentsEnabled() {
  return state.runMode === "ten_hard" || (state.runMode === "infinite" && state.elapsed >= 1200);
}

function getNonRangedSpawnType(t) {
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") return getTenHardNonRangedSpawnType(t);
  if (state.runMode === "infinite") return getInfiniteNonRangedSpawnType(t);
  return getSpawnType(t);
}

function getEnemyCap() {
  if (state.runMode === "five") return 230;
  if (state.runMode === "ten") return state.elapsed < 300 ? 230 : 210;
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") return state.elapsed < 300 ? 160 : 145;
  if (state.elapsed < 600) return 210;
  if (state.elapsed < 900) return 170;
  if (state.elapsed < 1200) return 150;
  return 130;
}

function getSpawnInterval(t) {
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") return getTenHardSpawnInterval(t);
  if (t < 300) return getBaseFiveMinuteSpawnInterval(t);
  if (state.runMode === "infinite") return getInfiniteSpawnInterval(t);
  return getTenMinuteLateSpawnInterval(t);
}

function getBaseFiveMinuteSpawnInterval(t) {
  if (t < 60) return 1.05;
  if (t < 150) return 0.72;
  if (t < 270) return 0.48;
  return 0.22;
}

function getTenMinuteLateSpawnInterval(t) {
  if (t < 390) return 0.4;
  if (t < 480) return 0.32;
  if (t < 540) return 0.27;
  return 0.22;
}

function getTenHardSpawnInterval(t) {
  if (t < 60) return 1.05;
  if (t < 150) return 0.78;
  if (t < 270) return 0.58;
  if (t < 390) return 0.48;
  if (t < 480) return 0.42;
  if (t < 540) return 0.36;
  return 0.32;
}

function getInfiniteSpawnInterval(t) {
  if (t < 600) return getTenMinuteLateSpawnInterval(t);
  return Math.max(0.26, 0.34 - (t - 600) / 10000);
}

function getSpawnCount(t) {
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") return getTenHardSpawnCount(t);
  if (t < 300) return getBaseFiveMinuteSpawnCount(t);
  if (state.runMode === "infinite") return getInfiniteSpawnCount(t);
  return getTenMinuteLateSpawnCount(t);
}

function getBaseFiveMinuteSpawnCount(t) {
  if (t < 60) return 2;
  if (t < 150) return 3;
  if (t < 270) return 4;
  return 6;
}

function getTenMinuteLateSpawnCount(t) {
  if (t < 390) return 5;
  if (t < 480) return 6;
  if (t < 540) return 7;
  return 9;
}

function getTenHardSpawnCount(t) {
  if (t < 60) return 1;
  if (t < 150) return 2;
  if (t < 270) return 3;
  if (t < 390) return 3;
  if (t < 480) return 4;
  if (t < 540) return 4;
  return 5;
}

function getInfiniteSpawnCount(t) {
  if (t < 600) return getTenMinuteLateSpawnCount(t);
  if (t < 900) return 5;
  if (t < 1200) return 6;
  return 6;
}

function getSpawnType(t) {
  const roll = Math.random();
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") return getTenHardSpawnType(t, roll);
  if (t < 300) return getBaseFiveMinuteSpawnType(t, roll);
  if (state.runMode === "infinite") return getInfiniteSpawnType(t, roll);
  return getTenMinuteLateSpawnType(t, roll);
}

function getBaseFiveMinuteSpawnType(t, roll = Math.random()) {
  return t >= 150 && roll > 0.72 ? "mass" : t >= 60 && roll > 0.48 ? "echo" : "shadow";
}

function getTenMinuteLateSpawnType(t, roll = Math.random()) {
  if (t < 120) return "shadow";
  if (t < 240) return roll > 0.48 ? "echo" : "shadow";
  if (t < 300) return roll > 0.65 ? "mass" : roll > 0.34 ? "echo" : "shadow";
  if (t < 390) return roll > 0.56 ? "graffiti" : roll > 0.24 ? "red_student" : "shadow";
  if (t < 480) return roll > 0.68 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.38 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.17 ? "red_student" : "graffiti";
  if (t < 540) return roll > 0.78 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.56 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.34 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.16 ? "sticky" : "red_student";
  return roll > 0.82 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.66 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.48 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.28 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.12 ? "graffiti" : "red_student";
}

function getTenHardSpawnType(t, roll = Math.random()) {
  if (t < 60) return roll > 0.72 ? "echo" : "shadow";
  if (t < 150) return roll > 0.66 ? "red_student" : roll > 0.52 ? "mass" : roll > 0.22 ? "echo" : "shadow";
  if (t < 240) return roll > 0.88 ? "ranged_student" : roll > 0.62 ? "red_student" : roll > 0.34 ? "mass" : "echo";
  if (t < 300) return roll > 0.88 ? "ranged_student" : roll > 0.72 ? "graffiti" : roll > 0.44 ? "red_student" : roll > 0.18 ? "mass" : "echo";
  if (t < 390) return roll > 0.86 ? "ranged_student" : roll > 0.72 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.48 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.22 ? "graffiti" : "red_student";
  if (t < 480) return roll > 0.86 ? "ranged_student" : roll > 0.72 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.5 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.24 ? "sticky" : "smiling";
  if (t < 540) return roll > 0.84 ? "ranged_student" : roll > 0.68 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.42 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.18 ? "sticky" : "smiling";
  return roll > 0.84 ? "ranged_student" : roll > 0.68 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.42 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.18 ? "sticky" : "smiling";
}

function getTenHardNonRangedSpawnType(t, roll = Math.random()) {
  if (t < 60) return roll > 0.72 ? "echo" : "shadow";
  if (t < 150) return roll > 0.66 ? "red_student" : roll > 0.52 ? "mass" : roll > 0.22 ? "echo" : "shadow";
  if (t < 240) return roll > 0.72 ? "red_student" : roll > 0.38 ? "mass" : "echo";
  if (t < 300) return roll > 0.72 ? "graffiti" : roll > 0.42 ? "red_student" : roll > 0.18 ? "mass" : "echo";
  if (t < 390) return roll > 0.74 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.48 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.22 ? "graffiti" : "red_student";
  if (t < 480) return roll > 0.74 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.54 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.28 ? "sticky" : "smiling";
  if (t < 540) return roll > 0.7 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.44 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.2 ? "sticky" : "smiling";
  return roll > 0.68 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.42 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.18 ? "sticky" : "smiling";
}

function getInfiniteSpawnType(t, roll = Math.random()) {
  if (t < 600) return getTenMinuteLateSpawnType(t, roll);
  if (t >= 1200) return roll > 0.92 ? "ranged_student" : roll > 0.74 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.56 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.38 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.22 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.11 ? "graffiti" : "red_student";
  if (t >= 900) return roll > 0.8 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.62 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.45 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.3 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.15 ? "graffiti" : roll > 0.06 ? "red_student" : "mass";
  return roll > 0.88 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.72 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.55 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.38 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.2 ? "graffiti" : roll > 0.08 ? "red_student" : "mass";
}

function getInfiniteNonRangedSpawnType(t, roll = Math.random()) {
  if (t < 600) return getTenMinuteLateSpawnType(t, roll);
  if (t >= 1200) return roll > 0.74 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.56 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.38 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.22 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.11 ? "graffiti" : "red_student";
  if (t >= 900) return roll > 0.8 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.62 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.45 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.3 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.15 ? "graffiti" : roll > 0.06 ? "red_student" : "mass";
  return roll > 0.88 ? "black_teacher" : roll > 0.72 ? "reverse_student" : roll > 0.55 ? "smiling" : roll > 0.38 ? "sticky" : roll > 0.2 ? "graffiti" : roll > 0.08 ? "red_student" : "mass";
}

function addEnemy(type, options = {}) {
  const def = enemyDefs[type];
  const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
  let x = Math.random() * W;
  let y = Math.random() * H;
  if (options.x !== undefined) x = options.x;
  if (options.y !== undefined) y = options.y;
  if (edge === 0) y = -30;
  if (edge === 1) x = W + 30;
  if (edge === 2) y = H + 30;
  if (edge === 3) x = -30;
  if (options.x !== undefined) x = options.x;
  if (options.y !== undefined) y = options.y;
  const hpScale = options.hpScale ?? (def.boss || type === "small_shadow" ? 1 : getEnemyHpScale());
  const elite = Boolean(options.elite || shouldMakeEliteEnemy(type, def));
  const eliteHpScale = elite ? 1.8 : 1;
  const eliteDamageScale = elite ? 1.15 : 1;
  const speedScale = options.speedScale ?? getEnemyBaseSpeedScale(type, def);
  const damageScale = options.damageScale ?? 1;
  const radiusScale = options.radiusScale ?? 1;
  state.enemies.push({
    type,
    name: options.name || def.name,
    x,
    y,
    hp: def.hp * hpScale * eliteHpScale,
    maxHp: def.hp * hpScale * eliteHpScale,
    speed: def.speed * speedScale,
    radius: def.radius * radiusScale,
    damage: def.damage * eliteDamageScale * damageScale,
    xp: def.xp,
    color: options.color || def.color,
    knockResist: options.knockResist ?? def.knockResist ?? 1,
    boss: Boolean(def.boss),
    elite,
    midBoss: Boolean(def.midBoss),
    infiniteBoss: Boolean(def.infiniteBoss),
    limitBoss: Boolean(options.limitBoss),
    bossBehavior: options.bossBehavior || "",
    summonTimer: options.bossBehavior === "summon" || options.bossBehavior === "phase_summon" || type === "broadcast_boss" ? 4 : 0,
    phaseInterval: options.phaseInterval || 0,
    phaseDuration: options.phaseDuration || 0,
    phaseTimer: options.phaseInterval || 0,
    phaseAlphaTimer: 0,
    statusImmune: Boolean(options.statusImmune),
    splitLives: options.splitLives || 0,
    splitGroupId: options.splitGroupId || null,
    shieldSummonTimer: options.shieldSummonTimer || 0,
    teleportTimer: type === "reverse_student" ? rand(2.2, 4.2) : 0,
    shootTimer: type === "ranged_student" ? rand(1.4, state.runMode === "ten_hard" ? 2.9 : 4.2) : 0,
    chargeCooldown: type === "red_student" || options.bossBehavior === "charge" || options.bossBehavior === "long_charge" || options.bossBehavior === "limit" ? rand(0.6, 1.4) : 0,
    chargeTimer: 0,
    hitFlash: 0,
  });
}

function shouldMakeEliteEnemy(type, def) {
  if (def.boss || type === "small_shadow" || type === "ranged_student") return false;
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") {
    const chance = state.elapsed >= 540 ? 0.5 : state.elapsed >= 420 ? 0.42 : state.elapsed >= 300 ? 0.3 : state.elapsed >= 150 ? 0.18 : 0.08;
    return Math.random() < chance;
  }
  if (state.runMode === "ten" && state.elapsed >= 480) {
    return Math.random() < (state.elapsed >= 540 ? 0.18 : 0.1);
  }
  if (state.runMode === "infinite" && state.elapsed >= 600) {
    const chance = state.elapsed >= 1200 ? 0.32 : state.elapsed >= 900 ? 0.24 : 0.14;
    return Math.random() < chance;
  }
  return false;
}

function getEnemyBaseSpeedScale(type, def) {
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard" && !def.boss && !def.midBoss && !def.infiniteBoss && type !== "small_shadow") return 1.2;
  return 1;
}

function getEnemyHpScale() {
  if (state.runMode === "five") return 1 + state.elapsed / 430;
  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") {
    if (state.elapsed < 300) return (1.45 + state.elapsed / 360) * 1.2;
    return Math.min(5.9, 2.45 + (state.elapsed - 300) / 260) * 1.2;
  }
  if (state.elapsed < 300) return 1 + state.elapsed / 430;
  if (state.elapsed < 600) return 1.55 + (state.elapsed - 300) / 520;
  if (state.runMode === "infinite") return Math.min(5.8, 2.25 + (state.elapsed - 600) / 260);
  return Math.min(5.5, 2.1 + (state.elapsed - 600) / 360);
}

function updateEnemies(dt) {
  const p = state.player;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.magnifyTimer > 0) {
      e.magnifyTimer = Math.max(0, e.magnifyTimer - dt);
      if (e.magnifyTimer <= 0 && e.baseRadius) {
        e.radius = e.baseRadius;
        e.magnifyScale = 1;
        e.telescopeMagnified = false;
      }
    }
    if (e.telescopeSlowTimer > 0) {
      e.telescopeSlowTimer = Math.max(0, e.telescopeSlowTimer - dt);
      if (e.telescopeSlowTimer <= 0) e.telescopeSlowStacks = 0;
    }
    const aggro = getEnemyAggroTarget(e) || p;
    const dx = aggro.x - e.x;
    const dy = aggro.y - e.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    updateSpecialEnemy(e, dt, d);
    e.slowTimer = Math.max(0, (e.slowTimer || 0) - dt);
    e.fearTimer = Math.max(0, (e.fearTimer || 0) - dt);
    e.confusedTimer = Math.max(0, (e.confusedTimer || 0) - dt);
    e.stunTimer = Math.max(0, (e.stunTimer || 0) - dt);
    e.tectonicTimer = Math.max(0, (e.tectonicTimer || 0) - dt);
    if (e.tectonicTimer <= 0) e.tectonicStacks = 0;
    updateBurningEnemy(e, dt);
    if (e.stunTimer > 0) {
      e.hitFlash = Math.max(e.hitFlash, 0.03);
      constrainBossToArena(e);
      continue;
    }
    const speed = getEnemySpeed(e);
    const drift = getRadiationDrift(e, dt);
    let moveX = dx / d;
    let moveY = dy / d;
    let speedScale = 1;
    if (e.type === "ranged_student") {
      if (d < 150) {
        moveX = -dx / d;
        moveY = -dy / d;
        speedScale = 0.82;
      } else if (d < 240) {
        moveX = 0;
        moveY = 0;
        speedScale = 0;
      }
    }
    if (e.fearTimer > 0 && !e.boss) {
      const fx = e.x - p.x;
      const fy = e.y - p.y;
      const fd = Math.hypot(fx, fy) || 1;
      moveX = fx / fd;
      moveY = fy / fd;
    } else if (e.confusedTimer > 0 && !e.boss) {
      e.confusedAngle ||= Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      moveX = Math.cos(e.confusedAngle + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 8) * 0.8);
      moveY = Math.sin(e.confusedAngle + Math.cos(state.elapsed * 7) * 0.8);
      speedScale = 1;
    }
    e.x += (moveX * speed * speedScale + drift.x) * dt;
    e.y += (moveY * speed * speedScale + drift.y) * dt;
    constrainBossToArena(e);
    if (aggro !== p && aggro.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(e.x - aggro.x, e.y - aggro.y) <= e.radius + aggro.radius) {
      aggro.hp -= e.damage * dt;
      aggro.hitFlash = 0.12;
    }
    e.hitFlash = Math.max(0, e.hitFlash - dt);
    e.evolvedHitFlash = Math.max(0, (e.evolvedHitFlash || 0) - dt);
    e.suppressHitColorFlash = Math.max(0, (e.suppressHitColorFlash || 0) - dt);
  }
}

function constrainBossToArena(e) {
  if (!e?.boss) return;
  const marginX = Math.max(22, (e.radius || 20) + 8);
  const marginTop = Math.max(38, (e.radius || 20) + 8);
  const marginBottom = Math.max(24, (e.radius || 20) + 8);
  e.x = clamp(e.x, marginX, W - marginX);
  e.y = clamp(e.y, marginTop, H - marginBottom);
}

function getQuantumCatAggro(e) {
  if (!state.quantumCats.length) return null;
  let best = null;
  let bestD = Infinity;
  const hasQuantumCat = state.weapons.some(w => w.id === "quantum_cat");
  const aggroRadius = hasQuantumCat ? 130 : 108;
  for (const cat of state.quantumCats) {
    if (!cat.alive) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(cat.x - e.x, cat.y - e.y);
    if (d < bestD && d < aggroRadius) {
      best = cat;
      bestD = d;
    }
  }
  if (!best) return null;
  const chance = hasQuantumCat ? 0.58 : 0.42;
  return Math.random() < chance ? best : null;
}

function updateSpecialEnemy(e, dt, distanceToPlayer) {
  if (e.type === "ranged_student") {
    e.shootTimer = Math.max(0, (e.shootTimer || 0) - dt);
    if (distanceToPlayer < 340 && e.shootTimer <= 0 && e.stunTimer <= 0 && (e.phaseAlphaTimer || 0) <= 0) {
      fireEnemyProjectile(e);
      e.shootTimer = state.runMode === "ten_hard" ? rand(3.8, 5.1) : rand(4.8, 6.6);
    }
  }
  if (e.type === "red_student") {
    e.chargeCooldown -= dt;
    e.chargeTimer = Math.max(0, e.chargeTimer - dt);
    if (distanceToPlayer < 130 && e.chargeCooldown <= 0) {
      e.chargeTimer = 0.42;
      e.chargeCooldown = rand(2.0, 3.2);
      state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 18, text: "돌진", color: "#ff8b8b", life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35 });
    }
  }
  if (e.phaseInterval > 0) {
    e.phaseTimer = Math.max(0, (e.phaseTimer || 0) - dt);
    e.phaseAlphaTimer = Math.max(0, (e.phaseAlphaTimer || 0) - dt);
    if (e.phaseTimer <= 0) {
      e.phaseAlphaTimer = e.phaseDuration || 1;
      e.phaseTimer = e.phaseInterval + e.phaseAlphaTimer;
      state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 34, text: "위상 이탈", color: "#d6b8ff", life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55, size: 13 });
    }
  }
  if (e.bossBehavior === "charge" || e.bossBehavior === "long_charge" || e.bossBehavior === "limit") {
    e.chargeCooldown -= dt;
    e.chargeTimer = Math.max(0, e.chargeTimer - dt);
    const longCharge = e.bossBehavior === "long_charge" || e.bossBehavior === "limit";
    if (distanceToPlayer < (longCharge ? 330 : 190) && e.chargeCooldown <= 0) {
      e.chargeTimer = e.limitBoss ? 0.75 : longCharge ? 0.72 : 0.52;
      e.chargeCooldown = e.limitBoss ? rand(2.8, 3.8) : longCharge ? rand(3.2, 4.6) : rand(2.8, 4.2);
      state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 28, text: "돌진 예고", color: "#ff9a8a", life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, size: 13 });
      state.particles.push({ kind: "boss_pulse", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + (longCharge ? 38 : 24), life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });
    }
  }
  if (e.type === "reverse_student") {
    e.teleportTimer -= dt;
    if (e.teleportTimer <= 0 && distanceToPlayer > 70) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      e.x = clamp(state.player.x + Math.cos(angle) * rand(80, 135), 20, W - 20);
      e.y = clamp(state.player.y + Math.sin(angle) * rand(65, 115), 36, H - 20);
      e.teleportTimer = rand(3.5, 5.2);
      state.particles.push({ kind: "splash", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 20, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
    }
  }
  if (e.boss && (e.bossBehavior === "summon" || e.bossBehavior === "phase_summon" || e.type === "broadcast_boss")) {
    e.summonTimer -= dt;
    if (e.summonTimer <= 0) {
      e.summonTimer = e.hp < e.maxHp * 0.5 ? 3.4 : 5.2;
      const summonCount = e.bossBehavior === "summon" ? 2 : 3;
      for (let i = 0; i < summonCount; i += 1) {
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        addEnemy("shadow", { x: clamp(e.x + Math.cos(angle) * 42, 16, W - 16), y: clamp(e.y + Math.sin(angle) * 42, 28, H - 16) });
      }
      state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 34, text: "소환", color: "#ff9aac", life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55 });
    }
  }
  if (e.bossBehavior === "shield_summon") {
    e.shieldSummonTimer -= dt;
    if (e.shieldSummonTimer <= 0) {
      e.shieldSummonTimer = 3;
      summonBossShieldLine(e);
    }
  }
}

function fireEnemyProjectile(e) {
  const dx = state.player.x - e.x;
  const dy = state.player.y - e.y;
  const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
  const speed = state.runMode === "ten_hard" ? 128 : 118;
  state.enemyProjectiles ||= [];
  state.enemyProjectiles.push({
    kind: "ranged_student",
    x: e.x + (dx / d) * (e.radius + 8),
    y: e.y + (dy / d) * (e.radius + 8),
    vx: (dx / d) * speed,
    vy: (dy / d) * speed,
    radius: 6,
    damage: state.runMode === "ten_hard" ? 4.25 : 5,
    life: 4.2,
    color: "#ff4a4a",
    strokeColor: "#7a1515",
  });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 18, text: "투척", color: "#ff6b5f", life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32, size: 11 });
}

function getEnemyIncomingDamageMultiplier() {
  return state.runMode === "ten_hard" ? 0.85 : 1;
}

function updateEnemyProjectiles(dt) {
  const p = state.player;
  state.enemyProjectiles ||= [];
  for (const pr of state.enemyProjectiles) {
    pr.x += pr.vx * dt;
    pr.y += pr.vy * dt;
    pr.life -= dt;
    if (p.invuln <= 0 && Math.hypot(pr.x - p.x, pr.y - p.y) <= pr.radius + p.radius) {
      damagePlayerFromHazard(pr.x, pr.y, pr.radius + 1, pr.damage);
      pr.life = 0;
      state.particles.push({ kind: "splash", x: pr.x, y: pr.y, radius: 16, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
    }
  }
  state.enemyProjectiles = state.enemyProjectiles.filter(pr => pr.life > 0 && pr.x > -40 && pr.x < W + 40 && pr.y > -50 && pr.y < H + 50);
}

function summonBossShieldLine(e) {
  const dx = state.player.x - e.x;
  const dy = state.player.y - e.y;
  const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
  const ux = dx / d;
  const uy = dy / d;
  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i += 1) {
    addEnemy("black_teacher", {
      x: clamp(e.x + ux * (36 + i * 34), 24, W - 24),
      y: clamp(e.y + uy * (36 + i * 34), 32, H - 24),
      hpScale: 2.6,
      speedScale: 0.35,
      damageScale: 1.15,
      knockResist: 0.05,
      elite: true,
      color: "#3b3342",
    });
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 36, text: "방패 소환", color: "#ffd166", life: 0.6, maxLife: 0.6, size: 13 });
}

function getEnemySpeed(e) {
  let speed = e.speed;
  if (isEinsteinCharacter() && !e.boss && !e.midBoss && !e.limitBoss && state.player.moving) {
    speed *= 1 - getEinsteinRelativitySlow();
  }
  if (e.slowTimer > 0) speed *= 0.72;
  if ((e.radiationLevel || 0) === 1) speed *= 0.9;
  if ((e.radiationLevel || 0) === 2) speed *= 0.75;
  if ((e.radiationLevel || 0) >= 3) speed *= 0.55;
  if ((e.telescopeSlowTimer || 0) > 0) speed *= 1 - Math.min(3, e.telescopeSlowStacks || 0) * 0.06;
  if (e.type === "red_student" && e.chargeTimer > 0) speed *= 3.0;
  if (e.bossBehavior === "charge" && e.chargeTimer > 0) speed *= 2.8;
  if (e.bossBehavior === "long_charge" && e.chargeTimer > 0) speed *= 5.6;
  if (e.bossBehavior === "limit" && e.chargeTimer > 0) speed *= 3.2;
  if (e.type === "smiling") speed *= 1 + (1 - clamp(e.hp / e.maxHp, 0, 1)) * 1.2;
  if (e.boss && e.hp < e.maxHp * 0.5) speed *= 1.45;
  return speed * GLOBAL_ENEMY_MOVE_MULTIPLIER;
}

function isEinsteinCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "einstein";
}

function getEinsteinRelativitySlow() {
  if (!isEinsteinCharacter() || !state.player.moving) return 0;
  const current = Math.hypot(state.player.velocityX || 0, state.player.velocityY || 0);
  const base = Math.max(1, state.player.baseSpeed);
  const speedRatio = current / base;
  return Math.min(0.5, 0.15 + Math.max(0, speedRatio - 1) * 0.7);
}

function healActorWithText(actor, amount, options = {}) {
  if (!actor || amount <= 0 || actor.hp == null || actor.maxHp == null) return false;
  const before = actor.hp;
  actor.hp = Math.min(actor.maxHp, actor.hp + amount);
  if (actor.hp <= before) return false;
  recordPlayerHealing(actor, before);
  const chance = options.chance ?? 1;
  if (Math.random() < chance) {
    const textValue = amount >= 1 ? Math.round(amount) : amount.toFixed(1);
    state.particles.push({
      kind: "text",
      x: options.x ?? actor.x,
      y: options.y ?? actor.y - 24,
      text: `체력+${textValue}`,
      color: "#6dff9f",
      life: 0.48,
      maxLife: 0.48,
      size: options.size || 12,
    });
  }
  return true;
}

function recordPlayerHealing(actor, beforeHp) {
  if (actor !== state.player) return;
  const healed = Math.max(0, actor.hp - beforeHp);
  if (healed > 0) state.run.totalHealingReceived = (state.run.totalHealingReceived || 0) + healed;
}

function getRadiationDrift(e, dt) {
  const level = e.radiationLevel || 0;
  if (level <= 0) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
  e.radiationWobbleTimer = Math.max(0, (e.radiationWobbleTimer || 0) - dt);
  if (e.radiationWobbleTimer <= 0) {
    e.radiationWobbleTimer = level >= 3 ? rand(0.14, 0.32) : level === 2 ? rand(0.36, 0.7) : rand(0.8, 1.3);
    let angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    let power = level >= 3 ? rand(52, 82) : level === 2 ? rand(24, 52) : rand(10, 24);
    if (level >= 3) {
      const awayX = e.x - state.player.x;
      const awayY = e.y - state.player.y;
      const awayD = Math.hypot(awayX, awayY) || 1;
      const zigzag = (e.radiationZigzag = -(e.radiationZigzag || 1));
      const sidePower = rand(28, 54) * zigzag;
      e.radiationDriftX = (awayX / awayD) * power + (-awayY / awayD) * sidePower;
      e.radiationDriftY = (awayY / awayD) * power + (awayX / awayD) * sidePower;
    } else {
      e.radiationDriftX = Math.cos(angle) * power;
      e.radiationDriftY = Math.sin(angle) * power;
    }
    if (level === 1 && Math.random() < 0.45) {
      e.x += Math.cos(angle) * 5;
      e.y += Math.sin(angle) * 5;
      state.particles.push({ kind: "radiation_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 12, life: 0.16, maxLife: 0.16 });
    }
  }
  const scale = level >= 3 ? 0.9 : level === 2 ? 0.55 : 0.18;
  return { x: (e.radiationDriftX || 0) * scale, y: (e.radiationDriftY || 0) * scale };
}

function updateRadiationEffects(dt) {
  updateCurieRadiationPulse(dt);
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || !(e.radiationLevel > 0)) continue;
    e.radiationBurstTimer = Math.max(0, (e.radiationBurstTimer || 0) - dt);
    const radiationLevel = e.radiationLevel || 0;
    const burstInterval = radiationLevel >= 3 ? 2 : radiationLevel >= 2 ? 5 : 0;
    if (burstInterval > 0 && e.radiationBurstTimer <= 0) {
      e.radiationBurstTimer = burstInterval;
      const damage = Math.max(4, e.maxHp * 0.2);
      hitEnemy(e, damage, 0, rand(-1, 1), rand(-1, 1), "radiation_internal");
      e.hitFlash = Math.max(e.hitFlash || 0, 0.18);
      state.particles.push({ kind: "radiation_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + 22, life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28 });
      if (Math.random() < 0.35) state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 18, text: "붕괴", color: "#ff7777", life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, size: 12 });
    }
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function updateCurieRadiationPulse(dt) {
  if (!isCurieCharacter()) return;
  state.radiationPulseTimer = Math.max(0, (state.radiationPulseTimer ?? 8) - dt);
  if (state.radiationPulseTimer > 0) return;
  state.radiationPulseTimer = 8;
  triggerCurieRadiationPulse();
}

function triggerCurieRadiationPulse() {
  let affected = 0;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0) continue;
    if (e.boss) addRadiationExposure(e, 50, "curie_passive");
    else applyRadiationLevel(e, (e.radiationLevel || 0) + 1, "curie_passive");
    e.radiationDriftX = rand(-62, 62);
    e.radiationDriftY = rand(-62, 62);
    e.radiationWobbleTimer = 0.18;
    affected += 1;
  }
  if (affected > 0) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "radiation_pulse", x: W / 2, y: H / 2, radius: Math.max(W, H) * 0.72, life: 0.7, maxLife: 0.7 });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: W / 2, y: H * 0.24, text: "방사능 오염", color: "#ff7070", life: 0.8, maxLife: 0.8, size: 18 });
    addScreenShake(0.08);
  }
}

function addRadiationExposure(e, amount, source = "radioactive_material") {
  if (!e || e.hp <= 0) return;
  e.radiationExposure = Math.min(100, (e.radiationExposure || 0) + amount);
  e.radiationSource = source;
  while (e.radiationExposure >= 100 && (e.radiationLevel || 0) < 3) {
    e.radiationExposure -= 100;
    applyRadiationLevel(e, (e.radiationLevel || 0) + 1, source);
  }
}

function applyRadiationLevel(e, level, source = "xray") {
  if (!e || e.hp <= 0) return;
  if (e.statusImmune) return;
  const next = clamp(level, 0, 3);
  if (next <= (e.radiationLevel || 0)) return;
  e.radiationLevel = next;
  e.radiationSource = source;
  e.radiationExposure = 0;
  if (next >= 2) {
    const burstInterval = next >= 3 ? 2 : 5;
    e.radiationBurstTimer = Math.min(e.radiationBurstTimer || burstInterval, burstInterval);
  }
  e.hitFlash = Math.max(e.hitFlash || 0, 0.14);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "radiation_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + next * 8, life: 0.24, maxLife: 0.24 });
}

function updateBurningEnemy(e, dt) {
  if (!e.burnTime || e.burnTime <= 0) return;
  e.burnTime -= dt;
  if (e.burnTime <= 0) {
    e.wasBurning = false;
    return;
  }
  e.burnTick = (e.burnTick || 0) - dt;
  if (e.burnTick <= 0) {
    e.burnTick = 0.35;
    hitEnemy(e, e.burnDamage || 2, 0, e.x - state.player.x, e.y - state.player.y, e.burnSource || "burn");
    state.particles.push({ kind: "flame_splash", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 9, life: 0.15, maxLife: 0.15 });
  }
}

function applyBurn(e, damage, duration, source) {
  if (e.statusImmune) return;
  e.burnTime = Math.max(e.burnTime || 0, getStatusDuration(getEffectDuration(duration)));
  e.burnDamage = Math.max(e.burnDamage || 0, damage);
  e.burnSource = source;
  e.wasBurning = true;
}

function updateInfections(dt) {
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (!e.infectionTime || e.hp <= 0) continue;
    e.infectionTime = Math.max(0, e.infectionTime - dt);
    e.infectionTick = Math.max(0, (e.infectionTick || 0) - dt);
    e.infectionSpreadTick = Math.max(0, (e.infectionSpreadTick || 0) - dt);
    if (e.infectionTick <= 0) {
      e.infectionTick = 0.45;
      hitEnemy(e, (e.infectionDamage || 2) * (e.infectionStacks || 1), 0, e.x - state.player.x, e.y - state.player.y, e.infectionSource || "germ");
      if (Math.random() < 0.35) state.particles.push({ kind: "infection", x: e.x + rand(-6, 6), y: e.y + rand(-8, 6), radius: 7 + (e.infectionStacks || 1) * 2, life: 0.24, maxLife: 0.24 });
    }
    if (e.infectionSpreadTick <= 0 && e.infectionTime > 0) {
      e.infectionSpreadTick = 1.25;
      spreadInfection(e, e.infectionSource || "germ", 0.45);
    }
    if (e.infectionTime <= 0) {
      e.infectionStacks = 0;
      e.infectionPandemic = false;
    }
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function applyInfection(e, options) {
  if (!e || e.hp <= 0) return;
  if (e.statusImmune) return;
  const maxStacks = options.stacks || 1;
  e.infectionStacks = Math.min(maxStacks, Math.max(1, (e.infectionStacks || 0) + 1));
  e.infectionTime = Math.max(e.infectionTime || 0, getStatusDuration(getEffectDuration(options.duration)));
  e.infectionDamage = Math.max(e.infectionDamage || 0, options.tickDamage);
  e.infectionSpreadRadius = Math.max(e.infectionSpreadRadius || 0, options.spreadRadius);
  e.infectionSource = options.source;
  e.infectionPandemic = Boolean(options.pandemic || e.infectionPandemic);
  e.infectionTick = Math.min(e.infectionTick || 0.2, 0.2);
  e.infectionSpreadTick = Math.min(e.infectionSpreadTick || 0.75, 0.75);
  e.hitFlash = Math.max(e.hitFlash || 0, 0.08);
  e.suppressHitColorFlash = Math.max(e.suppressHitColorFlash || 0, 0.12);
}

function spreadInfection(origin, source = "germ", chance = 1) {
  const radius = origin.infectionSpreadRadius || (source === "pandemic" ? 108 : 72);
  let spread = 0;
  for (const other of state.enemies) {
    if (other === origin || other.hp <= 0 || Math.random() > chance) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(origin.x - other.x, origin.y - other.y) > radius + other.radius) continue;
    applyInfection(other, {
      duration: source === "pandemic" ? 4.4 : 3.2,
      tickDamage: (origin.infectionDamage || 2.6) * 0.78,
      spreadRadius: radius * 0.92,
      stacks: origin.infectionPandemic ? 3 : 1,
      source,
      pandemic: origin.infectionPandemic,
    });
    spread += 1;
  }
  if (spread > 0) state.particles.push({ kind: "infection_wave", x: origin.x, y: origin.y, radius, life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28 });
}

function updateWeapons(dt) {
  // Run each owned weapon when its cooldown is ready.
  for (const owned of state.weapons) {
    const def = getWeaponDef(owned.id);
    if (!def.attack) continue;
    owned.cooldown -= dt;
    const cd = getWeaponCooldown(def, owned.level);
    if (owned.cooldown <= 0) {
      if (def.id === "coding" || def.id === "program") {
        const started = def.attack(owned.level);
        owned.cooldown = started ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : 0.1;
        continue;
      }
      def.attack(owned.level);
      state.run.attackCasts = (state.run.attackCasts || 0) + 1;
      triggerSuperpositionAttack(def, owned.level);
      if (owned.freshEvolution && def.evolved) {
        owned.freshEvolution = false;
        state.particles.push({ kind: "evolution_flash", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, radius: 92, life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32 });
      }
      owned.cooldown = cd;
    }
  }
}

function getWeaponCooldown(def, level) {
  let scale = Math.max(0.35, state.stats.cooldown);
  if ((def.id === "ruler" || def.id === "chalk") && level >= 5) scale *= 0.78;
  if (def.id === "ammonia" && level >= 5) scale *= 0.62;
  if (def.id === "continental_shift" && level >= 4) scale *= 0.78;
  if (def.id === "wave" && level >= 5) scale *= 0.82;
  if (def.id === "xray" && level >= 5) scale *= 0.82;
  if (def.id === "bell_sound" && level >= 2) scale *= 0.82;
  if ((def.id === "element_analysis" || def.id === "chemical_decomposition") && getElementBonus("analysisCooldown") > 0) scale *= 1 - getElementBonus("analysisCooldown");
  if (def.id === "carbon_bond") {
    const carbonCooldownScale = [1, 0.83, 0.69, 0.56, 0.42][clamp(level, 1, 5) - 1] || 1;
    scale *= carbonCooldownScale;
  }
  if (def.id === "vaccine" && level >= 4) scale *= 0.66;
  else if (def.id === "vaccine" && level >= 2) scale *= 0.8;
  return def.baseCooldown * scale;
}

function getRulerDamage(level) {
  return [32, 38, 44, 50, 54][clamp(level, 1, 5) - 1] || 32;
}

function attackRuler(level) {
  // Narrow, strong straight slash.
  const p = state.player;
  const swings = level >= 4 ? 2 : 1;
  const length = level >= 3 ? 86 : 66;
  const width = 15;
  const damage = applyLavoisierPassive(getRulerDamage(level) * state.stats.damage, true);
  const baseDir = getAimDirection();

  for (let s = 0; s < swings; s += 1) {
    const dir = baseDir + (s === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI);
    const finalDamage = applyNewtonPassive(damage, dir, p.x, p.y);
    state.slashes.push({ kind: "line", x: p.x, y: p.y, dir, length, width, life: 0.13, maxLife: 0.13, color: "rgba(255, 219, 103, 0.78)" });
    hitLineEnemies(p.x, p.y, dir, length, width, finalDamage, 12, "ruler");
  }
}

function attackSteelRuler() {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const length = 136;
  const width = 18;
  const damage = applyLavoisierPassive(applyNewtonPassive(70 * state.stats.damage, dir, p.x, p.y), true);
  for (const slashDir of [dir, dir + Math.PI]) {
    state.slashes.push({ kind: "line", x: p.x, y: p.y, dir: slashDir, length, width, life: 0.16, maxLife: 0.16, color: "rgba(218, 235, 240, 0.88)" });
    hitLineEnemies(p.x, p.y, slashDir, length, width, damage, 16, "steel_ruler");
  }
}

function attackFossilHammer(level) {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const swings = level >= 5 ? 2 : 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < swings; i += 1) {
    const offsetDir = dir + (i === 0 ? 0 : 0.28);
    const centerX = p.x + Math.cos(offsetDir) * (level >= 4 ? 48 : 42);
    const centerY = p.y + Math.sin(offsetDir) * (level >= 4 ? 48 : 42);
    const radius = getFossilHammerRadius(level) * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
    const damageScale = i === 0 ? 1 : 0.7;
    fossilHammerImpact(centerX, centerY, radius, applyNewtonPassive((level >= 2 ? 58 : 44) * state.stats.damage * damageScale, dir, centerX, centerY), "fossil_hammer", level >= 4 ? 18 : 14, level >= 5 ? 2 : 1);
  }
}

function getFossilHammerRadius(level) {
  return [34, 44, 56, 68, 80][clamp(level, 1, 5) - 1] || 34;
}

function attackFossilRestoration() {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const centerX = p.x + Math.cos(dir) * 48;
  const centerY = p.y + Math.sin(dir) * 48;
  const radius = 80 * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  const damage = applyNewtonPassive(72 * state.stats.damage, dir, centerX, centerY);
  fossilHammerImpact(centerX, centerY, radius, damage, "fossil_restoration", 20, 2);
  state.areas.push({
    kind: "fossil_spike",
    x: centerX,
    y: centerY,
    radius: radius + 10,
    damage: damage * 0.65,
    knock: 8,
    tick: 0.14,
    life: 0.2,
    maxLife: 0.2,
    source: "fossil_restoration",
    hit: new Set(),
  });
}

function attackElementAnalysis(level) {
  startElementScans(level, false);
}

function attackChemicalDecomposition() {
  startElementScans(5, true);
}

const ADA_COMMANDS = [
  { id: "emergency_patch", name: "응급 패치", tier: "basic", category: "survival", seq: ["down", "up", "down"] },
  { id: "code_bullet", name: "코드 탄환", tier: "basic", category: "attack", seq: ["up", "right", "down"] },
  { id: "robot_summon", name: "로봇 소환", tier: "basic", category: "special", seq: ["left", "up", "right"] },
  { id: "phase_shift", name: "위상이탈", tier: "middle", category: "survival", seq: ["down", "left", "up", "right", "down"] },
  { id: "piercing_code", name: "관통 코드", tier: "middle", category: "attack", seq: ["up", "right", "down", "right", "up"] },
  { id: "pause_command", name: "정지 명령", tier: "middle", category: "special", seq: ["right", "up", "left", "down", "right"] },
  { id: "emergency_move", name: "긴급 이동", tier: "deep", category: "survival", seq: ["left", "down", "right", "up", "left", "down", "right"] },
  { id: "hacking", name: "해킹", tier: "deep", category: "special", seq: ["down", "up", "left", "right", "down", "up", "down"] },
  { id: "error_field", name: "오류 장판", tier: "deep", category: "attack", seq: ["right", "down", "left", "up", "right", "up", "down"] },
];
const ADA_PROGRAM_SEQS = {
  emergency_patch: ["down", "up", "down", "right"],
  code_bullet: ["up", "right", "down", "left"],
  robot_summon: ["left", "up", "right", "down"],
  phase_shift: ["down", "left", "up", "right"],
  piercing_code: ["up", "right", "down", "right"],
  pause_command: ["right", "up", "left", "down"],
  emergency_move: ["left", "down", "right", "up"],
  hacking: ["down", "up", "left", "right"],
  error_field: ["right", "down", "left", "up"],
};

function isAdaCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "ada_lovelace";
}

function ensureAdaState() {
  state.ada ||= {};
  const ada = state.ada;
  ada.robots ||= [];
  ada.errorFields ||= [];
  ada.comboEvents ||= [];
  ada.phaseTimer = Math.max(0, ada.phaseTimer || 0);
  ada.promptDelay = Math.max(0, ada.promptDelay || 0);
  ada.expireTimer = Math.max(0, ada.expireTimer || 0);
  ada.failTimer = Math.max(0, ada.failTimer || 0);
  ada.algorithmHintTimer = Math.max(0, ada.algorithmHintTimer || 0);
  ada.cleanCodingStreak = Math.max(0, ada.cleanCodingStreak || 0);
  return ada;
}

function attackCoding(level) {
  return beginAdaCodingPrompt(level, false);
}

function attackProgram() {
  return beginAdaCodingPrompt(5, true);
}

function beginAdaCodingPrompt(level, evolved = false) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  if (ada.codingPrompt) return false;
  if (ada.phaseTimer > 0 && !evolved) return false;
  const command = chooseAdaCodingCommand(level, evolved);
  ada.codingPrompt = { ...command, seq: evolved ? ADA_PROGRAM_SEQS[command.id] || command.seq.slice(0, 4) : command.seq, evolved };
  ada.codingWeaponId = evolved ? "program" : "coding";
  ada.promptDelay = evolved ? 0.1 : 2;
  ada.inputIndex = 0;
  ada.expireTimer = evolved ? 4.2 : Math.max(4.2, ada.codingPrompt.seq.length * 1.15);
  ada.lastDirection = null;
  ada.failTimer = 0;
  ada.promptHadMistake = false;
  return true;
}

function chooseAdaCodingCommand(level, evolved = false) {
  const tierWeights = evolved ? { basic: 1, middle: 2.2, deep: 3.2 } : getAdaTierWeights(level);
  const choices = ADA_COMMANDS.map(cmd => ({ ...cmd, weight: tierWeights[cmd.tier] || 1 }));
  applyAdaAlgorithmWeights(choices);
  const total = choices.reduce((sum, cmd) => sum + Math.max(0.05, cmd.weight), 0);
  let roll = Math.random() * total;
  for (const cmd of choices) {
    roll -= Math.max(0.05, cmd.weight);
    if (roll <= 0) return cmd;
  }
  return choices[0];
}

function getAdaTierWeights(level) {
  const rows = [
    { basic: 70, middle: 25, deep: 5 },
    { basic: 55, middle: 30, deep: 15 },
    { basic: 35, middle: 40, deep: 25 },
    { basic: 25, middle: 35, deep: 40 },
    { basic: 33, middle: 34, deep: 33 },
  ];
  return rows[clamp(level, 1, 5) - 1] || rows[0];
}

function applyAdaAlgorithmWeights(commands) {
  if (!isAdaCharacter()) return;
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  const hpRatio = state.player.hp / Math.max(1, state.player.maxHp);
  const near = state.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(e.x - state.player.x, e.y - state.player.y) < 120).length;
  const totalEnemies = state.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0).length;
  const bugged = state.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0 && e.debugBug).length;
  const bossOrElite = state.enemies.some(e => e.hp > 0 && (e.boss || e.elite));
  let hint = "알고리즘: 심화 코드 추천";
  for (const cmd of commands) {
    if (hpRatio <= 0.5 && cmd.category === "survival") cmd.weight *= hpRatio <= 0.25 ? 3.2 : 2.1;
    if (hpRatio <= 0.25 && cmd.id === "emergency_move") cmd.weight *= 2.2;
    if (near >= 5 && ["pause_command", "phase_shift"].includes(cmd.id)) cmd.weight *= 2.2;
    if (totalEnemies >= 24 && ["piercing_code", "error_field"].includes(cmd.id)) cmd.weight *= 2.1;
    if (bugged > 0 && ["robot_summon", "piercing_code", "error_field"].includes(cmd.id)) cmd.weight *= 1.8;
    if (bossOrElite && ["code_bullet", "piercing_code", "error_field"].includes(cmd.id)) cmd.weight *= 1.55;
    if (bossOrElite && cmd.id === "hacking") cmd.weight *= 0.25;
  }
  if (hpRatio <= 0.5) hint = "알고리즘: 생존 코드 추천";
  else if (near >= 5) hint = "알고리즘: 정지/회피 코드 추천";
  else if (bugged > 0) hint = "알고리즘: 버그 처리 코드 추천";
  else if (totalEnemies >= 24) hint = "알고리즘: 범위 코드 추천";
  ada.algorithmHint = hint;
  ada.algorithmHintTimer = 1.2;
}

function updateAdaSystems(dt) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  ada.phaseTimer = Math.max(0, ada.phaseTimer - dt);
  ada.failTimer = Math.max(0, ada.failTimer - dt);
  ada.algorithmHintTimer = Math.max(0, ada.algorithmHintTimer - dt);
  updateAdaComboEvents(dt);
  updateAdaCodingPrompt(dt);
  updateAdaRobots(dt);
  updateAdaErrorFields(dt);
  updateDebugBugTimers(dt);
}

function updateAdaCodingPrompt(dt) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  if (!ada.codingPrompt) return;
  ada.promptDelay = Math.max(0, ada.promptDelay - dt);
  if (ada.promptDelay > 0) return;
  ada.expireTimer -= dt;
  if (ada.expireTimer <= 0) finishAdaPromptPartial();
}

function handleAdaDirectionInput(dir) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  const prompt = ada.codingPrompt;
  if (!prompt) return;
  if (ada.promptDelay > 0 || state.mode !== "play") return;
  if (!dir || dir === ada.lastDirection) return;
  ada.lastDirection = dir;
  const expected = prompt.seq[ada.inputIndex];
  if (dir === expected) {
    ada.inputIndex += 1;
    ada.expireTimer = Math.max(1.5, ada.expireTimer);
    if (ada.inputIndex >= prompt.seq.length) {
      const completedPrompt = { ...prompt, hadMistake: ada.promptHadMistake };
      clearAdaPrompt();
      executeAdaCodingCommand(completedPrompt.id, 1);
      registerAdaCodingComboSuccess(completedPrompt);
    }
  } else {
    ada.promptHadMistake = true;
    resetAdaCodingCombo();
    if (prompt.evolved && ada.inputIndex >= 2) {
      finishAdaPromptPartial();
      return;
    }
    ada.failTimer = 0.32;
    ada.inputIndex = Math.max(0, ada.inputIndex - 1);
  }
}

function finishAdaPromptPartial() {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  const prompt = ada.codingPrompt;
  if (!prompt) return;
  if (!prompt.evolved) resetAdaCodingCombo();
  let shouldExecute = false;
  let powerScale = 1;
  if (prompt.evolved) {
    const chance = ada.inputIndex >= 4 ? 1 : ada.inputIndex === 3 ? 0.55 : ada.inputIndex === 2 ? 0.25 : 0;
    shouldExecute = chance > 0 && Math.random() < chance;
    powerScale = ada.inputIndex >= 4 ? 1 : ada.inputIndex === 3 ? 0.72 : 0.48;
  }
  clearAdaPrompt();
  if (shouldExecute) executeAdaCodingCommand(prompt.id, powerScale);
}

function resetAdaCodingCombo() {
  ensureAdaState().cleanCodingStreak = 0;
}

function registerAdaCodingComboSuccess(prompt) {
  if (!prompt || prompt.hadMistake) return;
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  ada.cleanCodingStreak = (ada.cleanCodingStreak || 0) + 1;
  if (ada.cleanCodingStreak < 3) return;
  ada.cleanCodingStreak = 0;
  const command = ADA_COMMANDS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ADA_COMMANDS.length)];
  ada.comboEvents.push({ type: "combo_text", timer: 0.68 });
  ada.comboEvents.push({ type: "combo_command", commandId: command.id, timer: 0.84 });
}

function updateAdaComboEvents(dt) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  if (!ada.comboEvents.length) return;
  for (const event of ada.comboEvents) event.timer -= dt;
  const ready = ada.comboEvents.filter(event => event.timer <= 0);
  ada.comboEvents = ada.comboEvents.filter(event => event.timer > 0);
  for (const event of ready) {
    if (state.mode !== "play") continue;
    if (event.type === "combo_text") showAdaComboText();
    else if (event.type === "combo_command") executeAdaCodingCommand(event.commandId, 1);
  }
}

function showAdaComboText() {
  state.particles.push({
    kind: "text",
    x: state.player.x,
    y: state.player.y - 66,
    text: "[콤보]",
    color: "#ffd84a",
    life: 0.82,
    maxLife: 0.82,
    size: 16,
  });
}

function clearAdaPrompt() {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  startAdaCodingCooldown();
  ada.codingPrompt = null;
  ada.inputIndex = 0;
  ada.promptDelay = 0;
  ada.expireTimer = 0;
  ada.lastDirection = null;
  ada.codingWeaponId = null;
}

function startAdaCodingCooldown() {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  const weaponId = ada.codingWeaponId || (ada.codingPrompt?.evolved ? "program" : "coding");
  const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === weaponId);
  const def = owned ? getWeaponDef(owned.id) : null;
  if (!owned || !def) return;
  owned.cooldown = def.id === "program" ? 1 : getWeaponCooldown(def, owned.level);
}

function getAdaCommandDisplayName(id) {
  return ADA_COMMANDS.find(cmd => cmd.id === id)?.name || "코드 실행";
}

function showAdaCommandFeedback(id, powerScale = 1) {
  const p = state.player;
  const suffix = powerScale < 1 ? " 약화" : "";
  state.particles.push({
    kind: "text",
    x: p.x,
    y: p.y - 48,
    text: `${getAdaCommandDisplayName(id)}${suffix}`,
    color: "#6dffd0",
    life: 0.78,
    maxLife: 0.78,
    size: 13,
  });
}

function executeAdaCodingCommand(id, powerScale = 1) {
  const p = state.player;
  const damageScale = state.stats.damage * powerScale;
  showAdaCommandFeedback(id, powerScale);
  if (id === "emergency_patch") {
    if (p.hp / p.maxHp >= 0.8) p.vaccineShield = Math.max(p.vaccineShield || 0, 8 * powerScale);
    else healActorWithText(p, 6 * powerScale * getHealingMultiplier(), { y: p.y - 28, size: 12 });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_code_cross", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius: 34, life: 0.42, maxLife: 0.42 });
  } else if (id === "code_bullet") {
    const count = getAdaProjectileCount(false);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const offset = (i - (count - 1) / 2) * 0.16;
      fireAdaCodeProjectile(50 * damageScale, offset, false);
    }
  } else if (id === "robot_summon") {
    summonAdaRobot(powerScale);
  } else if (id === "phase_shift") {
    ensureAdaState().phaseTimer = Math.max(ensureAdaState().phaseTimer, getEffectDuration(5 * powerScale));
  } else if (id === "piercing_code") {
    const count = getAdaProjectileCount(true);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const dir = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count;
      fireAdaCodeProjectile(40 * damageScale, 0, true, dir);
    }
  } else if (id === "pause_command") {
    applyAdaPauseCommand(powerScale);
  } else if (id === "emergency_move") {
    teleportAdaToSaferSpot(powerScale);
  } else if (id === "hacking") {
    hackAdaEnemy();
  } else if (id === "error_field") {
    createAdaErrorField(powerScale);
  }
  state.run.attackCasts = (state.run.attackCasts || 0) + 1;
}

function getAdaProjectileCount(piercing = false) {
  const base = piercing ? 10 : 3;
  return base + Math.max(0, Math.floor(state.stats.projectiles || 0));
}

function getAdaInterval(base, floor = 0.12) {
  return Math.max(floor, base * Math.max(0.35, state.stats.cooldown || 1));
}

function isAdaCodingDamageSource(source = "") {
  return ["ada_code_bullet", "ada_piercing_code", "ada_robot", "ada_error_field"].includes(source);
}

function getAdaDebugSynergyDamageMultiplier(enemy, source = "") {
  return enemy?.debugBug && isAdaCodingDamageSource(source) ? 1.5 : 1;
}

function reduceAdaCodingCooldown(amount = 0.5) {
  for (const id of ["coding", "program"]) {
    const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (owned && Number.isFinite(owned.cooldown)) owned.cooldown = Math.max(0, owned.cooldown - amount);
  }
}

function fireAdaCodeProjectile(damage, angleOffset = 0, piercing = false, fixedDir = null) {
  const target = findTarget();
  const dir = fixedDir ?? (target ? Math.atan2(target.y - state.player.y, target.x - state.player.x) + angleOffset : getAimDirection() + angleOffset);
  state.projectiles.push({
    kind: "ada_code",
    x: state.player.x,
    y: state.player.y,
    vx: Math.cos(dir) * 360 * getProjectileSpeedMultiplier(),
    vy: Math.sin(dir) * 360 * getProjectileSpeedMultiplier(),
    radius: piercing ? 6 : 7,
    damage,
    knock: piercing ? 3 : 4,
    life: 1.5,
    source: piercing ? "ada_piercing_code" : "ada_code_bullet",
    pierce: piercing ? 2 : Infinity,
    hit: new Set(),
  });
}

function summonAdaRobot(powerScale = 1) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  const maxRobots = state.weapons.some(w => w.id === "program") ? 5 : 3;
  if (ada.robots.length >= maxRobots) ada.robots.shift();
  ada.robots.push({ x: state.player.x + rand(-24, 24), y: state.player.y + rand(-24, 24), life: getEffectDuration(10) * getSummonDurationMultiplier(), attackTimer: 0, damage: 14 * powerScale, radius: 10 });
}

function updateAdaRobots(dt) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  for (const bot of ada.robots) {
    updateTelescopeAllyMagnify(bot, dt);
    bot.life -= dt;
    const target = findNearestBuggedEnemy(bot.x, bot.y) || findNearestEnemyFrom(bot.x, bot.y);
    if (target) {
      const dx = target.x - bot.x;
      const dy = target.y - bot.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      bot.x = clamp(bot.x + (dx / d) * 72 * getSummonSpeedMultiplier() * dt, 18, W - 18);
      bot.y = clamp(bot.y + (dy / d) * 72 * getSummonSpeedMultiplier() * dt, 28, H - 18);
      bot.attackTimer -= dt;
      if (bot.attackTimer <= 0 && d < 190) {
        bot.attackTimer = getAdaInterval(0.5, 0.18);
        const source = "ada_robot";
        hitEnemy(target, bot.damage * state.stats.damage * getSummonPowerMultiplier() * getAdaDebugSynergyDamageMultiplier(target, source), 2, dx, dy, source);
        state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_code_arc", x: bot.x, y: bot.y, x2: target.x, y2: target.y, life: 0.14, maxLife: 0.14 });
      }
    }
  }
  ada.robots = ada.robots.filter(bot => bot.life > 0);
}

function findNearestBuggedEnemy(x, y) {
  let best = null;
  let bestD = Infinity;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || !e.debugBug) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.y - y);
    if (d < bestD) { best = e; bestD = d; }
  }
  return best;
}

function applyAdaPauseCommand(powerScale = 1) {
  const radius = 240 * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(e.x - state.player.x, e.y - state.player.y) > radius + e.radius) continue;
    if (e.boss) {
      e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, getEffectDuration(3 * powerScale));
      e.slowFactor = Math.min(e.slowFactor || 1, 0.65);
    } else {
      e.stunTimer = Math.max(e.stunTimer || 0, getEffectDuration((e.elite ? 1.5 : 3) * powerScale));
    }
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_pause", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, radius, life: 0.36, maxLife: 0.36 });
}

function teleportAdaToSaferSpot(powerScale = 1) {
  const radius = 200 * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  let moved = 0;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0) continue;
    const dx = e.x - state.player.x;
    const dy = e.y - state.player.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (d > radius + e.radius) continue;
    const angle = d > 1 ? Math.atan2(dy, dx) : Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const cos = Math.cos(angle);
    const sin = Math.sin(angle);
    const marginX = e.radius + 14;
    const marginTop = e.radius + 34;
    const marginBottom = e.radius + 14;
    const candidates = [];
    if (Math.abs(cos) > 0.001) candidates.push(((cos > 0 ? W - marginX : marginX) - state.player.x) / cos);
    if (Math.abs(sin) > 0.001) candidates.push(((sin > 0 ? H - marginBottom : marginTop) - state.player.y) / sin);
    const distance = Math.max(220, Math.min(...candidates.filter(v => v > 0)));
    e.x = clamp(state.player.x + cos * distance, marginX, W - marginX);
    e.y = clamp(state.player.y + sin * distance, marginTop, H - marginBottom);
    constrainBossToArena(e);
    e.hitFlash = Math.max(e.hitFlash || 0, 0.08);
    moved += 1;
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_phase", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, radius, life: 0.36, maxLife: 0.36 });
  if (moved > 0) state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y - 42, text: `전송 ${moved}`, color: "#c9a4ff", life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55, size: 12 });
}

function hackAdaEnemy() {
  const candidates = state.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0 && !e.boss && !e.elite && !e.convertedToAlly);
  if (!candidates.length) return;
  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.hp - a.hp);
  const target = candidates[0];
  convertEnemyToAlly(target, {
    label: "해킹",
    color: "#6dffd0",
    hacked: true,
    maxHackedAllies: 5,
    replaceWeakest: true,
    replaceOldestWithScience: true,
    damageScale: 1 / 0.55,
    aggroRange: 150,
  });
}

function createAdaErrorField(powerScale = 1) {
  const center = findDenseEnemyPoint() || { x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y };
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  if (ada.errorFields.length >= 2) ada.errorFields.shift();
  const life = getEffectDuration(8);
  ada.errorFields.push({ x: center.x, y: center.y, radius: 200 * getAttackSizeMultiplier(), life, maxLife: life, tick: 0, pulse: 0, damage: 14 * state.stats.damage * powerScale });
}

function findDenseEnemyPoint() {
  let best = null;
  let bestCount = 0;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0) continue;
    const count = state.enemies.filter(o => o.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(o.x - e.x, o.y - e.y) < 120).length;
    if (count > bestCount) { best = e; bestCount = count; }
  }
  return best ? { x: best.x, y: best.y } : null;
}

function updateAdaErrorFields(dt) {
  const ada = ensureAdaState();
  for (const field of ada.errorFields) {
    field.life -= dt;
    field.tick -= dt;
    field.pulse -= dt;
    if (field.tick <= 0) {
      field.tick = getAdaInterval(0.5, 0.18);
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(e.x - field.x, e.y - field.y) > field.radius + e.radius) continue;
        const bonus = getAdaDebugSynergyDamageMultiplier(e, "ada_error_field");
        e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, 0.55);
        e.slowFactor = Math.min(e.slowFactor || 1, 0.65);
        hitEnemy(e, field.damage * bonus, 0, e.x - field.x, e.y - field.y, "ada_error_field");
      }
    }
    if (field.pulse <= 0) {
      field.pulse = getAdaInterval(1, 0.35);
      explodeEnergy(field.x + rand(-24, 24), field.y + rand(-24, 24), 26, 7 * state.stats.damage, "ada_error_field");
    }
    if (field.life <= 0 && !field.finished) {
      field.finished = true;
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(e.x - field.x, e.y - field.y) > field.radius + e.radius) continue;
        if (e.boss) {
          e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, 1);
          e.slowFactor = Math.min(e.slowFactor || 1, 0.5);
        } else {
          e.stunTimer = Math.max(e.stunTimer || 0, 1);
        }
      }
      state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_pause", x: field.x, y: field.y, radius: field.radius, life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32 });
    }
  }
  ada.errorFields = ada.errorFields.filter(field => field.life > -0.05);
}

function attackDebugging(level) {
  applyDebugBugToRandomEnemy(level, false);
}

function attackSystemPatch() {
  applyDebugBugToRandomEnemy(5, true);
}

function applyDebugBugToRandomEnemy(level, evolved = false) {
  const maxBugged = evolved ? 8 : Math.min(6, level + 1);
  let current = state.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0 && e.debugBug).length;
  if (current >= maxBugged) return;
  const visible = state.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0 && !e.debugBug && e.x > -20 && e.x < W + 20 && e.y > -20 && e.y < H + 20);
  const weighted = [];
  for (const e of visible) {
    const weight = e.boss ? 4 : e.elite ? 3 : 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < weight; i += 1) weighted.push(e);
  }
  const primary = weighted[Math.floor(Math.random() * weighted.length)];
  if (!primary) return;
  const applyCount = evolved ? 5 : level >= 5 ? 4 : level >= 4 ? 3 : level >= 2 ? 2 : 2;
  const clustered = visible
    .filter(e => e !== primary)
    .sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - primary.x, a.y - primary.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - primary.x, b.y - primary.y));
  const targets = [primary, ...clustered].filter((e, index) => index === 0 || Math.hypot(e.x - primary.x, e.y - primary.y) <= (evolved ? 190 : 150));
  let applied = 0;
  for (const target of targets) {
    if (current >= maxBugged) break;
    if (!target || target.debugBug || target.hp <= 0) continue;
    target.debugBug = { level, evolved, life: evolved ? 10 : 8, lastHitTime: -99 };
    current += 1;
    applied += 1;
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: target.x, y: target.y - 24, text: "BUG", color: "#6dffd0", life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55, size: 12 });
    if (current >= maxBugged || applied >= applyCount) break;
  }
}

function updateDebugBugTimers(dt) {
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (!e.debugBug) continue;
    e.debugBug.life -= dt;
    if (e.debugBug.life <= 0 || e.hp <= 0) e.debugBug = null;
  }
}

function maybeTriggerAdaDebugBug(e, info = {}) {
  if (!e?.debugBug || e.hp <= 0) return;
  const source = info.source || "";
  if (["debugging", "system_patch", "debug_transfer", "debug_shard", "ada_error_field_final"].includes(source)) return;
  const bug = e.debugBug;
  e.debugBug = null;
  if (!bug.evolved && bug.level >= 4 && !e.boss && !e.convertedToAlly && Math.random() < 0.1) {
    convertEnemyToAlly(e, { label: "해킹", color: "#6dffd0", aggroRange: 150, hacked: true, replaceOldestWithScience: true });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_debug_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + 30, life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35 });
    return;
  }
  const bossScale = e.boss ? 0.7 : 1;
  const base = bug.evolved ? 58 : bug.level >= 5 ? 42 : bug.level >= 4 ? 36 : bug.level >= 3 ? 30 : bug.level >= 2 ? 26 : 18;
  hitEnemy(e, base * state.stats.damage * bossScale, 0, 0, 0, bug.evolved ? "system_patch" : "debugging");
  triggerAdaDebugSplash(e, bug, base);
  if (bug.level >= 3 || bug.evolved) {
    if (e.boss) {
      e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, bug.evolved ? 1.8 : 1.4);
      e.slowFactor = Math.min(e.slowFactor || 1, bug.evolved ? 0.55 : 0.65);
    } else {
      e.stunTimer = Math.max(e.stunTimer || 0, bug.evolved ? (e.elite ? 0.45 : 0.75) : (e.elite ? 0.25 : 0.45));
      e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, bug.evolved ? 1.2 : 0.8);
      e.slowFactor = Math.min(e.slowFactor || 1, bug.evolved ? 0.55 : 0.7);
    }
  }
  if (bug.level >= 4 || bug.evolved) {
    const count = bug.evolved ? (info.isArea ? 3 : 2) : 1;
    const transferRatio = bug.evolved ? (info.isArea ? 0.45 : 0.4) : 0.35;
    const nearby = state.enemies.filter(o => o !== e && o.hp > 0).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - e.x, a.y - e.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - e.x, b.y - e.y)).slice(0, count);
    for (const other of nearby) hitEnemy(other, (info.damage || base) * transferRatio, 0, other.x - e.x, other.y - e.y, "debug_transfer");
  }
  if (bug.evolved && (state.elapsed - (bug.lastHitTime || -99)) < 1 && Math.random() < 0.35) {
    e.debugBug = { level: 5, evolved: true, life: 7, lastHitTime: state.elapsed };
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_debug_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + 24, life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35 });
  if (isAdaCodingDamageSource(source)) {
    reduceAdaCodingCooldown(0.5);
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 36, text: "코드 회수", color: "#6dffd0", life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, size: 10 });
  }
}

function triggerAdaDebugSplash(center, bug, baseDamage) {
  const radius = bug.evolved ? 82 : bug.level >= 5 ? 68 : bug.level >= 3 ? 56 : 44;
  const damage = baseDamage * state.stats.damage * (bug.evolved ? 0.58 : 0.45);
  let hits = 0;
  for (const other of state.enemies) {
    if (other === center || other.hp <= 0) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(other.x - center.x, other.y - center.y) > radius + other.radius) continue;
    hitEnemy(other, damage * (other.boss ? 0.55 : 1), 0, other.x - center.x, other.y - center.y, "debug_shard");
    hits += 1;
    if (hits >= (bug.evolved ? 8 : 5)) break;
  }
  if (hits > 0) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_debug_burst", x: center.x, y: center.y, radius, life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3 });
  }
}

function triggerAdaBugDeathExplosion(e) {
  const bug = e.debugBug;
  if (!bug || bug.deathExploded) return;
  bug.deathExploded = true;
  const radius = bug.evolved ? 110 : bug.level >= 5 ? 72 : 0;
  if (radius <= 0) return;
  explodeEnergy(e.x, e.y, radius, (bug.evolved ? 52 : 32) * state.stats.damage * (e.boss ? 0.7 : 1), bug.evolved ? "system_patch" : "debug_shard");
}

function startElementScans(level, evolved = false) {
  const elements = ensureElementState();
  const maxTargets = evolved ? 3 : level >= 5 ? 3 : level >= 4 ? 2 : 1;
  const scanTime = evolved ? 2.35 : level >= 3 ? 2.5 : 3;
  const damage = (evolved ? 64 : level >= 2 ? 52 : 38) * state.stats.damage * (1 + getElementBonus("elementDamage"));
  const candidates = state.enemies
    .filter(e => e.hp > 0 && !isElementScanPhasedEnemy(e) && !elements.scans.some(scan => scan.enemy === e))
    .sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - state.player.x, a.y - state.player.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - state.player.x, b.y - state.player.y))
    .slice(0, maxTargets);
  for (const enemy of candidates) {
    elements.scans.push({
      enemy,
      timer: scanTime,
      maxTimer: scanTime,
      damage,
      drops: evolved ? 2 : 1,
      source: evolved ? "chemical_decomposition" : "element_analysis",
    });
    enemy.elementScanProtected = true;
    enemy.elementScanSource = evolved ? "chemical_decomposition" : "element_analysis";
    if (!enemy.boss && !enemy.midBoss && !enemy.limitBoss && !enemy.statusImmune) {
      enemy.stunTimer = Math.max(enemy.stunTimer || 0, scanTime);
    } else if (!enemy.statusImmune) {
      enemy.stunTimer = Math.max(enemy.stunTimer || 0, 0.2);
    }
    state.particles.push({ kind: "element_scan", x: enemy.x, y: enemy.y, radius: enemy.radius + 18, life: scanTime, maxLife: scanTime });
  }
}

function isElementScanPhasedEnemy(enemy) {
  return Boolean(enemy?.elementScanProtected);
}

function holdElementScanDeathIfNeeded(enemy) {
  if (!enemy?.elementScanProtected || enemy.hp > 0) return false;
  enemy.elementScanPendingDeath = true;
  enemy.hp = 0.01;
  return true;
}

function updateElementSystem(dt) {
  const elements = ensureElementState();
  if (!elements.active) return;
  elements.flashTableTimer = Math.max(0, (elements.flashTableTimer || 0) - dt);
  updateElementScans(elements, dt);
  updateElementReactions(elements, dt);
  updateElementOrbitals(elements, dt);
}

function updateElementScans(elements, dt) {
  for (const scan of elements.scans) {
    const enemy = scan.enemy;
    if (!enemy || enemy.hp <= 0) {
      scan.done = true;
      continue;
    }
    scan.timer -= dt;
    state.particles.push({ kind: "element_scan", x: enemy.x, y: enemy.y, radius: enemy.radius + 14 + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 12) * 3, life: 0.08, maxLife: 0.08 });
    if (scan.timer <= 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < scan.drops; i += 1) gainElement(chooseElementNumber(enemy), scan.source, enemy);
      const pendingDeath = Boolean(enemy.elementScanPendingDeath);
      enemy.elementScanProtected = false;
      enemy.elementScanSource = null;
      enemy.elementScanPendingDeath = false;
      if (pendingDeath) {
        enemy.hp = 0;
        if (!enemy.killer && scan.source) enemy.killer = scan.source;
        triggerAdaBugDeathExplosion(enemy);
      } else {
        hitEnemy(enemy, scan.damage, 4, enemy.x - state.player.x, enemy.y - state.player.y, scan.source);
      }
      scan.done = true;
      sweepDeadEnemies();
    }
  }
  for (const scan of elements.scans) {
    if (scan.done && scan.enemy) {
      scan.enemy.elementScanProtected = false;
      scan.enemy.elementScanSource = null;
      scan.enemy.elementScanPendingDeath = false;
    }
  }
  elements.scans = elements.scans.filter(scan => !scan.done);
}

function trySpendElements(cost) {
  const elements = ensureElementState();
  for (const [symbol, amount] of Object.entries(cost)) {
    const n = getElementNumberBySymbol(symbol);
    if ((elements.inventory[n] || 0) < amount) return false;
  }
  for (const [symbol, amount] of Object.entries(cost)) {
    const n = getElementNumberBySymbol(symbol);
    elements.inventory[n] -= amount;
  }
  return true;
}

function getElementNumberBySymbol(symbol) {
  const found = ELEMENT_DEFS.find(element => element?.symbol === symbol);
  return found?.n || 1;
}

function canAffordElements(cost) {
  const elements = ensureElementState();
  for (const [symbol, amount] of Object.entries(cost)) {
    const n = getElementNumberBySymbol(symbol);
    if ((elements.inventory[n] || 0) < amount) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function getElementCostTotal(cost) {
  return Object.values(cost || {}).reduce((sum, amount) => sum + amount, 0);
}

function updateElementReactions(elements, dt) {
  elements.reactionCooldown = Math.max(0, (elements.reactionCooldown || 0) - dt);
  if (elements.reactionCooldown > 0) return;
  const reactions = [
    { id: "reaction_limestone", formula: "CaCO3", name: "석회", cost: { Ca: 1, C: 1, O: 3 }, power: 4, fn: triggerLimestoneReaction },
    { id: "reaction_flash", formula: "MgO", name: "섬광", cost: { Mg: 1, O: 1 }, power: 5, fn: triggerFlashReaction },
    { id: "reaction_glass", formula: "SiO2", name: "유리", cost: { Si: 1, O: 2 }, power: 8, fn: () => triggerCrystalTrapReaction("glass") },
    { id: "reaction_salt", formula: "NaCl", name: "소금", cost: { Na: 1, Cl: 1 }, power: 3, fn: () => triggerCrystalTrapReaction("salt") },
    { id: "reaction_carbon_dioxide", formula: "CO2", name: "이산화탄소", cost: { C: 1, O: 2 }, power: 4, fn: triggerCarbonDioxideReaction },
    { id: "reaction_water", formula: "H2O", name: "물", cost: { H: 2, O: 1 }, power: 6, fn: triggerWaterReaction },
    { id: "reaction_ammonia", formula: "NH3", name: "암모니아", cost: { N: 1, H: 3 }, power: 5, fn: triggerAmmoniaReaction },
    { id: "reaction_methane", formula: "CH4", name: "메탄", cost: { C: 1, H: 4 }, power: 10, fn: triggerMethaneReaction },
  ];
  const reaction = reactions
    .filter(candidate => canAffordElements(candidate.cost))
    .sort((a, b) => (getElementCostTotal(b.cost) - getElementCostTotal(a.cost)) || ((b.power || 0) - (a.power || 0)))[0];
  if (!reaction || !trySpendElements(reaction.cost)) return;
  reaction.fn();
  state.run.chemicalReactionsTriggered = (state.run.chemicalReactionsTriggered || 0) + 1;
  elements.reactionCooldown = 5.8 * (1 - getElementBonus("reactionCooldown"));
  showChemicalReactionFeedback(reaction);
}

function showChemicalReactionFeedback(reaction) {
  const p = state.player;
  state.particles.push({
    kind: "chemical_formula",
    x: p.x,
    y: p.y - 66,
    formula: reaction.formula,
    label: reaction.name,
    reactionId: reaction.id,
    color: getReactionFormulaColor(reaction.id),
    life: 1.0,
    maxLife: 1.0,
  });
}

function getReactionFormulaColor(id) {
  if (id === "reaction_water") return "#8fe7ff";
  if (id === "reaction_carbon_dioxide") return "#c9d8df";
  if (id === "reaction_salt") return "#fff1c2";
  if (id === "reaction_glass") return "#bdf7ff";
  if (id === "reaction_ammonia") return "#d8f79b";
  if (id === "reaction_methane") return "#ffbf6e";
  if (id === "reaction_limestone") return "#f0dfad";
  if (id === "reaction_flash") return "#ffffff";
  return "#8fe7ff";
}

function triggerWaterReaction() {
  const p = state.player;
  const damage = 24 * state.stats.damage * (1 + getElementBonus("reactionDamage"));
  explode(p.x, p.y, 136, damage, "reaction_water", 28);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "reaction_water_wave", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius: 136, life: 0.75, maxLife: 0.75 });
}

function triggerCarbonDioxideReaction() {
  const p = state.player;
  state.areas.push({ kind: "element_slow_zone", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius: 126, damage: 4.5 * state.stats.damage * (1 + getElementBonus("reactionDamage")), slow: 0.32, tick: 0, life: 4.2, maxLife: 4.2, source: "reaction_carbon_dioxide" });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "reaction_co2_cloud", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius: 126, life: 0.9, maxLife: 0.9 });
}

function triggerCrystalTrapReaction(type = "salt") {
  const p = state.player;
  const count = type === "glass" ? 15 : 10;
  const radius = type === "glass" ? 150 : 126;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const d = rand(28, radius);
    state.areas.push({ kind: "element_trap", trapType: type, x: p.x + Math.cos(a) * d, y: p.y + Math.sin(a) * d, radius: type === "glass" ? 13 : 11, damage: (type === "glass" ? 42 : 26) * state.stats.damage * (1 + getElementBonus("reactionDamage")), tick: 0, life: 5.5, maxLife: 5.5, source: type === "glass" ? "reaction_glass" : "reaction_salt", hit: new Set() });
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "reaction_crystal_burst", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius, trapType: type, life: 0.7, maxLife: 0.7 });
}

function getElementReactionDamageMultiplier() {
  return 1 + getElementBonus("reactionDamage");
}

function triggerAmmoniaReaction() {
  attackAmmonia(5, { source: "reaction_ammonia", damageScale: getElementReactionDamageMultiplier(), showReactionEffect: true });
}

function triggerMethaneReaction() {
  attackVolcano({ source: "reaction_methane", damageScale: getElementReactionDamageMultiplier(), showReactionEffect: true });
}

function triggerLimestoneReaction() {
  state.player.vaccineShield = Math.max(state.player.vaccineShield || 0, 34);
  state.player.vaccineShieldMax = Math.max(state.player.vaccineShieldMax || 0, 34);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y - 42, text: "석회 보호막", color: "#f0f0c2", life: 0.7, maxLife: 0.7, size: 12 });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "reaction_limestone_shield", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, radius: 54, life: 0.75, maxLife: 0.75 });
}

function triggerFlashReaction() {
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.statusImmune) continue;
    e.stunTimer = Math.max(e.stunTimer || 0, e.boss || e.midBoss || e.limitBoss ? 0.5 : 2);
  }
  addScreenShake(0.08);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "evolution_flash", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, radius: 140, life: 0.25, maxLife: 0.25 });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "reaction_flash_burst", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, radius: 160, life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35 });
}

function getElementPeriod(n) {
  if (n <= 2) return 1;
  if (n <= 10) return 2;
  if (n <= 18) return 3;
  return 4;
}

function getElementOrbitalRadius(n) {
  const period = getElementPeriod(n);
  return [0, 56, 86, 120, 160][period] || 56;
}

function triggerElementOversaturation(n) {
  const elements = ensureElementState();
  if ((elements.inventory[n] || 0) < 10) return;
  elements.inventory[n] -= 10;
  const element = ELEMENT_DEFS[n] || ELEMENT_DEFS[1];
  const duration = 5 + getElementBonus("orbitDuration");
  const count = 1 + Math.max(0, Math.floor(state.stats.projectiles || 0));
  const baseAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const period = getElementPeriod(n);
  const radius = getElementOrbitalRadius(n);
  const damage = 10 * state.stats.damage * (1 + (n - 1) * 0.06) * (1 + getElementBonus("elementDamage"));
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    elements.activeOrbitals.push({
      n,
      symbol: element.symbol,
      color: element.color,
      angle: baseAngle + (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count,
      radius,
      period,
      damage,
      tick: i * 0.04,
      life: duration,
      maxLife: duration,
    });
  }
  const maxOrbitals = 3 + Math.max(0, Math.floor(state.stats.projectiles || 0));
  while (elements.activeOrbitals.length > maxOrbitals) elements.activeOrbitals.shift();
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y - 50, text: `${element.symbol} 과포화`, color: element.color, life: 0.75, maxLife: 0.75, size: 12 });
}

function updateElementOrbitals(elements, dt) {
  for (const orbital of elements.activeOrbitals) {
    orbital.life -= dt;
    orbital.tick -= dt;
    orbital.angle += dt * 3.4;
    if (orbital.tick > 0) continue;
    orbital.tick = 0.18;
    const x = state.player.x + Math.cos(orbital.angle) * orbital.radius;
    const y = state.player.y + Math.sin(orbital.angle) * orbital.radius;
    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.y - y) > e.radius + 14) continue;
      hitEnemy(e, orbital.damage, 0, e.x - state.player.x, e.y - state.player.y, "element_oversaturation");
    }
  }
  elements.activeOrbitals = elements.activeOrbitals.filter(orbital => orbital.life > 0);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

}
