function fossilHammerImpact(x, y, radius, damage, source, knock, fossilPieces = 1) {
  state.particles.push({ kind: "fossil_impact", x, y, radius, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const d = Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.y - y);
    if (d > radius + e.radius) continue;
    const centerHit = d <= radius * 0.48 + e.radius;
    hitEnemy(e, damage * (centerHit ? 1.5 : 1), centerHit ? knock * 1.18 : knock, e.x - state.player.x, e.y - state.player.y, source);
  }
  tryExcavateFossilSite(x, y, radius + (source === "fossil_restoration" ? 18 : 0), source, fossilPieces);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function tryExcavateFossilSite(x, y, radius, source = "fossil_hammer", fossilPieces = 1) {
  const fossil = ensureFossilState();
  syncFossilPrimarySite(fossil);
  let site = null;
  let bestD = Infinity;
  for (const candidate of fossil.sites) {
    const d = Math.hypot(candidate.x - x, candidate.y - y);
    if (d <= radius + 18 && d < bestD) {
      site = candidate;
      bestD = d;
    }
  }
  if (!site?.active) return false;
  state.particles.push({ kind: "fossil_dig", x: site.x, y: site.y, radius: 34, life: 0.38, maxLife: 0.38 });
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "dust", x: site.x + rand(-12, 12), y: site.y + rand(-8, 10), vx: rand(-25, 25), vy: rand(-30, 8), life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });
  }
  if (source === "fossil_restoration") {
    explode(site.x, site.y, 54, 28 * state.stats.damage, "fossil_restoration", 8);
  }
  site.active = false;
  syncFossilPrimarySite(fossil);
  gainFossilPiece(source, fossilPieces);
  return true;
}

function attackBall(level) {
  // Bouncing projectile: rebounds off enemies and arena edges.
  const p = state.player;
  const count = (level >= 4 ? 2 : 1) + state.stats.projectiles;
  const speed = (level >= 5 ? 400 : level >= 2 ? 250 : 205) * getProjectileSpeedMultiplier();
  const damage = applyLavoisierPassive((level >= 2 ? 20 : 14) * state.stats.damage, true);
  const bounces = level >= 3 ? 7 : 4;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    state.projectiles.push({
      kind: "ball",
      x: p.x,
      y: p.y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      radius: 7,
      damage: applyNewtonPassive(damage, angle, p.x, p.y),
      life: getEffectDuration(7),
      bounces,
      hit: new Set(),
    });
  }
}

function attackChalk(level) {
  // Single-target chalk shot with a small splash.
  const p = state.player;
  const target = findTarget();
  if (!target) return;
  const count = 1 + state.stats.projectiles;
  const base = Math.atan2(target.y - p.y, target.x - p.x);
  const splash = level >= 3 ? 52 : 36;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const angle = base + (i - (count - 1) / 2) * 0.16;
    state.projectiles.push({
      kind: "chalk",
      x: p.x,
      y: p.y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * 320 * getProjectileSpeedMultiplier(),
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * 320 * getProjectileSpeedMultiplier(),
      radius: 5,
      damage: applyLavoisierPassive(applyNewtonPassive((level >= 2 ? 28 : 20) * state.stats.damage, angle, p.x, p.y), true),
      life: getEffectDuration(2.2),
      pierce: level >= 4 ? 1 : 0,
      splash,
      hit: new Set(),
    });
  }
}

function attackAmmonia(level, options = {}) {
  // Low damage aura around the player.
  const p = state.player;
  const source = options.source || "ammonia";
  const radius = (level >= 4 ? 86 : level >= 2 ? 68 : 50) * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  const damage = applyNewtonPassive((level >= 3 ? 9 : 6) * state.stats.damage * (options.damageScale || 1));

  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (dist(p, e) <= radius + e.radius) {
      hitEnemy(e, damage, 2, e.x - p.x, e.y - p.y, source);
    }
  }
  if (options.showReactionEffect) {
    const life = getEffectDuration(5);
    state.areas.push({
      kind: "element_aura",
      followPlayer: true,
      x: p.x,
      y: p.y,
      radius,
      damage,
      tick: 0,
      life,
      maxLife: life,
      source,
    });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "reaction_ammonia_cloud", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius, life: 0.8, maxLife: 0.8 });
  }
}

function attackChemWarfare() {
  const p = state.player;
  const radius = 88;
  const damage = applyNewtonPassive(8 * state.stats.damage);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "chem_warfare_aura", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius, life: getEffectDuration(0.34), maxLife: getEffectDuration(0.34) });

  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (dist(p, e) <= radius + e.radius) {
      e.x += ((e.x - p.x) / (dist(p, e) || 1)) * 1.4;
      e.y += ((e.y - p.y) / (dist(p, e) || 1)) * 1.4;
      e.slowTimer = 0.45;
      hitEnemy(e, damage, 1, e.x - p.x, e.y - p.y, "chem_warfare");
    }
  }
}

function getSpreadAngle(base, index, count, spread = 0.74) {
  if (count <= 1) return base + rand(-0.18, 0.18);
  return base + (index - (count - 1) / 2) * spread + rand(-0.1, 0.1);
}

function getDirectionalLanding(base, index, count, minDistance, maxDistance, yScale = 0.9) {
  const p = state.player;
  const angle = getSpreadAngle(base, index, count, count >= 4 ? 0.56 : 0.76);
  const distance = rand(minDistance, maxDistance);
  return {
    x: clamp(p.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, 28, W - 28),
    y: clamp(p.y + Math.sin(angle) * distance * yScale, 44, H - 28),
  };
}

function getSeparatedLanding(base, index, count, minDistance, maxDistance, yScale = 0.9) {
  if (count <= 1) return getDirectionalLanding(base, index, count, minDistance, maxDistance, yScale);
  const p = state.player;
  const distance = rand(minDistance, maxDistance);
  const patterns = count === 2
    ? [{ a: -1.05, d: 0.98 }, { a: 1.05, d: 0.98 }]
    : count === 3
      ? [{ a: 0, d: 1.08 }, { a: -1.28, d: 0.94 }, { a: 1.28, d: 0.94 }]
      : [
        { a: 0, d: 1.08 },
        { a: Math.PI, d: 0.7 },
        { a: -Math.PI / 2, d: 0.84 },
        { a: Math.PI / 2, d: 0.84 },
        { a: -0.86, d: 1.18 },
        { a: 0.86, d: 1.18 },
      ];
  const pattern = patterns[index % patterns.length];
  const extraRing = Math.floor(index / patterns.length);
  const angle = base + pattern.a + rand(-0.08, 0.08);
  const ring = distance * pattern.d + extraRing * 34;
  return {
    x: clamp(p.x + Math.cos(angle) * ring, 28, W - 28),
    y: clamp(p.y + Math.sin(angle) * ring * yScale, 44, H - 28),
  };
}

function attackFlask(level) {
  // Ground field throw: places a chemical area near enemies or along the aim direction.
  const p = state.player;
  const throws = (level >= 4 ? 2 : 1) + state.stats.projectiles;
  const target = Math.random() < 0.72 ? findTarget() : null;
  const base = target ? Math.atan2(target.y - p.y, target.x - p.x) : getAimDirection();
  for (let i = 0; i < throws; i += 1) {
    const singleAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const point = throws === 1 && target
      ? { x: clamp(target.x + Math.cos(singleAngle) * rand(20, 100), 24, W - 24), y: clamp(target.y + Math.sin(singleAngle) * rand(20, 90), 42, H - 24) }
      : getSeparatedLanding(base, i, throws, 92, 176, 0.82);
    const tx = point.x;
    const ty = point.y;
    state.areas.push({
      kind: "flask",
      x: tx,
      y: ty,
      radius: level >= 3 ? 46 : 36,
      damage: applyNewtonPassive((level >= 2 ? 9.5 : 7) * state.stats.damage, null, tx, ty),
      tick: 0,
      life: getEffectDuration(level >= 5 ? 3.4 : 2.5),
      maxLife: getEffectDuration(level >= 5 ? 3.4 : 2.5),
    });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "splash", x: tx, y: ty, radius: 22, life: 0.25, maxLife: 0.25 });
  }
}

function attackFlammableMaterial() {
  const p = state.player;
  const throws = 2 + state.stats.projectiles;
  const target = Math.random() < 0.82 ? findTarget() : null;
  const base = target ? Math.atan2(target.y - p.y, target.x - p.x) : getAimDirection();
  for (let i = 0; i < throws; i += 1) {
    const singleAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const point = throws === 1 && target
      ? { x: clamp(target.x + Math.cos(singleAngle) * rand(18, 104), 24, W - 24), y: clamp(target.y + Math.sin(singleAngle) * rand(18, 92), 42, H - 24) }
      : getDirectionalLanding(base, i, throws, 86, 168, 0.84);
    const tx = point.x;
    const ty = point.y;
    state.areas.push({
      kind: "flammable",
      x: tx,
      y: ty,
      radius: 56,
      damage: applyNewtonPassive(3.5 * state.stats.damage, null, tx, ty),
      explosionDamage: applyNewtonPassive(62 * state.stats.damage, null, tx, ty),
      tick: 0,
      life: 2.5,
      maxLife: 2.5,
    });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "flame_splash", x: tx, y: ty, radius: 24, life: 0.25, maxLife: 0.25 });
  }
}

function attackAlcoholLamp(level) {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const flames = level >= 4 ? 2 : 1;
  const length = level >= 3 ? 86 : 64;
  const width = level >= 3 ? 36 : 28;
  const damage = (level >= 5 ? 20 : level >= 4 ? 18 : level >= 2 ? 15 : 12) * state.stats.damage;
  const burnDuration = level >= 5 ? 3.2 : level >= 2 ? 2.5 : 1.7;
  for (let i = 0; i < flames; i += 1) {
    const flameDir = dir + (flames === 1 ? 0 : (i === 0 ? -0.18 : 0.18));
    createAlcoholFire(p.x, p.y, flameDir, length, width, damage, burnDuration, "alcohol_lamp");
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function attackCombustion() {
  const p = state.player;
  const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "combustion");
  const stats = getCombustionStats(owned?.synergyLevel || 1);
  createAlcoholFire(p.x, p.y, getAimDirection(), stats.fireLength, stats.fireWidth, stats.fireDamage, stats.burnDuration, "combustion");
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function getCombustionStats(flaskLevel = 1) {
  const level = clamp(Math.floor(flaskLevel || 1), 1, 5);
  return {
    level,
    fireLength: level >= 3 ? 118 : 104,
    fireWidth: level >= 4 ? 58 : level >= 2 ? 50 : 42,
    burnDuration: level >= 3 ? 4.0 : 3.2,
    fireDamage: (level >= 5 ? 28 : level >= 4 ? 25 : level >= 3 ? 22 : level >= 2 ? 20 : 18) * state.stats.damage,
    explosionRadius: level >= 5 ? 86 : level >= 3 ? 74 : level >= 2 ? 66 : 58,
    explosionDamage: (level >= 5 ? 74 : level >= 4 ? 64 : level >= 3 ? 54 : level >= 2 ? 46 : 38) * state.stats.damage,
    extraBurnDamage: level >= 3 ? 3.2 * state.stats.damage : 0,
    extraBurnDuration: level >= 3 ? 2.0 : 0,
    chainCount: level >= 5 ? 2 : level >= 4 ? 1 : 0,
    chainRadius: 30,
    chainDamageScale: 0.38,
  };
}

function createAlcoholFire(x, y, dir, length, width, damage, burnDuration, source) {
  state.slashes.push({ kind: "flame", x, y, dir, length, width, life: getEffectDuration(0.18), maxLife: getEffectDuration(0.18), color: source === "combustion" ? "rgba(255, 84, 32, 0.76)" : "rgba(255, 119, 48, 0.66)" });
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - x;
    const dy = e.y - y;
    const forward = dx * Math.cos(dir) + dy * Math.sin(dir);
    const side = Math.abs(dx * Math.sin(dir) - dy * Math.cos(dir));
    if (forward >= 0 && forward <= length + e.radius && side <= width + e.radius) {
      hitEnemy(e, damage, 2, Math.cos(dir), Math.sin(dir), source);
      applyBurn(e, source === "combustion" ? 4.2 * state.stats.damage : 3.0 * state.stats.damage, burnDuration, source);
    }
  }
}

function updateVaccineImmuneAura(dt) {
  const p = state.player;
  if (!p.vaccineImmune || (p.vaccineInvuln || 0) <= 0) return;
  p.vaccineAuraTick = Math.max(0, (p.vaccineAuraTick || 0) - dt);
  if (p.vaccineAuraTick > 0) return;
  p.vaccineAuraTick = 0.22;
  const radius = p.radius * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  const damage = 8 * state.stats.damage;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(e.x - p.x, e.y - p.y) > radius + e.radius) continue;
    hitEnemy(e, damage, 2, e.x - p.x, e.y - p.y, "immune");
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "infection_wave", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius: radius + 8, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function createTelescopeScope(x, y, dir, length, width, damage, pierce, source, delay, magnifyScale = 1.25, magnifyRadius = 54) {
  state.areas.push({
    kind: "telescope_scope",
    x,
    y,
    dir,
    length,
    width,
    damage,
    pierce,
    source,
    magnifyScale,
    magnifyRadius,
    delay,
    life: delay + 0.16,
    maxLife: delay + 0.16,
    tick: 0,
  });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "scope", x: x + Math.cos(dir) * Math.min(length, 300), y: y + Math.sin(dir) * Math.min(length, 300), radius: 24 + width, life: delay, maxLife: delay });
}

function applyTelescopeMagnify(enemy, scale, duration) {
  if (!enemy || enemy.hp <= 0) return;
  enemy.baseRadius ||= enemy.radius;
  enemy.telescopeSlowStacks = Math.min(3, (enemy.telescopeSlowStacks || 0) + 1);
  enemy.telescopeSlowTimer = Math.max(enemy.telescopeSlowTimer || 0, duration);
  enemy.magnifyTimer = Math.max(enemy.magnifyTimer || 0, duration);
  if (!enemy.telescopeMagnified) {
    enemy.telescopeMagnified = true;
    enemy.magnifyScale = Math.max(enemy.magnifyScale || 1, scale);
    enemy.radius = enemy.baseRadius * enemy.magnifyScale;
  }
  enemy.hitFlash = Math.max(enemy.hitFlash || 0, 0.12);
}

const TELESCOPE_ALLY_MAGNIFY_SCALE_CAP = 2;
const TELESCOPE_ALLY_MAGNIFY_DURATION = 6;

function applyTelescopeAllyMagnify(actor, scale, duration) {
  if (!actor || actor.hp != null && actor.hp <= 0) return;
  actor.baseRadius ||= actor.radius || 10;
  const finalScale = Math.min(TELESCOPE_ALLY_MAGNIFY_SCALE_CAP, Math.max(1, scale || 1));
  actor.magnifyTimer = Math.max(actor.magnifyTimer || 0, TELESCOPE_ALLY_MAGNIFY_DURATION);
  actor.telescopeMagnified = true;
  actor.magnifyScale = Math.min(TELESCOPE_ALLY_MAGNIFY_SCALE_CAP, Math.max(actor.magnifyScale || 1, finalScale));
  actor.radius = actor.baseRadius * actor.magnifyScale;
  actor.hitFlash = Math.max(actor.hitFlash || 0, 0.12);
}

function updateTelescopeAllyMagnify(actor, dt) {
  if (!actor || !(actor.magnifyTimer > 0)) return;
  actor.magnifyTimer = Math.max(0, actor.magnifyTimer - dt);
  if (actor.magnifyTimer <= 0 && actor.baseRadius) {
    actor.radius = actor.baseRadius;
    actor.magnifyScale = 1;
    actor.telescopeMagnified = false;
  }
}

function createFaultLine(x, y, dir, length, width, damage, knock, source, stun, delay) {
  state.areas.push({
    kind: "fault",
    x,
    y,
    dir,
    length,
    width,
    damage,
    knock,
    source,
    stun,
    delay,
    life: delay + 0.28,
    maxLife: delay + 0.28,
    tick: 0,
    triggered: false,
  });
}

function maybeCreateAftershock(area) {
  const baseChance = area.source === "earthquake" ? 0.34 : 0.22;
  if (Math.random() >= applyCombatChance(baseChance, 0.65)) return;
  const offset = rand(-0.34, 0.34);
  const side = rand(-18, 18);
  const px = -Math.sin(area.dir);
  const py = Math.cos(area.dir);
  createFaultLine(
    area.x + Math.cos(area.dir) * rand(22, 58) + px * side,
    area.y + Math.sin(area.dir) * rand(22, 58) + py * side,
    area.dir + offset,
    area.length * 0.72,
    area.width * 0.74,
    area.damage * 0.42,
    area.knock * 0.45,
    `${area.source}_aftershock`,
    area.stun * (area.source === "earthquake" ? 0.45 : 0.38),
    0.18
  );
  state.particles.push({ kind: "crack_burst", x: area.x, y: area.y, radius: area.width + 8, life: 0.2, maxLife: 0.2 });
}

function createContinentalShift(x, y, radius, damage, knock, source, burnDamage = 3.4 * state.stats.damage) {
  const volcanoLike = source === "volcano" || source === "reaction_methane";
  state.particles.push({ kind: volcanoLike ? "volcano" : "shockwave", x, y, radius, life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });
  addScreenShake(volcanoLike ? 0.22 : 0.12);
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.y - y) <= radius + e.radius) {
      hitEnemy(e, damage, knock, e.x - x, e.y - y, source);
      if (volcanoLike) {
        applyBurn(e, burnDamage, 2.2, source);
        e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, 0.42);
      }
    }
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function applyFaultCrowdShift(area) {
  const ux = Math.cos(area.dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(area.dir);
  const px = -uy;
  const py = ux;
  const strength = area.source === "earthquake" ? 13 : 8;
  const influenceWidth = area.width + (area.source === "earthquake" ? 72 : 48);
  const safeRadius = state.player.radius + 46;
  let moved = 0;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || e.statusImmune) continue;
    const dx = e.x - area.x;
    const dy = e.y - area.y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    if (forward < -24 || forward > area.length + 24) continue;
    const side = dx * px + dy * py;
    if (Math.abs(side) > influenceWidth + e.radius) continue;
    const resist = e.boss || e.midBoss || e.limitBoss ? 0.25 : (e.knockResist ?? 1);
    const pull = Math.min(Math.abs(side), strength * resist);
    const nextX = e.x - Math.sign(side || 1) * px * pull;
    const nextY = e.y - Math.sign(side || 1) * py * pull;
    if (Math.hypot(nextX - state.player.x, nextY - state.player.y) < safeRadius) continue;
    e.x = nextX;
    e.y = nextY;
    moved += 1;
  }
  if (moved > 0 && area.source === "earthquake") {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "pangaea", x: area.x + ux * area.length * 0.45, y: area.y + uy * area.length * 0.45, radius: influenceWidth, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
  }
}

function applyVolcanoLavaFlow(area) {
  const safeRadius = state.player.radius + 42;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || e.statusImmune) continue;
    const dx = area.x - e.x;
    const dy = area.y - e.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > area.radius * 1.55 + e.radius || d < area.radius * 0.45) continue;
    const resist = e.boss || e.midBoss || e.limitBoss ? 0.18 : (e.knockResist ?? 1);
    const pull = 5.5 * resist;
    const nextX = e.x + (dx / d) * pull;
    const nextY = e.y + (dy / d) * pull;
    if (Math.hypot(nextX - state.player.x, nextY - state.player.y) < safeRadius) continue;
    e.x = nextX;
    e.y = nextY;
  }
}

function createPlantPot(level, evolved) {
  const maxPlants = evolved ? 5 : level >= 4 ? 3 : 1;
  if (state.plants.length >= maxPlants) return;
  const p = state.player;
  const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = rand(90, 230);
  const x = clamp(p.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, 34, W - 34);
  const y = clamp(p.y + Math.sin(angle) * distance, 50, H - 34);
  const life = (evolved ? getEffectDuration(24) : getEffectDuration(13)) * getSummonDurationMultiplier();
  state.plants.push({
    x,
    y,
    level,
    evolved,
    radius: evolved ? 28 : 22,
    growing: false,
    grown: false,
    grow: 0,
    growTime: evolved ? 1.75 : level >= 3 ? 2 : 3,
    life,
    ttl: 13,
    fire: 0,
  });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "sprout", x, y, radius: 16, life: 0.42, maxLife: 0.42 });
}

function updatePlantTurrets(dt) {
  if (!state.plants.length) return;
  const p = state.player;
  for (const plant of state.plants) {
    updateTelescopeAllyMagnify(plant, dt);
    if (!plant.grown) {
      const inRange = Math.hypot(plant.x - p.x, plant.y - p.y) <= 64;
      if (!plant.growing && !inRange) plant.ttl -= dt;
      if (inRange) {
        plant.growing = true;
        plant.ttl = 999;
        plant.grow += dt * (1 + ((state.avatarItemStats || {}).installGrowthSpeed || 0)) * getSummonPowerMultiplier();
        if (plant.grow >= plant.growTime) {
          plant.grown = true;
          plant.fire = 0.05;
          state.particles.push({ kind: "sprout", x: plant.x, y: plant.y, radius: plant.evolved ? 30 : 22, life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55 });
        }
      } else if (plant.growing) {
        plant.grow = Math.max(0, plant.grow - dt * 0.85);
        if (plant.grow <= 0) {
          plant.growing = false;
          plant.ttl = Math.min(plant.ttl, 8);
        }
      }
      continue;
    }

    plant.life -= dt;
    plant.fire -= dt;
    if (plant.fire <= 0) {
      plant.fire = (plant.evolved ? 0.42 : 0.6) / getSummonPowerMultiplier();
      firePlantPea(plant);
    }
    if (plant.life <= 0 && !plant.withered) {
      plant.withered = true;
      if (plant.level >= 2) {
        state.gems.push({ kind: "heal_pea", x: plant.x, y: plant.y, value: 5, radius: 7, pull: false });
        state.particles.push({ kind: "sprout", x: plant.x, y: plant.y, radius: 18, life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35 });
      }
    }
  }
  state.plants = state.plants.filter(plant => plant.grown ? plant.life > 0 : plant.ttl > 0);
}

function updateQuantumCats(dt) {
  let owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "schrodinger_cat" || w.id === "quantum_cat");
  if (!owned && (state.avatarItemStats || {}).itemCatStart) {
    owned = { id: "schrodinger_cat", level: 1, itemGranted: true };
  }
  if (!owned) {
    state.quantumCats = [];
    return;
  }
  const evolved = owned.id === "quantum_cat";
  const level = owned.level;
  const swapInterval = evolved ? 2.15 : level >= 4 ? 2.75 : 3.45;
  const desiredCount = evolved ? 2 : 1;
  if (state.quantumCats.length !== desiredCount) {
    const p = state.player;
    state.quantumCats = [{ x: p.x - 42, y: p.y + 18, alive: true, swap: 0, contactTick: 0, biteTick: 0 }];
    if (evolved) state.quantumCats.push({ x: p.x + 42, y: p.y + 18, alive: false, swap: 0, contactTick: 0, biteTick: 0 });
  }
  const aura = evolved ? 96 : level >= 3 ? 78 : 60;
  if (evolved && state.quantumCats.length === 2) {
    const lead = state.quantumCats[0];
    lead.swap = (lead.swap || 0) + dt;
    if (lead.swap >= swapInterval) {
      lead.swap = 0;
      state.quantumCats[0].alive = !state.quantumCats[0].alive;
      state.quantumCats[1].alive = !state.quantumCats[0].alive;
      for (const cat of state.quantumCats) {
        state.particles.push({ kind: "quantum_echo", x: cat.x, y: cat.y, life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35 });
        explode(cat.x, cat.y, 58, 28 * state.stats.damage, "quantum_cat", 0);
        state.particles.push({ kind: "resonance_burst", x: cat.x, y: cat.y, radius: 62, life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3 });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const cat of state.quantumCats) {
    updateTelescopeAllyMagnify(cat, dt);
    cat.contactTick = Math.max(0, (cat.contactTick || 0) - dt);
    cat.biteTick = Math.max(0, (cat.biteTick || 0) - dt);
    if (!evolved) cat.swap += dt;
    if (!evolved && cat.swap >= swapInterval) {
      cat.swap = 0;
      cat.alive = !cat.alive;
      state.particles.push({ kind: "quantum_echo", x: cat.x, y: cat.y, life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35 });
    }

    if (cat.alive) {
      const target = findTargetFrom(cat.x, cat.y);
      if (!target) continue;
      const dx = target.x - cat.x;
      const dy = target.y - cat.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const speed = (evolved ? 210 : 168) * getCatSpeedMultiplier() * getSummonPowerMultiplier();
      cat.x = clamp(cat.x + (dx / d) * speed * dt, 18, W - 18);
      cat.y = clamp(cat.y + (dy / d) * speed * dt, 28, H - 18);
      if (d <= target.radius + 22 && cat.contactTick <= 0) {
        cat.contactTick = (evolved ? 0.38 : 0.42) / getSummonPowerMultiplier();
        const contactDamageByLevel = [0, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16];
        const damage = (evolved ? 20 : contactDamageByLevel[Math.min(5, level)] || 8) * state.stats.damage;
        hitEnemy(target, damage, 0, dx, dy, owned.id);
        target.slowTimer = Math.max(target.slowTimer || 0, 0.12);
        state.particles.push({ kind: "quantum_note", x: target.x, y: target.y, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
      if (d <= target.radius + 34 && cat.biteTick <= 0) {
        cat.biteTick = (evolved ? 1.15 : level >= 5 ? 1.6 : level >= 4 ? 1.75 : level >= 3 ? 1.9 : 2.05) / getSummonPowerMultiplier();
        const biteDamageByLevel = [0, 18, 23, 29, 35, 42];
        const damage = (evolved ? 58 : biteDamageByLevel[Math.min(5, level)] || 18) * state.stats.damage;
        hitEnemy(target, damage, 1, dx, dy, owned.id);
        target.slowTimer = Math.max(target.slowTimer || 0, 0.18);
        state.particles.push({ kind: "quantum_note", x: target.x, y: target.y, life: 0.24, maxLife: 0.24 });
        state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: target.x, y: target.y - target.radius - 12, text: "물기", color: evolved ? "#d8f3ff" : "#fff0a8", life: 0.36, maxLife: 0.36, size: 12 });
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
    } else {
      const radiationStage = evolved || level >= 5 ? 3 : 2;
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (Math.hypot(e.x - cat.x, e.y - cat.y) <= aura + e.radius) {
          applyRadiationLevel(e, radiationStage, evolved ? "quantum_cat" : "schrodinger_cat");
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function updatePavlovDogs(dt) {
  let owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "dog" || w.id === "pavlov_dog");
  if (!owned && (state.avatarItemStats || {}).itemDogStart) {
    owned = { id: "dog", level: 1, itemGranted: true };
  }
  if (!owned) {
    state.pavlovDogs = [];
    return;
  }
  const evolved = owned.id === "pavlov_dog";
  const level = owned.level || 1;
  state.pavlovDogRespawn = Math.max(0, (state.pavlovDogRespawn || 0) - dt);
  if (!state.pavlovDogs.length && state.pavlovDogRespawn <= 0) {
    state.pavlovDogs.push({
      x: state.player.x - 34,
      y: state.player.y + 26,
      hp: evolved ? 110 : 76,
      maxHp: evolved ? 110 : 76,
      radius: evolved ? 13 : 11,
      barkTimer: 0.55,
      markTimer: rand(4, 7),
      aggroRange: evolved ? 128 : 104,
      facingX: 1,
      facingY: 0,
    });
  }
  for (const dog of state.pavlovDogs) {
    if (dog.hp <= 0) continue;
    updateTelescopeAllyMagnify(dog, dt);
    const target = findNearestEnemyFrom(dog.x, dog.y);
    let goalX = state.player.x - 54;
    let goalY = state.player.y + 34;
    if (target && Math.hypot(target.x - dog.x, target.y - dog.y) < 260) {
      const awayX = dog.x - target.x;
      const awayY = dog.y - target.y;
      const awayD = Math.hypot(awayX, awayY) || 1;
      goalX = target.x + (awayX / awayD) * 58;
      goalY = target.y + (awayY / awayD) * 58;
    } else if (Math.hypot(dog.x - state.player.x, dog.y - state.player.y) < 48) {
      goalX = dog.x + rand(-90, 90);
      goalY = dog.y + rand(-70, 70);
    }
    const dx = goalX - dog.x;
    const dy = goalY - dog.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > 10) {
      const speed = (evolved ? 190 : 165) * getSummonMoveSpeedMultiplier();
      dog.x = clamp(dog.x + (dx / d) * speed * dt, 18, W - 18);
      dog.y = clamp(dog.y + (dy / d) * speed * dt, 28, H - 18);
      dog.facingX = dx / d;
      dog.facingY = dy / d;
    }
    collectScienceOrbsNearDog(dog, level, evolved);
    dog.barkTimer -= dt;
    if (dog.barkTimer <= 0) {
      dog.barkTimer = (evolved ? 2.0 : level >= 4 ? 2.15 : 2.5) / getSummonPowerMultiplier();
      triggerDogBark(dog, level, evolved);
    }
    dog.markTimer -= dt;
    if (dog.markTimer <= 0) {
      dog.markTimer = rand(8, 12);
      createMarkingZone(dog.x, dog.y, level, evolved);
    }
  }
  state.pavlovDogs = state.pavlovDogs.filter(dog => {
    if (dog.hp > 0) return true;
    state.pavlovDogRespawn = Math.max(state.pavlovDogRespawn || 0, 5);
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: dog.x, y: dog.y - 18, text: "재소환 대기", color: "#ffd36d", life: 0.6, maxLife: 0.6, size: 11 });
    return false;
  });
}

function collectScienceOrbsNearDog(dog, level = 1, evolved = false) {
  const radius = evolved ? 82 : level >= 3 ? 66 : 54;
  for (const gem of state.gems || []) {
    if (gem.dead || !["mini_xp", "xp", "large_xp"].includes(gem.kind)) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(gem.x - dog.x, gem.y - dog.y);
    if (d > radius + (gem.radius || 0)) continue;
    gainExp(gem.value || 0);
    gainSolarCharge(gem.value || 0, gem.kind === "mini_xp");
    gem.dead = true;
    if (Math.random() < 0.35) {
      state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: dog.x, y: dog.y - 18, text: "+과학력", color: "#80e9ff", life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32, size: 10 });
    }
  }
}

function triggerDogBark(dog, level, evolved) {
  const barkRadiusByLevel = [0, 72, 82, 92, 102, 112];
  const barkDamageByLevel = [0, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14];
  const radius = evolved ? 112 : barkRadiusByLevel[Math.min(5, level)] || 72;
  const damage = (evolved ? 16 : barkDamageByLevel[Math.min(5, level)] || 6) * state.stats.damage * getSummonPowerMultiplier();
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(e.x - dog.x, e.y - dog.y) > radius + e.radius) continue;
    hitEnemy(e, damage, 2, e.x - dog.x, e.y - dog.y, evolved ? "pavlov_dog" : "dog");
    if (!e.boss && !e.statusImmune) e.fearTimer = Math.max(e.fearTimer || 0, evolved ? 1.5 : 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < (evolved ? 2 : 0); i += 1) recordConditionReflexHit(e, evolved ? "pavlov_dog" : "dog", true);
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "dog_bark", x: dog.x, y: dog.y, radius, life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34, evolved });
}

function createMarkingZone(x, y, level, evolved) {
  state.areas.push({
    kind: "marking_zone",
    x,
    y,
    radius: evolved ? 82 : 56,
    damage: (evolved ? 6 : level >= 5 ? 4.5 : 3) * state.stats.damage,
    heal: evolved ? 4.5 : level >= 5 ? 3.2 : 2.2,
    conditionChanceBonus: evolved ? 0.01 : 0,
    tick: 0,
    life: evolved ? 6 : level >= 3 ? 5 : 4,
    maxLife: evolved ? 6 : level >= 3 ? 5 : 4,
  });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "dog_bark", x, y, radius: evolved ? 82 : 56, life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28, evolved: true, zone: true });
}

function updateAlliedEnemies(dt) {
  for (const ally of state.alliedEnemies || []) {
    if (ally.hp <= 0) continue;
    updateTelescopeAllyMagnify(ally, dt);
    ally.attackTimer = Math.max(0, (ally.attackTimer || 0) - dt);
    const target = findNearestEnemyFrom(ally.x, ally.y);
    if (!target) {
      const dx = state.player.x - ally.x;
      const dy = state.player.y - ally.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      if (d > 88) {
        ally.x += (dx / d) * ally.speed * 0.65 * getAlliedMoveSpeedMultiplier() * dt;
        ally.y += (dy / d) * ally.speed * 0.65 * getAlliedMoveSpeedMultiplier() * dt;
      }
      continue;
    }
    const dx = target.x - ally.x;
    const dy = target.y - ally.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > ally.radius + target.radius + 6) {
      ally.x += (dx / d) * ally.speed * getAlliedMoveSpeedMultiplier() * dt;
      ally.y += (dy / d) * ally.speed * getAlliedMoveSpeedMultiplier() * dt;
    } else if (ally.attackTimer <= 0) {
      ally.attackTimer = 0.75;
      hitEnemy(target, ally.damage * 0.55 * getSummonPowerMultiplier(), 3, dx, dy, "allied_enemy");
    }
  }
  state.alliedEnemies = (state.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally.hp > 0);
}

function findNearestEnemyFrom(x, y) {
  let best = null;
  let bestD = Infinity;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || e.convertedToAlly) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.y - y);
    if (d < bestD) {
      best = e;
      bestD = d;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

function getSummonMoveSpeedMultiplier() {
  const itemStats = state.avatarItemStats || {};
  return 1 + (itemStats.summonMoveSpeed || 0) + (itemStats.summonPower || 0);
}

function getAlliedMoveSpeedMultiplier() {
  return getSummonMoveSpeedMultiplier() * (1 + ((state.avatarItemStats || {}).alliedMoveSpeed || 0));
}

function firePlantPea(plant) {
  const target = findTargetFrom(plant.x, plant.y);
  if (!target) return;
  const base = Math.atan2(target.y - plant.y, target.x - plant.x);
  const doubleShot = plant.evolved || plant.level >= 5;
  const count = doubleShot ? 2 : 1;
  const giant = plant.evolved && Math.random() < 0.18;
  firePeaBurst(plant.x, plant.y - 10, base, count, {
    damage: (giant ? 36 : plant.evolved ? 24 : 17) * state.stats.damage,
    speed: plant.evolved ? 320 : 280,
    radius: giant ? 11 : plant.evolved ? 7 : 6,
    splitsLeft: giant ? 2 : 1,
    splitCount: plant.evolved ? 3 : 2,
    splitDamageScales: plant.evolved ? [0.66, 0.44] : [0.58, 0.34],
    source: plant.evolved ? "pure_cross" : "planting",
    spread: 0.2,
    life: getEffectDuration(2.0),
    pierce: plant.evolved ? 1 : 0,
    kind: giant ? "giant_pea" : "pea",
  });
}

function firePeaBurst(x, y, base, count, options) {
  const spread = count === 1 ? 0 : options.spread;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const angle = base + (i - (count - 1) / 2) * spread;
    state.projectiles.push({
      kind: options.kind || "pea",
      x: x + Math.cos(angle) * 10,
      y: y + Math.sin(angle) * 10,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * options.speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * options.speed,
      radius: options.radius,
      damage: applyNewtonPassive(options.damage, angle, x, y),
      life: options.life,
      pierce: options.pierce || 0,
      splitsLeft: options.splitsLeft,
      splitChance: options.splitChance ?? 1,
      splitChanceCap: options.splitChanceCap ?? 0.8,
      splitCount: options.splitCount,
      splitDamageScales: options.splitDamageScales || [0.6, 0.35],
      guaranteedSplits: options.guaranteedSplits || 0,
      maxTotalSplits: options.maxTotalSplits ?? 99,
      totalSplits: options.totalSplits || 0,
      knock: options.knock ?? 10,
      source: options.source,
      hit: new Set(),
    });
  }
}

function attackApple(level) {
  const count = (level >= 4 ? 2 : 1) + state.stats.projectiles;
  const target = findTarget();
  const baseDir = target ? Math.atan2(target.y - state.player.y, target.x - state.player.x) : getAimDirection();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const singleAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const point = count === 1 && target
      ? { x: clamp(target.x + Math.cos(singleAngle) * rand(0, 52), 28, W - 28), y: clamp(target.y + Math.sin(singleAngle) * rand(0, 44), 44, H - 28) }
      : getSeparatedLanding(baseDir, i, count, 92, 182, 0.82);
    const tx = point.x;
    const ty = point.y;
    state.falls.push({
      kind: "apple",
      x: tx,
      y: ty,
      height: 92,
      radius: level >= 3 ? 66 : 54,
      damage: applyNewtonPassive((level >= 2 ? 46 : 36) * state.stats.damage, null, tx, ty),
      knock: level >= 5 ? 16 : 4,
      life: getEffectDuration(0.72),
      maxLife: getEffectDuration(0.72),
      source: "apple",
    });
  }
}

function attackGravity() {
  const count = 2 + Math.min(1, state.stats.projectiles);
  const target = findTarget();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const point = getSafeGravityPoint(target, i, count);
    state.falls.push({
      kind: "gravity",
      x: point.x,
      y: point.y,
      height: 110,
      radius: 102,
      damage: applyNewtonPassive(56 * state.stats.damage, null, point.x, point.y),
      knock: 22,
      pull: true,
      life: getEffectDuration(0.86),
      maxLife: getEffectDuration(0.86),
      source: "gravity",
    });
  }
}

function getSafeGravityPoint(target, index = 0, count = 1) {
  const p = state.player;
  const base = target ? Math.atan2(target.y - p.y, target.x - p.x) : getAimDirection();
  if (count > 1) {
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 8; tries += 1) {
      const point = getDirectionalLanding(base, index, count, 124, 230, 0.86);
      if (Math.hypot(point.x - p.x, point.y - p.y) >= 120) return point;
    }
  }
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 8; tries += 1) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const baseX = target ? target.x : p.x;
    const baseY = target ? target.y : p.y;
    const x = clamp(baseX + Math.cos(angle) * rand(40, 130), 34, W - 34);
    const y = clamp(baseY + Math.sin(angle) * rand(36, 108), 50, H - 34);
    if (Math.hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y) >= 120) return { x, y };
  }
  const away = Math.atan2((target?.y ?? p.y + 1) - p.y, (target?.x ?? p.x + 1) - p.x);
  return {
    x: clamp(p.x + Math.cos(away) * 140, 34, W - 34),
    y: clamp(p.y + Math.sin(away) * 120, 50, H - 34),
  };
}

function attackLaser(level) {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const baseBeams = level >= 5 ? 3 : level >= 3 ? 2 : 1;
  const beamCount = baseBeams + state.stats.projectiles;
  const spread = beamCount === 1 ? 0 : 0.18;
  const beams = Array.from({ length: beamCount }, (_, i) => (i - (beamCount - 1) / 2) * spread);
  const length = Math.hypot(W, H);
  const width = 5;
  const damage = (level >= 5 ? 13.5 : level >= 2 ? 11.5 : 9) * state.stats.damage;
  for (const offset of beams) {
    const beamDir = dir + offset;
    const finalDamage = applyNewtonPassive(damage, beamDir, p.x, p.y);
    state.slashes.push({ kind: "laser", x: p.x, y: p.y, dir: beamDir, length, width, life: 0.12, maxLife: 0.12, color: "rgba(116, 231, 255, 0.9)" });
    hitLineEnemies(p.x, p.y, beamDir, length, width, finalDamage, 5, "laser");
    if (level >= 4) {
      state.areas.push({
        kind: "afterglow",
        x: p.x + Math.cos(beamDir) * length * 0.5,
        y: p.y + Math.sin(beamDir) * length * 0.5,
        dir: beamDir,
        length,
        width: 13,
        damage: 4 * state.stats.damage,
        tick: 0,
        life: 0.42,
        maxLife: 0.42,
      });
    }
  }
}

function attackPrism() {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const length = Math.hypot(W, H);
  const beamCount = 3 + state.stats.projectiles;
  const spread = beamCount === 1 ? 0 : 0.18;
  const beams = Array.from({ length: beamCount }, (_, i) => (i - (beamCount - 1) / 2) * spread);
  for (const offset of beams) {
    const beamDir = dir + offset;
    const firstDamage = applyNewtonPassive(14.5 * state.stats.damage, beamDir, p.x, p.y);
    const firstHit = hitFirstLineEnemy(p.x, p.y, beamDir, length, 6, firstDamage, 4, "prism");
    const visualLength = firstHit ? Math.hypot(firstHit.x - p.x, firstHit.y - p.y) : length;
    state.slashes.push({ kind: "laser", x: p.x, y: p.y, dir: beamDir, length: visualLength, width: 6, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18, color: "rgba(191, 245, 255, 0.95)" });
    if (!firstHit) continue;

    state.particles.push({ kind: "star_burst", x: firstHit.x, y: firstHit.y, radius: 30, life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45 });
    const splitDirs = [beamDir - 0.42, beamDir, beamDir + 0.42];
    for (const splitDir of splitDirs) {
      const damage = applyNewtonPassive(16 * state.stats.damage, splitDir, firstHit.x, firstHit.y);
      const startX = firstHit.x + Math.cos(splitDir) * (firstHit.enemy.radius + 5);
      const startY = firstHit.y + Math.sin(splitDir) * (firstHit.enemy.radius + 5);
      state.slashes.push({ kind: "laser", x: firstHit.x, y: firstHit.y, dir: splitDir, length, width: 7, life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28, color: "rgba(191, 245, 255, 0.9)" });
      hitLineEnemies(startX, startY, splitDir, length, 7, damage, 4, "prism");
    }
  }
}

function attackWave(level) {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const attackSize = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  const width = (level >= 3 ? 112 : 94) * attackSize;
  const length = (level >= 4 ? 700 : 600) * attackSize;
  const damage = applyNewtonPassive((level >= 5 ? 5.5 : level >= 2 ? 4.5 : 3.5) * state.stats.damage, dir, p.x, p.y);
  createQuantumWave(p.x, p.y, dir, {
    kind: "wave",
    width,
    length,
    damage,
    speed: 42 * getWaveSpeedMultiplier(),
    life: getEffectDuration(8.0),
    source: "wave",
  });
}

function attackResonance() {
  const p = state.player;
  const dir = getAimDirection();
  const attackSize = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  createQuantumWave(p.x, p.y, dir, {
    kind: "resonance_wave",
    width: 112 * attackSize,
    length: 700 * attackSize,
    damage: applyNewtonPassive(5.5 * state.stats.damage, dir, p.x, p.y),
    burstDamage: applyNewtonPassive(68 * state.stats.damage, dir, p.x, p.y),
    speed: 44 * getWaveSpeedMultiplier(),
    life: getEffectDuration(8.0),
    source: "resonance",
  });
}

function createQuantumWave(x, y, dir, options) {
  state.nextWaveId = (state.nextWaveId || 0) + 1;
  state.areas.push({
    kind: options.kind,
    x: x + Math.cos(dir) * 18,
    y: y + Math.sin(dir) * 18,
    originX: x,
    originY: y,
    dir,
    vx: Math.cos(dir) * options.speed,
    vy: Math.sin(dir) * options.speed,
    width: options.width,
    length: options.length,
    damage: options.damage,
    burstDamage: options.burstDamage || 0,
    tick: 0,
    life: options.life,
    maxLife: options.life,
    source: options.source,
    resonanceCooldown: 0,
    waveId: state.nextWaveId,

}

function fireLightShots(level, evolved) {

function attackMassConversion(level) {

function createMassConversion(level, evolved) {
  const maxCount = evolved ? 10 : level >= 3 ? 4 : 1;
  const scienceOrbs = state.gems
    .filter(g => (g.kind === "mini_xp" || g.kind === "xp" || g.kind === "large_xp") && !g.dead)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const ap = a.kind === "mini_xp" ? 0 : 1;
      const bp = b.kind === "mini_xp" ? 0 : 1;
      if (ap !== bp) return ap - bp;
      return Math.hypot(a.x - state.player.x, a.y - state.player.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - state.player.x, b.y - state.player.y);
    })
    .slice(0, maxCount);
  if (!scienceOrbs.length) return;
  let x = 0;
  let y = 0;
  let value = 0;
  let miniCount = 0;
  let standardCount = 0;
  for (const orb of scienceOrbs) {
    x += orb.x;
    y += orb.y;
    value += (orb.value || 1) * (orb.kind === "mini_xp" ? 1 : 3.2);
    if (orb.kind === "mini_xp") miniCount += 1;
    else standardCount += 1;
    orb.dead = true;
    state.particles.push({ kind: "mini_orb_spark", x: orb.x, y: orb.y, radius: orb.kind === "large_xp" ? 15 : orb.kind === "xp" ? 11 : 8, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
  }
  x /= scienceOrbs.length;
  y /= scienceOrbs.length;
  const target = findTargetFrom(x, y);
  const tx = target?.x ?? state.player.x + state.player.facingX * 160;
  const ty = target?.y ?? state.player.y + state.player.facingY * 160;
  const massBonus = Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, value));
  state.massProjectiles.push({
    x,
    y,
    targetX: tx,
    targetY: ty,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    radius: evolved ? 10 + scienceOrbs.length * 2.4 + Math.min(8, standardCount * 2) : 7 + scienceOrbs.length * 1.7 + Math.min(5, standardCount * 1.5),
    damage: (evolved ? 41 : level >= 2 ? 28 : 20) * state.stats.damage + value * (evolved ? 2.45 : 1.75),
    explosionRadius: evolved ? 86 + Math.min(44, massBonus * 3.5 + standardCount * 7) : (level >= 5 ? 88 : level >= 3 ? 76 : 64) + Math.min(48, massBonus * 3.2 + standardCount * 8),
    explosionDamageScale: evolved ? 0.64 : level >= 5 ? 0.54 : 0.46,
    shockwave: true,
    evolved,
    miniCount,
    standardCount,
    materialValue: value,
    cascadeCount: evolved ? Math.min(8, 3 + scienceOrbs.length + standardCount) : 0,
    phase: "compress",
    timer: evolved ? 0.14 : 0.26,
    source: evolved ? "emc2" : "mass_conversion",
    color: "#80e9ff",
  });
  state.gems = state.gems.filter(g => !g.dead);
}

function dropMiniScienceOrbs(enemy, count = 1, source = "photoelectric_effect") {
  if (!enemy) return;
  trimMiniScienceOrbs();
  const value = Math.max(1, Math.round((enemy.xp || 1) * 0.2 / Math.max(1, count)));
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const angle = count === 1 ? Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 : (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + rand(-0.38, 0.38);
    const distOut = (enemy.radius || 12) + rand(18, 34);
    const orbX = clamp(enemy.x + Math.cos(angle) * distOut, 8, W - 8);
    const orbY = clamp(enemy.y + Math.sin(angle) * distOut, 18, H - 8);
    state.gems.push({
      kind: "mini_xp",
      x: orbX,
      y: orbY,
      value,
      radius: 3.5,
      pull: false,
      life: 8,
      source,
    });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "mini_orb_spark", x: orbX, y: orbY, radius: 10, life: 0.2, maxLife: 0.2 });
  }
  trimMiniScienceOrbs();
}

function attackXray(level) {

  const range = level >= 2 ? 190 : 160;
  const angle = level >= 3 ? 0.86 : 0.68;
  const damage = (level >= 4 ? 13 : 9) * state.stats.damage;
  createXrayShot(p.x, p.y, dir, range, angle, damage, level, "xray", false);
}

function attackCollapse() {

}

function createXrayShot(x, y, dir, range, angleWidth, damage, level, source, collapse) {
  state.areas.push({
    kind: "xray_flash",
    x,
    y,
    dir,
    range,
    angle: angleWidth,
    life: 0.18,
    maxLife: 0.18,
  });
  let hits = 0;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - x;
    const dy = e.y - y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > range + e.radius) continue;
    const diff = Math.abs(angleDiff(dir, Math.atan2(dy, dx)));
    if (diff > angleWidth * 0.5) continue;
    hits += 1;
    hitEnemy(e, damage, collapse ? 3 : 1, dx, dy, source);
    if (collapse) {
      applyRadiationLevel(e, 3, "collapse");
      e.stunTimer = Math.max(e.stunTimer || 0, 1);
    } else {
      applyRadiationLevel(e, (e.radiationLevel || 0) + 1, "xray");
      const stun = level >= 5 ? 0.78 : level >= 4 ? 0.62 : level >= 3 ? 0.48 : level >= 2 ? 0.34 : 0.24;
      e.stunTimer = Math.max(e.stunTimer || 0, stun);
      e.radiationDriftX = -Math.cos(dir) * (level >= 4 ? 76 : 48);
      e.radiationDriftY = -Math.sin(dir) * (level >= 4 ? 76 : 48);
      e.radiationWobbleTimer = Math.min(e.radiationWobbleTimer || 0.3, 0.3);
    }
  }
  if (hits > 0) state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: x + Math.cos(dir) * 44, y: y + Math.sin(dir) * 44 - 12, text: collapse ? "붕괴!" : "찰칵", color: collapse ? "#ff7777" : "#d9f1ff", life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, size: 12 });
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) createRadioactiveThrow(level, false, i, count, base);
}

}

function createRadioactiveThrow(level, evolved, index = 0, count = 1, baseOverride = null) {
  const p = state.player;
  const target = findTarget();
  const base = baseOverride ?? (target ? Math.atan2(target.y - p.y, target.x - p.x) : getAimDirection());
  const radius = evolved ? 74 : level >= 3 ? 66 : 54;
  const minThrowDistance = radius + 30;
  const distance = rand(minThrowDistance, minThrowDistance + (evolved ? 118 : 92));
  const singleAngle = base + rand(-0.42, 0.42);
  const point = count > 1
    ? getSeparatedLanding(base, index, count, minThrowDistance, minThrowDistance + (evolved ? 118 : 92), 0.84)
    : { x: clamp(p.x + Math.cos(singleAngle) * distance, 30, W - 30), y: clamp(p.y + Math.sin(singleAngle) * distance, 44, H - 28) };
  const x = point.x;
  const y = point.y;
  const damage = (evolved ? 58 : level >= 2 ? 48 : 38) * state.stats.damage;
  state.falls.push({
    kind: evolved ? "fallout" : "radioactive_material",
    x,
    y,
    height: 120,
    radius,
    damage,
    playerDamage: damage * (evolved ? 0.22 : 0.18),
    exposureRate: level >= 5 || evolved ? 18 : 13,
    knock: evolved ? 10 : 7,
    life: 3,
    maxLife: 3,
    source: evolved ? "fallout" : "radioactive_material",
  });
}
