function triggerSuperpositionAttack(def, level) {
  if (!isSchrodingerCharacter()) return;
  if (!["ruler", "steel_ruler", "ball", "iron_ball", "chalk", "chalk_machine", "ammonia", "chem_warfare", "flask", "flammable_material", "wave", "resonance"].includes(def.id)) return;
  if (Math.random() > 0.14) return;
  const echo = getQuantumEchoPoint();
  const target = findTargetFrom(echo.x, echo.y);
  const dir = target ? Math.atan2(target.y - echo.y, target.x - echo.x) : getAimDirection() + rand(-0.7, 0.7);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "quantum_echo", x: echo.x, y: echo.y, life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });

  if (def.id === "ruler" || def.id === "steel_ruler") {
    const evolved = def.id === "steel_ruler";
    const length = evolved ? 116 : level >= 3 ? 74 : 58;
    const width = evolved ? 16 : 13;
    const damage = (evolved ? 40 : level >= 2 ? 28 : 22) * state.stats.damage;
    state.slashes.push({ kind: "line", x: echo.x, y: echo.y, dir, length, width, life: 0.12, maxLife: 0.12, color: "rgba(197, 224, 255, 0.58)" });
    hitLineEnemies(echo.x, echo.y, dir, length, width, damage, 6, def.id);
    return;
  }

  if (def.id === "ball" || def.id === "iron_ball") {
    const evolved = def.id === "iron_ball";
    state.projectiles.push({
      kind: evolved ? "iron_ball" : "ball",
      x: echo.x,
      y: echo.y,
      vx: Math.cos(dir) * (evolved ? 400 : level >= 5 ? 330 : 230),
      vy: Math.sin(dir) * (evolved ? 400 : level >= 5 ? 330 : 230),
      radius: evolved ? 8 : 7,
      damage: (evolved ? 16 : 12) * state.stats.damage,
      power: 1,
      life: getEffectDuration(4.5),
      bounces: evolved ? 6 : 4,
      hit: new Set(),
    });
    return;
  }

  if (def.id === "chalk" || def.id === "chalk_machine") {
    state.projectiles.push({
      kind: def.id === "chalk_machine" ? "chalk_machine" : "chalk",
      x: echo.x,
      y: echo.y,
      vx: Math.cos(dir) * 330,
      vy: Math.sin(dir) * 330,
      radius: 5,
      damage: (def.id === "chalk_machine" ? 8 : 15) * state.stats.damage,
      life: getEffectDuration(1.8),
      pierce: 0,
      splash: def.id === "chalk_machine" ? 68 : 42,
      hit: new Set(),
    });
    return;
  }

  if (def.id === "ammonia" || def.id === "chem_warfare") {
    const radius = def.id === "chem_warfare" ? 74 : level >= 4 ? 66 : 50;
    state.areas.push({ kind: "quantum_cloud", x: echo.x, y: echo.y, radius, damage: (def.id === "chem_warfare" ? 5 : 3.5) * state.stats.damage, tick: 0, life: 0.75, maxLife: 0.75 });
    return;
  }

  if (def.id === "flask" || def.id === "flammable_material") {
    const point = target || echo;
    state.areas.push({ kind: def.id === "flammable_material" ? "flammable" : "flask", x: point.x, y: point.y, radius: 42, damage: (def.id === "flammable_material" ? 3.5 : 7) * state.stats.damage, tick: 0, life: getEffectDuration(1.2), maxLife: getEffectDuration(1.2), explosionDamage: 18 * state.stats.damage });
    return;
  }

  if (def.id === "wave" || def.id === "resonance") {
    createQuantumWave(echo.x, echo.y, dir, {
      kind: def.id === "resonance" ? "resonance_wave" : "wave",
      width: def.id === "resonance" ? 112 : 96,
      length: def.id === "resonance" ? 700 : 600,
      damage: (def.id === "resonance" ? 5.5 : 3.5) * state.stats.damage,
      burstDamage: def.id === "resonance" ? 64 * state.stats.damage : 0,
      speed: (def.id === "resonance" ? 44 : 42) * getWaveSpeedMultiplier(),
      life: getEffectDuration(8.0),
      source: def.id,
    });
  }
}

function getQuantumEchoPoint() {
  const p = state.player;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {
    const x = rand(54, W - 54);
    const y = rand(64, H - 48);
    if (Math.hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y) >= 180) return { x, y };
  }
  const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = rand(190, 310);
  return {
    x: clamp(p.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, 54, W - 54),
    y: clamp(p.y + Math.sin(angle) * distance, 64, H - 48),
  };
}

function updateNotebook(dt) {
  // Rotating notebook hits enemies along its orbit.
  const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "notebook" || w.id === "exam_cheatsheet");
  if (!owned) return;
  const p = state.player;
  const evolved = owned.id === "exam_cheatsheet";
  const level = owned.level;
  const count = evolved ? 4 + state.stats.projectiles : 1 + (level >= 2 ? 1 : 0) + (level >= 5 ? 1 : 0) + state.stats.projectiles;
  const orbit = evolved ? 96 : level >= 3 ? 88 : 74;
  const baseDamage = evolved ? 14 : level >= 3 ? 13 : level >= 2 ? 11.5 : 12.5;
  const damage = applyNewtonPassive(baseDamage * state.stats.damage);
  const previousAngle = state.notebookAngle;
  state.notebookAngle += dt * (evolved ? 3.35 : 2.9) * getAvatarOrbitSpeedMultiplier();
  const tickRate = evolved ? 0.18 : level >= 4 ? 0.2 : 0.28;
  owned.tick = Math.max(0, (owned.tick || 0) - dt);
  if (owned.tick > 0) return;
  owned.tick = tickRate;

  const fromAngle = owned.lastNotebookHitAngle ?? previousAngle;
  const toAngle = state.notebookAngle;
  const hitThisTick = new Set();
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    sweepNotebookPath(p.x, p.y, orbit, fromAngle + (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count, toAngle + (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count, 15, damage, owned.id, hitThisTick);
  }
  owned.lastNotebookHitAngle = toAngle;
  triggerSuperpositionNotebook(owned, count, orbit, damage);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function sweepNotebookPath(cx, cy, orbit, fromAngle, toAngle, hitRadius, damage, source, hitSet) {
  const delta = Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle);
  const steps = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(delta * orbit / 18));
  for (let step = 0; step <= steps; step += 1) {
    const t = step / steps;
    const a = lerp(fromAngle, toAngle, t);
    const nx = cx + Math.cos(a) * orbit;
    const ny = cy + Math.sin(a) * orbit;
    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (hitSet.has(e) || e.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(e.x - nx, e.y - ny) <= e.radius + hitRadius) {
        hitSet.add(e);
        hitEnemy(e, damage, 0, e.x - cx, e.y - cy, source);
      }
    }
  }
}

function triggerSuperpositionNotebook(owned, count, orbit, damage) {
  if (!isSchrodingerCharacter() || Math.random() > 0.09) return;
  const echo = getQuantumEchoPoint();
  state.particles.push({ kind: "quantum_echo", x: echo.x, y: echo.y, life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(count, 3); i += 1) {
    const a = state.notebookAngle + (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count;
    const nx = echo.x + Math.cos(a) * orbit;
    const ny = echo.y + Math.sin(a) * orbit;
    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (Math.hypot(e.x - nx, e.y - ny) < e.radius + 12) hitEnemy(e, damage * 0.72, 0, e.x - echo.x, e.y - echo.y, owned.id);
    }
    state.particles.push({ kind: "quantum_note", x: nx, y: ny, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
  }
}

function updateOrbitSystem(dt) {
  const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "planet" || w.id === "solar_system");
  if (!owned) return;
  state.orbitTime += dt;
  owned.tick = Math.max(0, (owned.tick || 0) - dt);
  if (owned.tick > 0) return;
  owned.tick = owned.id === "solar_system" ? 0.13 : 0.18;
  const planets = getOrbitPlanets(owned);
  for (const planet of planets) {
    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (Math.hypot(e.x - planet.x, e.y - planet.y) <= e.radius + planet.radius) {
        hitEnemy(e, planet.damage * state.stats.damage, planet.knock, e.x - state.player.x, e.y - state.player.y, owned.id);
        if (Math.random() < 0.2) state.particles.push({ kind: "star", x: planet.x, y: planet.y, radius: planet.radius + 4, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
      }
    }
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function getOrbitPlanets(owned) {
  const p = state.player;
  const evolved = owned.id === "solar_system";
  const orbitCount = evolved ? 6 : owned.level;
  const density = 1 + state.stats.projectiles;
  const planets = [];
  const baseRadii = evolved ? [48, 84, 128, 178, 234, 292] : [56, 96, 142, 194, 252];
  const speedFactors = evolved ? [1.42, 0.88, 1.17, 0.56, 0.73, 0.38] : [1.36, 0.82, 1.08, 0.58, 0.72];
  const phaseOffsets = evolved ? [0.2, 2.0, 0.95, 3.55, 1.48, 4.42] : [0.15, 1.95, 0.72, 3.35, 1.28];
  for (let orbit = 0; orbit < orbitCount; orbit += 1) {
    const radius = baseRadii[orbit] || baseRadii[baseRadii.length - 1] + (orbit - baseRadii.length + 1) * 58;
    const planetCount = evolved ? Math.min(4, density + (orbit >= 3 ? 1 : 0)) : density;
    const size = evolved ? [5, 7, 8, 16, 13, 10][orbit] || 8 : 7 + orbit;
    const speed = (evolved ? 2.36 : 2.05) * speedFactors[orbit % speedFactors.length] * (64 / radius) * getAvatarOrbitSpeedMultiplier();
    const wobble = Math.sin(state.orbitTime * (0.34 + orbit * 0.07) + orbit * 1.9) * (0.12 + orbit * 0.015);
    const phase = phaseOffsets[orbit % phaseOffsets.length] + wobble;
    for (let i = 0; i < planetCount; i += 1) {
      const localOffset = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / planetCount + Math.sin(state.orbitTime * (0.18 + i * 0.05 + orbit * 0.03)) * 0.05;
      const angle = state.orbitTime * speed + phase + localOffset;
      planets.push({
        x: p.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        y: p.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
        orbitRadius: radius,
        radius: size,
        color: getPlanetColor(orbit, evolved),
        ring: evolved && orbit === 4,
        jupiter: evolved && orbit === 3,
        damage: evolved ? (orbit === 3 ? 28 : 13 + orbit * 2.4) : 8 + orbit * 2.1,
        knock: evolved ? 8 : 5,
      });
    }
  }
  return planets;
}

function getPlanetColor(index, evolved) {
  const colors = evolved
    ? ["#b8c7d8", "#6cc5ff", "#6ed36c", "#d49657", "#d9b16f", "#8ad6df"]
    : ["#95d0ff", "#a4e37f", "#e0bd70", "#c98ad8", "#8fd7d8"];
  return colors[index % colors.length];
}

function updateProjectiles(dt) {
  const projectileSpeedMultiplier = getGalileoProjectileSpeedMultiplier();
  const attackSizeMultiplier = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  for (const pr of state.projectiles) {
    if (pr.kind === "ammonite" || pr.kind === "ancient_sea_ammonite") {
      updateAmmoniteProjectile(pr, dt);
      continue;
    }
    pr.x += pr.vx * dt * projectileSpeedMultiplier;
    pr.y += pr.vy * dt * projectileSpeedMultiplier;
    pr.life -= dt;

    if (pr.kind === "ball" || pr.kind === "iron_ball") {
      if (pr.x < pr.radius || pr.x > W - pr.radius) {
        pr.vx *= -1;
        pr.bounces -= 1;
        if (pr.kind === "iron_ball") pr.power = Math.min(3, pr.power * 1.2);
      }
      if (pr.y < 26 || pr.y > H - pr.radius) {
        pr.vy *= -1;
        pr.bounces -= 1;
        if (pr.kind === "iron_ball") pr.power = Math.min(3, pr.power * 1.2);
      }
    }

    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (pr.hit.has(e)) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(pr.x - e.x, pr.y - e.y) <= pr.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) {
        const source = pr.source || pr.kind;
        let damage = pr.kind === "iron_ball" ? pr.damage * pr.power : pr.damage;
        damage *= getAdaDebugSynergyDamageMultiplier(e, source);
        const projectileKnock = pr.kind === "chalk" || pr.kind === "chalk_machine" ? 0 : pr.kind === "iron_ball" ? 16 : pr.knock ?? 10;
        hitEnemy(e, damage, projectileKnock, pr.vx, pr.vy, source);
        pr.hit.add(e);
        if (pr.kind === "light_photon") {
          dropMiniScienceOrbs(e, pr.miniDrops || 1, pr.source || "photoelectric_effect");
          state.particles.push({ kind: "mini_orb_spark", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 14, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
          pr.life = 0;
        } else if (pr.kind === "current") {
          chainElectricDamage(e, pr.chainDamage, pr.chainRange, pr.chainCount, "current", false, false);
          pr.life = 0;
        } else if (pr.kind === "ada_code") {
          pr.pierce = (pr.pierce || 0) - 1;
          state.particles.push({ kind: "ada_debug_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 18, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
          if (pr.pierce < 0) pr.life = 0;
        } else if (pr.kind === "chalk" || pr.kind === "chalk_machine") {
          explode(pr.x, pr.y, pr.splash, pr.damage * 0.45, pr.kind, 0);
          pr.pierce -= 1;
          if (pr.pierce < 0) pr.life = 0;
        } else if (pr.kind === "pea" || pr.kind === "pea_split" || pr.kind === "giant_pea") {
          splitPeaProjectile(pr);
          pr.pierce = (pr.pierce || 0) - 1;
          if (pr.pierce < 0) pr.life = 0;
        } else {
          pr.vx *= -1;
          pr.vy *= -1;
          pr.bounces -= 1;
          if (pr.kind === "iron_ball") pr.power = Math.min(3, pr.power * 1.2);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  state.projectiles = state.projectiles.filter(pr =>
    pr.life > 0 && pr.bounces !== -1 && pr.x > -80 && pr.x < W + 80 && pr.y > -80 && pr.y < H + 80
  );
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function updateAmmoniteProjectile(pr, dt) {
  pr.life -= dt;
  const ux = Math.cos(pr.dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(pr.dir);
  const px = -uy;
  const py = ux;
  if (!pr.returning) {
    pr.t += dt / Math.max(0.1, (pr.maxLife || 1.8) * 0.55);
    const outwardT = clamp(pr.t, 0, 1);
    const travel = Math.sin((Math.PI * 0.5) * outwardT);
    const side = Math.sin(Math.PI * outwardT + pr.phase);
    pr.x = pr.originX + ux * pr.flightRadius * travel + px * pr.sideRadius * side * travel;
    pr.y = pr.originY + uy * pr.flightRadius * travel + py * pr.sideRadius * side * travel;
    if (outwardT >= 1) pr.returning = true;
  } else {
    const dx = state.player.x - pr.x;
    const dy = state.player.y - pr.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const returnSpeed = (pr.kind === "ancient_sea_ammonite" ? 560 : 500) * getProjectileSpeedMultiplier();
    pr.x += (dx / d) * returnSpeed * dt;
    pr.y += (dy / d) * returnSpeed * dt;
    if (d <= state.player.radius + pr.radius + 8) pr.life = 0;
  }
  if (pr.kind === "ancient_sea_ammonite") {
    pr.waveTimer -= dt;
    if (pr.waveTimer <= 0) {
      pr.waveTimer = 0.13;
      state.areas.push({
        kind: "ancient_sea_wave",
        x: pr.x,
        y: pr.y,
        radius: 34 * getAttackSizeMultiplier(),
        damage: 1.8 * state.stats.damage,
        slow: 0.18,
        tick: 0,
        life: getEffectDuration(2.7),
        maxLife: getEffectDuration(2.7),
        source: "ancient_sea",
      });
    }
  }
  const fossilHit = findNearestFossilSiteFrom(pr.x, pr.y);
  if (fossilHit && fossilHit.distance <= (pr.kind === "ancient_sea_ammonite" ? 150 : 92)) {
    state.fossil.hintBoostTimer = Math.max(state.fossil.hintBoostTimer || 0, pr.kind === "ancient_sea_ammonite" ? 1.2 : 0.7);
  }
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0) continue;
    const lastHit = pr.hitTimes.get(e) || -99;
    if (state.elapsed - lastHit < 0.28) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(pr.x - e.x, pr.y - e.y) > pr.radius * getAttackSizeMultiplier() + e.radius) continue;
    pr.hitTimes.set(e, state.elapsed);
    hitEnemy(e, pr.damage, pr.knock, e.x - pr.x, e.y - pr.y, pr.source);
    state.particles.push({ kind: "fossil_dig", x: pr.x, y: pr.y, radius: pr.radius + 10, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
  }
}

function updateMassProjectiles(dt) {
  for (const mp of state.massProjectiles) {
    if (mp.phase === "compress") {
      mp.timer -= dt;
      if (mp.timer <= 0) {
        mp.phase = "launch";
        const dx = mp.targetX - mp.x;
        const dy = mp.targetY - mp.y;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const speed = mp.evolved ? 1900 : 660;
        mp.vx = (dx / d) * speed;
        mp.vy = (dy / d) * speed;
        mp.life = mp.evolved ? 0.38 : 1.4;
      }
      continue;
    }
    mp.x += mp.vx * dt;
    mp.y += mp.vy * dt;
    mp.life -= dt;
    state.particles.push({ kind: "mini_orb_spark", x: mp.x, y: mp.y, radius: mp.radius, life: 0.12, maxLife: 0.12 });
    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(mp.x - e.x, mp.y - e.y) > mp.radius + e.radius) continue;
      hitEnemy(e, mp.damage, mp.evolved ? 18 : 10, e.x - mp.x, e.y - mp.y, mp.source);
      if (mp.shockwave) explodeEnergy(e.x, e.y, mp.explosionRadius || (mp.evolved ? 104 : 74), mp.damage * (mp.explosionDamageScale || 0.42), mp.source);
      if (mp.evolved) triggerEmc2Cascade(e.x, e.y, mp);
      mp.life = 0;
      break;
    }
  }
  state.massProjectiles = state.massProjectiles.filter(mp => (mp.phase === "compress" || mp.life > 0) && mp.x > -90 && mp.x < W + 90 && mp.y > -90 && mp.y < H + 90);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function explodeEnergy(x, y, radius, damage, source) {
  state.particles.push({ kind: "energy_burst", x, y, radius, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
  if (source === "emc2") consumeScienceOrbsInRadius(x, y, radius);
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(x - e.x, y - e.y) > radius + e.radius) continue;
    hitEnemy(e, damage, 6, e.x - x, e.y - y, source);
  }
}

function consumeScienceOrbsInRadius(x, y, radius) {
  let removed = false;
  for (const gem of state.gems) {
    if (!["mini_xp", "xp", "large_xp"].includes(gem.kind) || gem.dead) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(x - gem.x, y - gem.y) > radius + (gem.radius || 0)) continue;
    gem.dead = true;
    removed = true;
    state.particles.push({ kind: "mini_orb_spark", x: gem.x, y: gem.y, radius: (gem.radius || 5) + 5, life: 0.16, maxLife: 0.16 });
  }
  if (removed) state.gems = state.gems.filter(gem => !gem.dead);
}

function triggerEmc2Cascade(x, y, mp) {
  const targets = state.enemies
    .filter(e => e.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.y - y) <= (mp.explosionRadius || 120) + 220 + e.radius)
    .sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - x, a.y - y) - Math.hypot(b.x - x, b.y - y))
    .slice(0, mp.cascadeCount || 4);
  const shardDamage = Math.max(12, mp.damage * 0.16 + (mp.materialValue || 0) * 0.36);
  for (const target of targets) {
    const dx = target.x - x;
    const dy = target.y - y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    hitEnemy(target, shardDamage, 5, dx, dy, "emc2");
    state.particles.push({
      kind: "light_shard",
      x,
      y,
      targetX: target.x,
      targetY: target.y,
      radius: 8 + Math.min(18, (mp.standardCount || 0) * 3 + (mp.miniCount || 0)),
      life: 0.18,
      maxLife: 0.18,
    });
  }
  if ((mp.standardCount || 0) > 0) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x, y: y - 28, text: "E=mc²", color: "#fff6b0", life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55, size: 15 });
    addScreenShake(Math.min(0.18, 0.06 + (mp.standardCount || 0) * 0.025));
  }
}

function splitPeaProjectile(pr) {
  if ((pr.splitsLeft || 0) <= 0) return;
  if ((pr.totalSplits || 0) >= (pr.maxTotalSplits || 99)) return;
  const chance = applyCombatChance(pr.splitChance ?? 1, pr.splitChanceCap ?? 0.8);
  const guaranteed = (pr.guaranteedSplits || 0) > 0;
  if (!guaranteed && Math.random() >= chance) return;
  if (guaranteed) pr.guaranteedSplits -= 1;
  const pieces = pr.splitCount || 2;
  const base = Math.atan2(pr.vy, pr.vx);
  const spread = pr.splitsLeft > 1 ? 0.66 : 0.52;
  const scales = pr.splitDamageScales || [0.6, 0.35];
  const scaleIndex = Math.max(0, scales.length - pr.splitsLeft);
  const scale = scales[Math.min(scaleIndex, scales.length - 1)];
  const speed = Math.hypot(pr.vx, pr.vy) * 0.88;
  for (let i = 0; i < pieces; i += 1) {
    const angle = base + (i - (pieces - 1) / 2) * spread;
    state.projectiles.push({
      kind: "pea_split",
      x: pr.x + Math.cos(angle) * 8,
      y: pr.y + Math.sin(angle) * 8,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      radius: Math.max(3, pr.radius * 0.72),
      damage: pr.damage * scale,
      life: getEffectDuration(1.25),
      pierce: 0,
      splitsLeft: pr.splitsLeft - 1,
      splitChance: pr.splitChance,
      splitChanceCap: pr.splitChanceCap,
      splitCount: pieces,
      splitDamageScales: scales,
      guaranteedSplits: pr.guaranteedSplits || 0,
      maxTotalSplits: pr.maxTotalSplits,
      totalSplits: (pr.totalSplits || 0) + 1,
      knock: Math.max(5, (pr.knock ?? 10) * 0.75),
      source: pr.source,
      hit: new Set(),
    });
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "sprout", x: pr.x, y: pr.y, radius: pr.radius + 8, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
}

function updateAreas(dt) {
  const attackSizeMultiplier = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  for (const area of state.areas) {
    area.life -= dt;
    area.tick -= dt;
    if (area.kind === "afterglow") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.12;
        hitLineEnemies(area.x - Math.cos(area.dir) * area.length * 0.5, area.y - Math.sin(area.dir) * area.length * 0.5, area.dir, area.length, area.width, area.damage, 0, "laser");
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "wave" || area.kind === "resonance_wave") {
      area.x += area.vx * dt;
      area.y += area.vy * dt;
      reflectQuantumWave(area);
      if (Math.hypot(area.x - (area.originX ?? area.x), area.y - (area.originY ?? area.y)) > area.length + 28) area.life = 0;
      if (area.life <= 0) continue;
      area.reflectionFlash = Math.max(0, (area.reflectionFlash || 0) - dt);
      area.resonanceCooldown = Math.max(0, (area.resonanceCooldown || 0) - dt);
      hitWaveEnemies(area);
      if (area.kind === "resonance_wave") triggerResonanceOverlap(area);
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "xray_flash") {
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "fossil_spike") {
      if (area.tick <= 0 && !area.done) {
        area.done = true;
        state.particles.push({ kind: "fossil_spike", x: area.x, y: area.y, radius: area.radius, life: 0.26, maxLife: 0.26 });
        for (const e of state.enemies) {
          if (area.hit.has(e) || e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) > area.radius + e.radius) continue;
          area.hit.add(e);
          hitEnemy(e, area.damage, area.knock, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, area.source);
        }
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "ancient_sea_wave") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.32;
        for (const e of state.enemies) {
          if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) > area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) continue;
          hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 0, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, area.source);
          if (!e.boss && !e.midBoss && !e.limitBoss && !e.statusImmune) {
            e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, 0.48);
            e.slowFactor = Math.min(e.slowFactor || 1, 1 - (area.slow || 0.18));
          }
        }
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
      const fossilHit = findNearestFossilSiteFrom(area.x, area.y);
      if (fossilHit && fossilHit.distance <= 150) {
        state.fossil.hintBoostTimer = Math.max(state.fossil.hintBoostTimer || 0, 0.6);
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "condition_wave") {
      area.delay = Math.max(0, (area.delay || 0) - dt);
      if (area.delay > 0) continue;
      area.radius += area.speed * dt;
      const inner = Math.max(0, area.radius - area.width);
      const outer = area.radius + area.width;
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (e.hp <= 0 || area.hit.has(e)) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y);
        if (d + e.radius >= inner && d - e.radius <= outer) {
          area.hit.add(e);
          hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 1, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, area.source);
          maybeConvertEnemyByChance(e, area.allyChance || 0, area.source);
          for (let i = 0; i < (area.extraConditionHits || 0); i += 1) recordConditionReflexHit(e, area.source, true);
          if (area.confuseChance > 0 && !e.boss && !e.statusImmune && Math.random() < applyCombatChance(area.confuseChance, 0.6)) {
            e.confusedTimer = Math.max(e.confusedTimer || 0, area.confuseDuration || 1);
            e.confusedAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          }
          state.particles.push({ kind: "condition_hit", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + 8, life: 0.24, maxLife: 0.24, hypnosis: area.source === "hypnosis" });
        }
      }
      if (area.radius >= area.maxRadius) area.life = 0;
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "radiation_exposure") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.25;
        area.applied ||= new Set();
        for (const e of state.enemies) {
          if (area.applied.has(e)) continue;
          if (Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) <= area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) {
            area.applied.add(e);
            let levelGain = 1;
            if (Math.random() < applyCombatChance(area.extraRadiationChance || 0, 0.6)) levelGain += 1;
            applyRadiationLevel(e, (e.radiationLevel || 0) + levelGain, area.source || "radioactive_material");
            if (levelGain > 1) state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 26, text: "과다 피폭", color: "#ff9c7a", life: 0.42, maxLife: 0.42, size: 11 });
            state.particles.push({ kind: "radiation_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 16 + (e.radiationLevel || 1) * 3, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
          }
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "marking_zone") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.35;
        if (Math.hypot(area.x - state.player.x, area.y - state.player.y) <= area.radius + state.player.radius) {
          healActorWithText(state.player, area.heal * 0.35 * getHealingMultiplier(), { y: state.player.y - 26 });
        }
        for (const ally of state.alliedEnemies || []) {
          if (Math.hypot(area.x - ally.x, area.y - ally.y) <= area.radius + ally.radius) {
            healActorWithText(ally, area.heal * 0.35, { y: ally.y - 18, size: 10 });
          }
        }
        for (const dog of state.pavlovDogs || []) {
          if (dog.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(area.x - dog.x, area.y - dog.y) <= area.radius + dog.radius) {
            healActorWithText(dog, area.heal * 0.35, { y: dog.y - 18, size: 10 });
          }
        }
        for (const e of state.enemies) {
          if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) > area.radius + e.radius) continue;
          hitEnemy(e, area.damage * 0.35, 0, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, "marking_zone");
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "element_slow_zone" || area.kind === "element_aura") {
      if (area.followPlayer) {
        area.x = state.player.x;
        area.y = state.player.y;
      }
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.3;
        for (const e of state.enemies) {
          if (e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) > area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) continue;
          hitEnemy(e, area.damage * 0.3, 0, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, area.source || area.kind);
          if (area.kind === "element_slow_zone" && !e.boss && !e.midBoss && !e.limitBoss && !e.statusImmune) {
            e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, 0.55);
            e.slowFactor = Math.min(e.slowFactor || 1, 1 - (area.slow || 0.25));
          }
        }
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "element_trap") {
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (area.hit?.has(e) || e.hp <= 0 || Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) > area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) continue;
        area.hit ||= new Set();
        area.hit.add(e);
        hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 3, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, area.source || "element_trap");
        area.life = 0;
        state.particles.push({ kind: "spark", x: area.x, y: area.y, vx: rand(-20, 20), vy: rand(-24, 8), life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32 });
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "telescope_scope") {
      area.delay -= dt;
      if (area.delay <= 0 && !area.triggered) {
        area.triggered = true;
        hitTelescopeEnemies(area);
        state.slashes.push({ kind: "laser", x: area.x, y: area.y, dir: area.dir, length: area.length, width: area.width, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18, color: area.source === "celestial_telescope" ? "rgba(220, 240, 255, 0.96)" : "rgba(184, 220, 255, 0.82)" });
        addScreenShake(area.source === "celestial_telescope" ? 0.14 : 0.06);
        state.particles.push({ kind: "star_burst", x: area.x + Math.cos(area.dir) * 120, y: area.y + Math.sin(area.dir) * 120, radius: area.width + 24, life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3 });
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "fault") {
      area.delay -= dt;
      if (area.delay <= 0 && !area.triggered) {
        area.triggered = true;
        hitLineEnemies(area.x, area.y, area.dir, area.length, area.width, area.damage, area.knock, area.source);
        if (area.stun > 0) applyLineStun(area.x, area.y, area.dir, area.length, area.width, area.stun);
        if (area.source === "fault_shift" || area.source === "earthquake") applyFaultCrowdShift(area);
        if (area.source === "fault_shift" || area.source === "earthquake") maybeCreateAftershock(area);
        addScreenShake(area.source === "earthquake" ? 0.18 : 0.08);
        state.particles.push({ kind: "crack_burst", x: area.x + Math.cos(area.dir) * area.length * 0.5, y: area.y + Math.sin(area.dir) * area.length * 0.5, radius: area.width + 18, life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28 });
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "shift_delay") {
      if (area.life <= 0 && !area.triggered) {
        area.triggered = true;
        createContinentalShift(area.x, area.y, area.radius, area.damage, area.knock, "continental_shift");
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "lava") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.22;
        applyVolcanoLavaFlow(area);
        for (const e of state.enemies) {
          if (Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) <= area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) {
            e.slowTimer = Math.max(e.slowTimer || 0, 0.52);
            hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 2, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, area.source || "volcano");
            if (Math.random() < 0.46) applyBurn(e, area.burnDamage || 2.9 * state.stats.damage, 1.55, area.source || "volcano");
          }
        }
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "oxygen" || area.kind === "gas_mask_field") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.32;
        updateOxygenField(area);
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "magnetic_field") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.08;
        applyMagneticField(area);
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "magnetic_storm") {
      area.x += area.vx * dt;
      area.y += area.vy * dt;
      const progress = 1 - area.life / area.maxLife;
      area.radius = lerp(58, area.maxRadius, progress);
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.08;
        applyMagneticStorm(area);
      }
      if (Math.random() < 0.45) {
        state.particles.push({ kind: "electric", x: area.x + rand(-area.radius, area.radius) * 0.45, y: area.y + rand(-area.radius, area.radius) * 0.32, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.kind === "quantum_cloud") {
      if (area.tick <= 0) {
        area.tick = 0.2;
        for (const e of state.enemies) {
          if (Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) <= area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) {
            hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 0, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, "quantum_cloud");
          }
        }
        sweepDeadEnemies();
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (area.life <= 0 && area.kind === "flammable" && !area.exploded) {
      area.exploded = true;
      explode(area.x, area.y, area.radius + 22, area.explosionDamage, "flammable_material", 0);
      state.particles.push({ kind: "boom", x: area.x, y: area.y, radius: area.radius + 24, life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });
      continue;
    }
    if (area.tick <= 0) {
      area.tick = area.kind === "combustion" ? 0.18 : 0.23;
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) <= area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) {
          const source = area.kind === "combustion" ? "combustion" : area.kind === "flammable" ? "flammable_material" : "flask";
          const areaKnock = area.kind === "flask" || area.kind === "flammable" ? 0 : 3;
          hitEnemy(e, area.damage, areaKnock, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, source);
          if (area.kind === "combustion") applyBurn(e, area.burnDamage, 1.6, "combustion");
        }
      }
    }
  }
  state.areas = state.areas.filter(a => a.life > 0);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function reflectQuantumWave(area) {
  if ((area.reflectionsLeft ?? 0) <= 0) return;
  const contact = findQuantumWaveWallContact(area);
  if (!contact) return;
  let normalX = 0;
  let normalY = 0;
  if (contact.wall === "left") normalX = 1;
  else if (contact.wall === "right") normalX = -1;
  else if (contact.wall === "top") normalY = 1;
  else if (contact.wall === "bottom") normalY = -1;
  if (normalX) area.vx *= -1;
  if (normalY) area.vy *= -1;
  area.x = clamp(contact.x, 8, W - 8);
  area.y = clamp(contact.y, 32, H - 8);
  area.reflectionsLeft -= 1;
  area.reflected = true;
  area.dir = Math.atan2(area.vy, area.vx);
  area.originX = area.x;
  area.originY = area.y;
  area.hitTimes = new Map();
  area.reflectionFlash = 0.42;
  area.life = Math.max(area.life, Math.min(area.maxLife, 3.0));
  state.particles.push({ kind: "resonance_focus", x: area.x, y: area.y, radius: 24, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "wave_reflect", x: area.x, y: area.y, dir: area.dir, nx: normalX, ny: normalY, gold: area.kind === "resonance_wave", radius: area.width * 0.54, life: 0.42, maxLife: 0.42 });
}

function findQuantumWaveWallContact(area) {
  const ux = Math.cos(area.dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(area.dir);
  const px = -uy;
  const py = ux;
  const samples = 12;
  const half = area.width * 0.92;
  const phase = getQuantumWaveCrestPhase(area);
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i += 1) {
    const side = -half + (half * 2 * i) / samples;
    const crestOffset = getQuantumWaveCrestOffset(area, side, phase);
    const x = area.x + ux * crestOffset + px * side;
    const y = area.y + uy * crestOffset + py * side;
    if (x <= 8) return { x: 8, y: clamp(y, 32, H - 8), wall: "left" };
    if (x >= W - 8) return { x: W - 8, y: clamp(y, 32, H - 8), wall: "right" };
    if (y <= 32) return { x: clamp(x, 8, W - 8), y: 32, wall: "top" };
    if (y >= H - 8) return { x: clamp(x, 8, W - 8), y: H - 8, wall: "bottom" };
  }
  return null;
}

function triggerResonanceOverlap(area) {
  if (area.resonanceCooldown > 0) return;
  for (const other of state.areas) {
    if (other === area || other.kind !== "resonance_wave" || other.resonanceCooldown > 0) continue;
    if (!area.reflected && !other.reflected) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(area.x - other.x, area.y - other.y);
    if (d > (area.width + other.width) * 0.95) continue;
    const angle = getVectorAngleBetween(area.vx, area.vy, other.vx, other.vy);
    if (angle <= Math.PI / 2) continue;
    const x = (area.x + other.x) * 0.5;
    const y = (area.y + other.y) * 0.5;
    const damage = Math.max(area.burstDamage || 0, other.burstDamage || 0, 64 * state.stats.damage);
    area.resonanceCooldown = 0.8;
    other.resonanceCooldown = 0.8;
    const attackSize = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
    addScreenShake(0.08);
    state.particles.push({ kind: "resonance_focus", x, y, radius: 44 * attackSize, life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "resonance_burst", x, y, radius: 74 * attackSize, life: 0.46, maxLife: 0.46, gold: true });
    explode(x, y, 68 * attackSize, damage, "resonance", 0);
    break;
  }
}

function getVectorAngleBetween(ax, ay, bx, by) {
  const al = Math.hypot(ax, ay) || 1;
  const bl = Math.hypot(bx, by) || 1;
  const dot = clamp((ax * bx + ay * by) / (al * bl), -1, 1);
  return Math.acos(dot);
}

function hitWaveEnemies(area) {
  const ux = Math.cos(area.dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(area.dir);
  const px = -uy;
  const py = ux;
  const crestDepth = area.kind === "resonance_wave" ? 19 : 16;
  const phase = getQuantumWaveCrestPhase(area);
  area.hitTimes ||= new Map();
  const rehitDelay = area.kind === "resonance_wave" ? 0.76 : 0.96;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0) continue;
    const dx = e.x - area.x;
    const dy = e.y - area.y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    const signedSide = dx * px + dy * py;
    const side = Math.abs(signedSide);
    if (side > area.width * 0.92 + e.radius) continue;
    const crestOffset = getQuantumWaveCrestOffset(area, signedSide, phase);
    if (Math.abs(forward - crestOffset) <= crestDepth + e.radius) {
      const lastHit = area.hitTimes.get(e) ?? -Infinity;
      if (state.elapsed - lastHit < rehitDelay) continue;
      area.hitTimes.set(e, state.elapsed);
      hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 0, ux, uy, area.source);
      if (Math.random() < 0.5) state.particles.push({ kind: "wave_hit", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + 8, life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18, gold: area.kind === "resonance_wave" });
    }
  }
}

function getQuantumWaveCrestPhase(area) {
  return state.elapsed * 10 + (area.waveId || 0) * 0.73;
}

function getQuantumWaveCrestOffset(area, signedSide, phase = getQuantumWaveCrestPhase(area), pass = 0) {
  return Math.sin(phase + signedSide * 0.095) * (9 + pass * 1.5)
    + Math.sin(phase * 0.55 + signedSide * 0.045) * 3;
}

function applyMagneticField(area) {
  const ux = Math.cos(area.dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(area.dir);
  const px = -Math.sin(area.dir);
  const py = Math.cos(area.dir);
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (!isPointInMagneticCone(e.x, e.y, area)) continue;
    const dx = e.x - area.x;
    const dy = e.y - area.y;
    const signedSide = dx * px + dy * py;
    const resist = e.knockResist ?? 1;
    const pull = clamp(Math.abs(signedSide), 0, area.force * 1.35) * resist;
    e.x -= Math.sign(signedSide) * px * pull;
    e.y -= Math.sign(signedSide) * py * pull;
    hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 0, ux, uy, area.source);
    applyElectromagneticInduction(e, area.force * 0.35, area.source);
  }

  for (const gem of state.gems) {
    if (!isPointInMagneticCone(gem.x, gem.y, area)) continue;
    const dx = state.player.x - gem.x;
    const dy = state.player.y - gem.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const speed = area.force * 7.5;
    gem.x += (dx / d) * speed;
    gem.y += (dy / d) * speed;
    gem.pull = true;
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function updateOxygenField(area) {
  const attackSizeMultiplier = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  const p = state.player;
  if (Math.hypot(area.x - p.x, area.y - p.y) <= area.radius + p.radius) {
    const heal = area.heal * 0.32 * getHealingMultiplier();
    healActorWithText(p, heal, { y: p.y - 26 });
  }
  for (const ally of state.alliedEnemies || []) {
    if (Math.hypot(area.x - ally.x, area.y - ally.y) <= area.radius + ally.radius) {
      healActorWithText(ally, area.heal * 0.32, { y: ally.y - 18, size: 10 });
    }
  }
  for (const dog of state.pavlovDogs || []) {
    if (dog.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(area.x - dog.x, area.y - dog.y) <= area.radius + dog.radius) {
      healActorWithText(dog, area.heal * 0.32, { y: dog.y - 18, size: 10 });
    }
  }
  if (area.damage > 0) {
    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) <= area.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) {
        hitEnemy(e, area.damage * 0.32, 0, e.x - area.x, e.y - area.y, "gas_mask");
      }
    }
    sweepDeadEnemies();
  }
}

function getGasMaskDamageReduction() {
  const p = state.player;
  for (const area of state.areas) {
    if (area.kind === "gas_mask_field" && Math.hypot(area.x - p.x, area.y - p.y) <= area.radius + p.radius) {
      return area.reduction || 0.3;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

function applyMagneticStorm(area) {
  const forwardX = Math.cos(area.dir);
  const forwardY = Math.sin(area.dir);
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - area.x;
    const dy = e.y - area.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > area.radius + e.radius) continue;
    const resist = e.knockResist ?? 1;
    const tangentX = -dy / d;
    const tangentY = dx / d;
    e.x += (forwardX * area.force + tangentX * area.force * 0.72) * resist;
    e.y += (forwardY * area.force + tangentY * area.force * 0.72) * resist;
    hitEnemy(e, area.damage, 0, forwardX, forwardY, area.source);
    applyElectromagneticInduction(e, area.force, area.source);
  }
  for (const gem of state.gems) {
    const dx = gem.x - area.x;
    const dy = gem.y - area.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > area.radius + 28) continue;
    if (gem.kind === "heal_pea") {
      gem.pull = true;
      continue;
    }
    gainExp(gem.value || 0);
    gem.dead = true;
    if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
      state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: area.x, y: area.y - 24, text: "+과학력", color: "#80e9ff", life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32, size: 11 });
    }
  }
  state.gems = state.gems.filter(gem => !gem.dead);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function isPointInMagneticCone(x, y, area) {
  const dx = x - area.x;
  const dy = y - area.y;
  const forward = Math.cos(area.dir) * dx + Math.sin(area.dir) * dy;
  if (forward < 0 || forward > area.length) return false;
  const side = Math.abs(-Math.sin(area.dir) * dx + Math.cos(area.dir) * dy);
  return side <= 26 + forward * area.width;
}

function updateFallingObjects(dt) {
  const attackSizeMultiplier = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  for (const fall of state.falls) {
    fall.life -= dt;
    const t = fall.life / fall.maxLife;
    fall.height = Math.max(0, 110 * t);
    if (fall.kind === "radioactive_material" || fall.kind === "fallout") {
      fall.height = Math.max(0, 130 * t);
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (Math.hypot(fall.x - e.x, fall.y - e.y) <= fall.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + 24 + e.radius) {
          addRadiationExposure(e, (fall.exposureRate || 13) * dt, fall.source);
        }
      }
    }
    if (fall.pull && fall.life < 0.32) {
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        const dx = fall.x - e.x;
        const dy = fall.y - e.y;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        if (d < fall.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + 46) {
          e.x += (dx / d) * 90 * dt;
          e.y += (dy / d) * 90 * dt;
        }
      }
    }
    if (fall.life <= 0 && !fall.hit) {
      fall.hit = true;
      state.particles.push({ kind: fall.kind === "gravity" ? "boom" : fall.kind === "radioactive_material" || fall.kind === "fallout" ? "radiation_burst" : "splash", x: fall.x, y: fall.y, radius: fall.radius * attackSizeMultiplier, life: 0.26, maxLife: 0.26 });
      if (fall.kind === "gravity") addScreenShake(0.16);
      for (const e of state.enemies) {
        if (Math.hypot(fall.x - e.x, fall.y - e.y) <= fall.radius * attackSizeMultiplier + e.radius) {
          hitEnemy(e, fall.damage, fall.knock, e.x - fall.x, e.y - fall.y, fall.source);
          if (fall.kind === "radioactive_material" || fall.kind === "fallout") {
            addRadiationExposure(e, fall.kind === "fallout" ? 65 : 42, fall.source);
            if (fall.kind === "fallout") {
              e.fallout = true;
              e.falloutSource = "fallout";
              e.radiationDriftX = rand(-70, 70);
              e.radiationDriftY = rand(-70, 70);
              e.radiationWobbleTimer = 0.25;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (fall.kind === "radioactive_material" || fall.kind === "fallout") {
        state.areas.push({ kind: "radiation_exposure", x: fall.x, y: fall.y, radius: fall.radius * attackSizeMultiplier * 0.92, exposureRate: fall.kind === "fallout" ? 20 : 15, extraRadiationChance: fall.kind === "fallout" ? 0.24 : 0.15, tick: 0, life: 2.35, maxLife: 2.35, source: fall.source });
        addScreenShake(fall.kind === "fallout" ? 0.16 : 0.1);
      }
    }
  }
  state.falls = state.falls.filter(f => f.life > -0.05);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function damagePlayerFromHazard(x, y, radius, damage) {
  const p = state.player;
  if (p.invuln > 0 || Math.hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y) > radius + p.radius) return;
  p.hp = Math.max(0, p.hp - damage);
  p.invuln = Math.max(p.invuln, 0.45);
  state.hurtTimer = 0.45;
  state.playerHitFlash = 0.34;
  playAudioCue("hurt");
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: p.x, y: p.y - 24, text: "위험!", color: "#ff7777", life: 0.42, maxLife: 0.42, size: 12 });
  if (p.hp <= 0) endRun(false);
}

function explode(x, y, radius, damage, source = "explosion", knock = 8) {
  state.particles.push({ kind: source === "flammable_material" ? "boom" : "splash", x, y, radius, life: 0.2, maxLife: 0.2 });
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (Math.hypot(x - e.x, y - e.y) <= radius + e.radius) {
      hitEnemy(e, damage, knock, e.x - x, e.y - y, source);
    }
  }
}

function applyLineStun(x, y, dir, length, width, duration) {
  const ux = Math.cos(dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(dir);
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - x;
    const dy = e.y - y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    if (forward < 0 || forward > length + e.radius) continue;
    const side = Math.abs(dx * uy - dy * ux);
    if (side <= width + e.radius) {
      if (e.statusImmune) continue;
      e.stunTimer = Math.max(e.stunTimer || 0, e.boss ? 0.25 : duration);
    }
  }
}

function isEvolvedDamageSource(source) {
  const def = getWeaponDef(source);
  return Boolean(def?.evolved || [
    "combustion_explosion",
    "flammable_explosion",
    "resonance_burst",
    "radiation_internal",
    "radioactive_corpse",
    "quantum_switch",
  ].includes(source));
}

function hitEnemy(e, damage, knock, kx, ky, source = "") {
  if ((e.phaseAlphaTimer || 0) > 0) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "spark", x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: rand(-18, 18), vy: rand(-18, 18), life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18 });
    return;
  }
  if (e.quantumDebuff > 0 && ["wave", "resonance", "quantum_cloud", "schrodinger_cat", "quantum_cat"].includes(source)) {
    damage *= 1.15;
  }
  damage *= getAvatarDamageMultiplier(source, e);
  if (source !== "radiation_internal") {
    if ((e.radiationLevel || 0) === 2) damage *= 1.3;
    if ((e.radiationLevel || 0) >= 3) damage *= 1.6;
  }
  const len = Math.hypot(kx, ky) || 1;
  const heavyHit = damage >= Math.max(24, e.maxHp * 0.12);
  const evolvedHit = isEvolvedDamageSource(source);
  const actualDamage = Math.max(0, Math.min(e.hp, damage));
  e.hp -= damage;
  if (source) e.killer = source;
  const elementScanDeathHeld = holdElementScanDeathIfNeeded(e);
  maybeTriggerAdaDebugBug(e, { damage: actualDamage, source, isArea: String(source).includes("area") || String(source).includes("field") || String(source).includes("zone") });
  if (!elementScanDeathHeld && e.hp <= 0) triggerAdaBugDeathExplosion(e);
  if (source && state?.run?.weaponDamageCounts) {
    state.run.weaponDamageCounts[source] = (state.run.weaponDamageCounts[source] || 0) + actualDamage;
    if (state.run.weaponDamageEvents) {
      state.run.weaponDamageEvents.push({ time: state.elapsed, source, damage: actualDamage });
      const cutoff = state.elapsed - 75;
      while (state.run.weaponDamageEvents.length > 0 && state.run.weaponDamageEvents[0].time < cutoff) {
        state.run.weaponDamageEvents.shift();
      }
    }
  }
  e.hitFlash = Math.max(e.hitFlash || 0, evolvedHit ? 0.2 : heavyHit ? 0.16 : 0.08);
  if (source === "germ" || source === "pandemic") e.suppressHitColorFlash = Math.max(e.suppressHitColorFlash || 0, 0.14);
  e.evolvedHitFlash = Math.max(e.evolvedHitFlash || 0, evolvedHit ? 0.22 : 0);
  e.hitKickX = (kx / len) * (e.boss ? 1.6 : heavyHit ? 4 : 2);
  e.hitKickY = (ky / len) * (e.boss ? 1.6 : heavyHit ? 4 : 2);
  if (heavyHit && Math.random() < 0.45) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "hit_ring", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + (evolvedHit ? 13 : 8), life: 0.18, maxLife: 0.18, boss: e.boss, evolved: evolvedHit });
  }
  const resist = e.statusImmune ? 0 : e.knockResist ?? 1;
  e.x += (kx / len) * knock * resist;
  e.y += (ky / len) * knock * resist;
  if (knock > 0) applyElectromagneticInduction(e, knock, source);
  applyPangaeaPassive(e, knock, kx / len, ky / len);
  if (isTectonicMarkSource(source)) applyTectonicInstability(e, source);
  if (isTectonicDetonateSource(source)) triggerTectonicRupture(e, source);
  recordConditionReflexHit(e, source);
  maybeConvertEnemyFromBellItem(e, source);
  maybeDropMiniOrbFromAvatarItem(e, source);
}

function applyCombatChance(baseChance, cap = 0.8) {
  const mult = (state?.avatarItemStats || {}).combatChanceMultiplier || 1;
  return Math.min(cap, baseChance * mult);
}

function maybeDropMiniOrbFromAvatarItem(e, source = "") {
  const baseChance = (state?.avatarItemStats || {}).miniOrbOnHitChance || 0;
  if (!baseChance || !e || e.hp <= 0 || source === "photoelectric_effect" || source === "solar_cell") return;
  const now = state.elapsed || 0;
  if ((e.lastMiniOrbItemDrop || -99) + 1 > now) return;
  if (Math.random() >= applyCombatChance(baseChance, 0.2)) return;
  e.lastMiniOrbItemDrop = now;
  dropMiniScienceOrbs(e, 1, "white_bomb_hair");
}

function maybeConvertEnemyFromBellItem(e, source = "") {
  const baseChance = (state?.avatarItemStats || {}).conditionOnHitChance || 0;
  if (["allied_enemy", "marking_zone"].includes(source)) return;
  maybeConvertEnemyByChance(e, baseChance, source);
}

function maybeConvertEnemyByChance(e, baseChance, source = "") {
  if (!baseChance || !e || e.hp <= 0 || e.boss || e.convertedToAlly || getAlliedEnemyCount() >= 5) return;
  if (Math.random() >= applyCombatChance(baseChance, 0.15)) return;
  convertEnemyToAlly(e);
}

function isPavlovCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "pavlov";
}

function getConditionReflexMaxChance() {
  return 0.08 + ((state?.avatarItemStats || {}).conditionChanceMax || 0);
}

function getAlliedEnemyCount() {
  return (state?.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally.hp > 0).length;
}

function retireOldestAllyWithScienceDrop() {
  const allies = (state.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally.hp > 0);
  const oldest = allies[0];
  if (!oldest) return false;
  const xpValue = Math.max(1, Math.round((oldest.xp || 10) * getEnemyXpMultiplier(oldest)));
  state.gems ||= [];
  state.gems.push({
    x: oldest.x,
    y: oldest.y,
    value: xpValue,
    radius: xpValue >= 50 ? 9 : 6,
    kind: xpValue >= 50 ? "large_xp" : "xp",
    pull: false,
  });
  oldest.hp = 0;
  state.alliedEnemies = (state.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally !== oldest);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: oldest.x, y: oldest.y - 24, text: "연산 종료", color: "#80e9ff", life: 0.6, maxLife: 0.6, size: 11 });
  return true;
}

function recordConditionReflexHit(e, source = "", countOnly = false) {
  if (!e || e.hp <= 0 || e.boss || e.convertedToAlly) return;
  if (!isPavlovCharacter()) return;
  if (["allied_enemy", "marking_zone"].includes(source)) return;
  e.conditionHits = (e.conditionHits || 0) + 1;
  if (countOnly) return;
  if (e.conditionHits < 3 || getAlliedEnemyCount() >= 5) return;
  const zoneBonus = getConditionZoneChanceBonus(e);
  const chance = Math.min(getConditionReflexMaxChance() + zoneBonus, applyCombatChance(0.03 + (e.conditionHits - 3) * 0.01 + zoneBonus, 0.15));
  if (Math.random() >= chance) return;
  convertEnemyToAlly(e);
}

function getConditionZoneChanceBonus(e) {
  let bonus = 0;
  for (const area of state.areas || []) {
    if (area.kind !== "marking_zone" || !area.conditionChanceBonus) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(area.x - e.x, area.y - e.y) <= area.radius + e.radius) {
      bonus = Math.max(bonus, area.conditionChanceBonus);
    }
  }
  return bonus;
}

function convertEnemyToAlly(e, options = {}) {
  if (!e || e.boss || e.convertedToAlly) return;
  if (getAlliedEnemyCount() >= 5 && options.replaceOldestWithScience) {
    retireOldestAllyWithScienceDrop();
  }
  if (options.hacked && options.maxHackedAllies) {
    const hackedAllies = (state.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally.hacked);
    if (hackedAllies.length >= options.maxHackedAllies) {
      const remove = options.replaceOldestWithScience ? hackedAllies[0] : hackedAllies.sort((a, b) => a.hp - b.hp)[0];
      if (options.replaceOldestWithScience && remove) {
        const xpValue = Math.max(1, Math.round((remove.xp || 10) * getEnemyXpMultiplier(remove)));
        state.gems ||= [];
        state.gems.push({ x: remove.x, y: remove.y, value: xpValue, radius: xpValue >= 50 ? 9 : 6, kind: xpValue >= 50 ? "large_xp" : "xp", pull: false });
      }
      state.alliedEnemies = (state.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally !== remove);
    }
  }
  if (getAlliedEnemyCount() >= 5) {
    if (!options.replaceWeakest) return;
    state.alliedEnemies.sort((a, b) => a.hp - b.hp);
    state.alliedEnemies.shift();
  }
  const ally = {
    ...e,
    allied: true,
    hp: e.maxHp * 3,
    maxHp: e.maxHp * 3,
    damage: Math.max(5, e.damage * (options.damageScale ?? 0.75)),
    attackTimer: 0,
    aggroRange: options.aggroRange ?? 132,
    hacked: Boolean(options.hacked),
    killer: "",
  };
  state.alliedEnemies.push(ally);
  e.convertedToAlly = true;
  e.hp = 0;
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 22, text: options.label || "조건반사", color: options.color || "#9df7ff", life: 0.65, maxLife: 0.65, size: 12 });
}

function isFaradayCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "faraday";
}

function updateElectromagneticCharge(dt) {
  if (!isFaradayCharacter()) return;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (!e.emTimer) continue;
    e.emTimer = Math.max(0, e.emTimer - dt);
    if (e.emTimer <= 0) {
      e.emMoves = 0;
      e.emCooldown = 0;
    } else if (e.emCooldown > 0) {
      e.emCooldown = Math.max(0, e.emCooldown - dt);
    }
  }
}

function updateQuantumDebuffs(dt) {
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.quantumDebuff > 0) e.quantumDebuff = Math.max(0, e.quantumDebuff - dt);
  }
}

function applyElectromagneticInduction(e, movementPower, source = "") {
  if (!isFaradayCharacter() || e.hp <= 0 || movementPower <= 0) return;
  e.emTimer = 1.05;
  e.emMoves = (e.emMoves || 0) + 1;
  if (e.emMoves < 2 || (e.emCooldown || 0) > 0) return;
  e.emCooldown = 0.1;
  const shock = Math.min(14, 3.5 + movementPower * 0.18) * state.stats.damage;
  e.hp -= shock;
  e.hitFlash = 0.1;
  state.particles.push({ kind: "electric", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 12 + Math.min(18, movementPower * 0.4), life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
  if (Math.random() < 0.24) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 18, text: "감전", color: "#80e9ff", life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, size: 12 });
  }
  if (source === "magnetic_storm" && Math.random() < 0.18) addScreenShake(0.05);
}

function chainElectricDamage(start, damage, range, jumps, source, heavy = false, includeStart = true) {
  const hit = new Set([start]);
  let current = start;
  if (includeStart) hitEnemy(start, damage, heavy ? 7 : 4, start.x - state.player.x, start.y - state.player.y, source);
  for (let i = 0; i < jumps; i += 1) {
    let next = null;
    let best = Infinity;
    for (const e of state.enemies) {
      if (hit.has(e) || e.hp <= 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(e.x - current.x, e.y - current.y);
      if (d <= range && d < best) {
        next = e;
        best = d;
      }
    }
    if (!next) break;
    hit.add(next);
    state.particles.push({ kind: "electric_arc", x: current.x, y: current.y, x2: next.x, y2: next.y, life: 0.16, maxLife: 0.16 });
    hitEnemy(next, damage * Math.pow(heavy ? 0.82 : 0.72, i + 1), heavy ? 8 : 4, next.x - current.x, next.y - current.y, source);
    current = next;
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function applyPangaeaPassive(center, knock, nx, ny) {
  if (!isWegenerCharacter() || knock <= 0) return;
  if (center.killer === "ammonia") return;
  const safeRadius = state.player.radius + 56;
  if (Math.hypot(center.x - state.player.x, center.y - state.player.y) < safeRadius) return;
  const tectonicBonus = center.tectonicStacks ? 14 : 0;
  const radius = 70 + tectonicBonus + Math.min(30, knock * 0.55);
  const pull = Math.min(19, 5 + knock * 0.26 + tectonicBonus * 0.12);
  let pulled = 0;
  for (const other of state.enemies) {
    if (other === center || other.hp <= 0) continue;
    const dx = center.x - other.x;
    const dy = center.y - other.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > radius + other.radius) continue;
    const resist = other.knockResist ?? 1;
    const nextX = other.x + (dx / d) * pull * resist;
    const nextY = other.y + (dy / d) * pull * resist;
    if (Math.hypot(nextX - state.player.x, nextY - state.player.y) < safeRadius) continue;
    other.x = nextX;
    other.y = nextY;
    pulled += 1;
  }
  if (pulled > 0 && Math.random() < 0.28) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "pangaea", x: center.x - nx * 8, y: center.y - ny * 8, radius, life: 0.22, maxLife: 0.22 });
  }
}

function isTectonicMarkSource(source = "") {
  return source === "fault_shift" || source === "earthquake" || source === "fault_shift_aftershock" || source === "earthquake_aftershock";
}

function isTectonicDetonateSource(source = "") {
  return source === "continental_shift" || source === "volcano" || source === "reaction_methane";
}

function applyTectonicInstability(e, source = "") {
  if (!e || e.hp <= 0) return;
  const add = source === "earthquake" || source === "earthquake_aftershock" ? 2 : 1;
  e.tectonicStacks = Math.min(4, (e.tectonicStacks || 0) + add);
  e.tectonicTimer = Math.max(e.tectonicTimer || 0, source.includes("aftershock") ? 3.2 : 5.2);
  e.hitFlash = Math.max(e.hitFlash || 0, 0.1);
  if ((e.lastTectonicSpark || -99) + 0.28 < (state.elapsed || 0)) {
    e.lastTectonicSpark = state.elapsed || 0;
    state.particles.push({ kind: "crack_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + 9 + e.tectonicStacks * 3, life: 0.16, maxLife: 0.16 });
  }
}

function triggerTectonicRupture(center, source = "") {
  const stacks = center?.tectonicStacks || 0;
  if (!center || stacks <= 0 || (center.tectonicRuptureCooldown || 0) > (state.elapsed || 0)) return;
  center.tectonicStacks = 0;
  center.tectonicTimer = 0;
  center.tectonicRuptureCooldown = (state.elapsed || 0) + 0.25;
  const radius = (source === "volcano" ? 58 : 48) + stacks * 16;
  const damage = (source === "volcano" ? 9 : 7) * stacks * state.stats.damage;
  const pull = source === "volcano" ? 15 : 11;
  state.particles.push({ kind: "tectonic_burst", x: center.x, y: center.y, radius, life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32, stacks });
  if (stacks >= 3) state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: center.x, y: center.y - 24, text: "지층 붕괴", color: "#ffd08a", life: 0.48, maxLife: 0.48, size: 12 });
  for (const other of state.enemies) {
    if (other.hp <= 0) continue;
    const dx = other.x - center.x;
    const dy = other.y - center.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d > radius + other.radius) continue;
    const inward = other === center ? 0 : pull * (other.knockResist ?? 1);
    other.x -= (dx / d) * inward;
    other.y -= (dy / d) * inward;
    const bossScale = other.boss || other.midBoss || other.limitBoss ? 0.55 : 1;
    hitEnemy(other, damage * bossScale, 4 + stacks * 1.5, dx, dy, "tectonic_rupture");
  }
}

function sweepDeadEnemies() {
  const alive = [];
  const pendingSpawns = [];
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0) {
      if (e.convertedToAlly) continue;
      if (e.splitLives > 0) {
        const groupId = e.splitGroupId || createSplitBossGroup(e.splitLives);
        const nextRadiusScale = Math.max(0.5, (e.radius / enemyDefs.mid_boss.radius) * 0.5);
        for (let i = 0; i < 2; i += 1) {
          const angle = i === 0 ? -0.62 : 0.62;
          pendingSpawns.push({
            type: "mid_boss",
            options: {
              x: clamp(e.x + Math.cos(angle) * (e.radius + 18), 24, W - 24),
              y: clamp(e.y + Math.sin(angle) * (e.radius + 18), 32, H - 24),
              name: `${e.name} 분해체`,
              hpScale: Math.max(1, (e.maxHp / enemyDefs.mid_boss.hp) * 0.5),
              speedScale: Math.min(1.28, e.speed / enemyDefs.mid_boss.speed + 0.06),
              damageScale: Math.max(1, e.damage / enemyDefs.mid_boss.damage),
              radiusScale: nextRadiusScale,
              knockResist: e.knockResist,
              color: e.color,
              bossBehavior: "split",
              splitLives: e.splitLives - 1,
              splitGroupId: groupId,
            },
          });
        }
        state.particles.push({ kind: "boss_pulse", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: e.radius + 28, life: 0.42, maxLife: 0.42 });
        state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 36, text: "2개체 분해", color: "#c49cff", life: 0.7, maxLife: 0.7, size: 16 });
        continue;
      }
      const finalSplitReward = resolveSplitBossFinalDeath(e);
      handleEnemyDeathSpecial(e, pendingSpawns);
      state.run.kills += 1;
      if (e.midBoss && finalSplitReward !== false) state.run.midBossKills = (state.run.midBossKills || 0) + 1;
      if ((e.boss || e.midBoss || e.infiniteBoss) && finalSplitReward !== false) state.run.bossKills = (state.run.bossKills || 0) + 1;
      const killer = e.killer || "unknown";
      if (isAreaDamageSource(killer)) state.run.areaWeaponKills = (state.run.areaWeaponKills || 0) + 1;
      state.run.weaponKillCounts[killer] = (state.run.weaponKillCounts[killer] || 0) + 1;
      maybeGainFossilPieceOnKill(e);
      maybeGainElementOnKill(e);
      const xpValue = Math.max(1, Math.round(e.xp * getEnemyXpMultiplier(e)));
      state.gems.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, value: xpValue, radius: xpValue >= 50 ? 9 : 6, kind: xpValue >= 50 ? "large_xp" : "xp", pull: false });
      if (e.killer === "exam_cheatsheet") {
        const bonus = Math.ceil(xpValue * 0.3);
        gainExp(bonus);
        state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 14, text: `+${bonus} 과학력`, life: 0.75, maxLife: 0.75 });
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
        state.particles.push({ kind: "spark", x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: rand(-35, 35), vy: rand(-45, 20), life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45 });
      }
    } else {
      alive.push(e);
    }
  }
  state.enemies = alive;
  for (const spawn of pendingSpawns) addEnemy(spawn.type, spawn.options);
}

function maybeGainFossilPieceOnKill(e) {
  if (!e || e.boss || e.midBoss || e.infiniteBoss || e.limitBoss) return;
  const passiveChance = state.characterId === "mary_anning" ? 0.01 : 0;
  const brushChance = (state.avatarItemStats || {}).fossilPieceOnKillChance || 0;
  const chance = passiveChance + brushChance;
  if (chance <= 0) return;
  if (Math.random() >= applyCombatChance(chance, 0.04)) return;
  state.particles.push({ kind: "fossil_dig", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: 22, life: 0.32, maxLife: 0.32 });
  gainFossilPiece(passiveChance > 0 ? "life_trace" : "fossil_brush");
}

function maybeGainElementOnKill(e) {
  if (!e || e.splitRewardPending || !hasElementSystemActive()) return;
  const hasDecomposition = hasWeapon("chemical_decomposition");
  const hasCarbon = hasWeapon("carbon_bond") || hasWeapon("carbon_nanotube");
  if (hasDecomposition && Math.random() < applyCombatChance(0.01, 0.2)) {
    gainElement(chooseElementNumber(e), "chemical_decomposition_drop", e);
  }
  if (hasCarbon && Math.random() < applyCombatChance(0.02, 0.2)) {
    gainElement(6, "carbon_bond_drop", e);
  }
}

function createSplitBossGroup(splitLives) {
  state.nextSplitBossGroupId = (state.nextSplitBossGroupId || 0) + 1;
  const id = state.nextSplitBossGroupId;
  state.splitBossGroups ||= {};
  state.splitBossGroups[id] = { remaining: Math.pow(2, splitLives) };
  return id;
}

function resolveSplitBossFinalDeath(e) {
  if (!e.splitGroupId || e.splitLives > 0) return null;
  state.splitBossGroups ||= {};
  const group = state.splitBossGroups[e.splitGroupId];
  if (!group) return true;
  group.remaining -= 1;
  if (group.remaining <= 0) {
    delete state.splitBossGroups[e.splitGroupId];
    return true;
  }
  e.suppressReward = true;
  return false;
}

function isAreaDamageSource(source) {
  const areaSources = new Set([
    "flask", "flammable_material", "ammonia", "chem_warfare",
    "oxygen_tank", "gas_mask", "volcano", "radioactive_material",
    "fallout", "combustion", "lava", "burn", "radiation",
    "bell_sound", "hypnosis", "marking_zone",
  ]);
  if (areaSources.has(source)) return true;
  const def = getWeaponDef(source);
  return Boolean(def?.tags?.includes("area") || def?.kind?.includes("장판") || def?.kind?.includes("영역"));
}

function getEnemyXpMultiplier(enemy) {
  let mult = 1;

  if (state.runMode === "ten_hard") {
    mult *= 2.16;
  }

  if (state.runMode === "ten" && state.elapsed >= 300) {
    mult *= 1.15;
  }

  if (state.runMode === "infinite") {
    if (state.elapsed >= 600) mult *= 1.2;
    if (state.elapsed >= 900) mult *= 1.45;
    if (state.elapsed >= 1200) mult *= 1.65;
    if (state.elapsed >= 1500) mult *= 1.8;
  }

  if (enemy.elite) mult *= 2.05;
  if (enemy.midBoss) return mult;
  if (enemy.infiniteBoss) mult *= 1.25;
  else if (enemy.boss) mult *= 2.2;

  return mult;
}

function handleEnemyDeathSpecial(e, pendingSpawns) {
  if (e.type === "graffiti") {
    const pieces = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < pieces; i += 1) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      pendingSpawns.push({ type: "small_shadow", options: { x: clamp(e.x + Math.cos(angle) * 18, 10, W - 10), y: clamp(e.y + Math.sin(angle) * 18, 28, H - 10) } });
    }
  }
  if (e.infectionPandemic || e.killer === "pandemic") {
    spreadInfection(e, "pandemic", 1);
  }
  if (state.weapons.some(w => w.id === "combustion") && e.wasBurning) {
    triggerCombustionReaction(e);
  }
  if (e.fallout) {
    triggerFalloutCorpseExplosion(e);
  }
  if (e.midBoss) {
    if (e.suppressReward) return;
    dropRewardChest(e.x, e.y);
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: e.x, y: e.y - 34, text: "보상 상자 발견", color: "#ffcf4a", life: 1.0, maxLife: 1.0, size: 15 });
    return;
  }
  if (e.infiniteBoss) {
    dropRewardChest(e.x, e.y);
    return;
  }
  if (e.boss && !state.bossDefeated) {
    state.bossDefeated = true;
    dropRewardChest(e.x, e.y);
    state.midnightText = "학교의 괴담이 더 강해졌다.";
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: W / 2, y: H / 2 - 48, text: state.midnightText, color: "#ffcf4a", life: 1.4, maxLife: 1.4, size: 22 });
    addScreenShake(0.25);
    state.player.xp = Math.min(state.player.nextXp - 1, state.player.xp + 140);
    state.player.level += 1;
    if (state.player.level >= 15) state.run.reachedLevel15 = true;
    state.player.nextXp = Math.floor(state.player.nextXp * 1.18 + 10);
    openLevelUp();
  }
}

function triggerFalloutCorpseExplosion(e) {
  const radius = 54;
  const damage = 22 * state.stats.damage;
  state.particles.push({ kind: "radiation_burst", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius, life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28 });
  for (const target of state.enemies) {
    if (target === e || target.hp <= 0) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(target.x - e.x, target.y - e.y) <= radius + target.radius) {
      hitEnemy(target, damage, 4, target.x - e.x, target.y - e.y, "fallout");
      addRadiationExposure(target, 32, "fallout");
    }
  }
}

function triggerCombustionReaction(e) {
  const stats = getCombustionStats(state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "combustion")?.synergyLevel || 1);
  explode(e.x, e.y, stats.explosionRadius, stats.explosionDamage, "combustion", 3);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "boom", x: e.x, y: e.y, radius: stats.explosionRadius, life: 0.24, maxLife: 0.24 });
  if (stats.extraBurnDamage > 0) {
    for (const target of state.enemies) {
      if (target.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(target.x - e.x, target.y - e.y) <= stats.explosionRadius + target.radius) {
        applyBurn(target, stats.extraBurnDamage, stats.extraBurnDuration, "combustion");
      }
    }
  }
  if (stats.chainCount > 0) {
    for (let i = 0; i < stats.chainCount; i += 1) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const x = clamp(e.x + Math.cos(angle) * rand(24, 48), 24, W - 24);
      const y = clamp(e.y + Math.sin(angle) * rand(18, 42), 34, H - 24);
      explode(x, y, stats.chainRadius, stats.explosionDamage * stats.chainDamageScale, "combustion", 1.5);
    }
  }
}

function updateGems(dt) {
  const p = state.player;
  for (const gem of state.gems) {
    if (gem.kind === "mini_xp") {
      gem.life = (gem.life ?? 8) - dt;
      if (gem.life <= 0) {
        gem.dead = true;
        continue;
      }
    }
    const dx = p.x - gem.x;
    const dy = p.y - gem.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    if (d < state.stats.pickup) gem.pull = true;
    if (gem.pull) {
      const speed = 120 + (state.stats.pickup - Math.min(d, state.stats.pickup)) * 5;
      gem.x += (dx / d) * speed * dt;
      gem.y += (dy / d) * speed * dt;
    }
    if (d < p.radius + gem.radius) {
      if (gem.kind === "heal_pea") {
        const before = p.hp;
        const healValue = gem.value * getHealingMultiplier();
        p.hp = Math.min(p.maxHp, p.hp + healValue);
        recordPlayerHealing(p, before);
        if (p.hp > before) {
          state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: p.x, y: p.y - 26, text: `+${Math.round(healValue)}`, color: "#6dff9f", life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55 });
        }
      } else {
        gainExp(gem.value);
        gainSolarCharge(gem.value || 0, gem.kind === "mini_xp");
      }
      gem.dead = true;
    }
  }
  state.gems = state.gems.filter(g => !g.dead);
}

function dropRewardChest(x, y) {
  state.rewardChests.push({
    x,
    y,
    radius: 13,
  });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x, y: y - 24, text: "보상 상자!", color: "#ffcf4a", life: 0.8, maxLife: 0.8, size: 14 });
  return true;
}

function getRewardChestCount() {
  const r = Math.random();
  if (r < 0.5) return 1;
  if (r < 0.8) return 2;
  return 3;
}

function updateRewardChests() {
  if (!state.rewardChests.length || state.mode !== "play") return;
  const p = state.player;
  for (const chest of state.rewardChests) {
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - chest.x, p.y - chest.y);
    if (d <= p.radius + chest.radius + 10) {
      chest.dead = true;
      collectRewardChest(chest);
      break;
    }
  }
  state.rewardChests = state.rewardChests.filter(chest => !chest.dead);
}

function collectRewardChest(chest) {
  playAudioCue("chest");
  state.run.chestsOpened = (state.run.chestsOpened || 0) + 1;
  state.particles.push({ kind: "evolution_flash", x: chest.x, y: chest.y, radius: 78, life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55 });
  startRewardRoll(chest.x, chest.y);
}

function startRewardRoll(x = W / 2, y = H / 2) {
  state.mode = "reward_roll";
  state.rewardRoll = {
    timer: 0,
    duration: 1.2,
    finalCount: getRewardChestCount(),
    displayCount: 1,
    resolved: false,
    x,
    y,
  };
}

function updateRewardRoll(dt) {
  updateEffects(dt);
  const roll = state.rewardRoll;
  if (!roll) {
    state.mode = "play";
    return;
  }
  roll.timer += dt;
  if (!roll.resolved) {
    roll.displayCount = 1 + Math.floor(roll.timer * 16) % 3;
  }
  if (!roll.resolved && roll.timer >= roll.duration) {
    roll.resolved = true;
    roll.displayCount = roll.finalCount;
    if (roll.finalCount >= 3) state.run.tripleChestRewards = (state.run.tripleChestRewards || 0) + 1;
    playAudioCue(roll.finalCount >= 3 ? "evolution" : "chest");
    addScreenShake(roll.finalCount === 3 ? 0.18 : roll.finalCount === 2 ? 0.1 : 0.04);
    const color = roll.finalCount === 3 ? "#ffe67a" : roll.finalCount === 2 ? "#72e4b8" : "#ffcf4a";
    state.particles.push({ kind: "evolution_flash", x: W / 2, y: H / 2, radius: 95 + roll.finalCount * 30, life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45 });
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: W / 2, y: H / 2 - 70, text: `보상 선택 ${roll.finalCount}회${roll.finalCount >= 3 ? "!!" : roll.finalCount === 2 ? "!" : ""}`, color, life: 0.65, maxLife: 0.65, size: 20 });
  }
  if (roll.resolved && roll.timer >= roll.duration + 0.55) {
    finishRewardRoll();
  }
}

function finishRewardRoll() {
  if (!state.rewardRoll) return;
  state.rewardSelectionCount = state.rewardRoll.finalCount;
  state.rewardRoll = null;
  openRewardChoice();
}

function gainExp(value) {
  const p = state.player;
  p.xp += value * (1 + state.stats.expBonus + getElementBonus("science"));
  while (p.xp >= p.nextXp) {
    p.xp -= p.nextXp;
    p.level += 1;
    if (isPasteurCharacter() && p.level === 15) {
      state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: p.x, y: p.y - 34, text: "살균 보호 종료", color: "#ffd88a", life: 0.8, maxLife: 0.8, size: 15 });
      state.particles.push({ kind: "vaccine_shield", x: p.x, y: p.y, radius: 48, life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45 });
    }
    if (p.level >= 15) state.run.reachedLevel15 = true;
    p.nextXp = Math.floor((p.nextXp * 1.22 + 12) * getNextXpRequirementMultiplier());
    openLevelUp();
    break;
  }
}

function gainSolarCharge(value, isMini = false) {
  if (!state.weapons.some(w => w.id === "solar_cell")) return;
  const add = (isMini ? value * 0.55 : value * 0.9) * 0.5;
  state.solarCharge = Math.min(100, (state.solarCharge || 0) + add);
  tryFireSolarBeam();
}

function tryFireSolarBeam() {
  if ((state.solarCharge || 0) < 100 || (state.solarBeamCooldown || 0) > 0) return;
  state.solarCharge = 0;
  state.solarBeamCooldown = 0.2;
  fireSolarBeam();
}

function fireSolarBeam() {
  const target = findStrongestEnemy() || findTarget();
  const dir = target ? Math.atan2(target.y - state.player.y, target.x - state.player.x) : getAimDirection();
  const length = Math.hypot(W, H);
  const damage = 92 * state.stats.damage;
  state.slashes.push({ kind: "laser", x: state.player.x, y: state.player.y, dir, length, width: 24, life: 0.16, maxLife: 0.16, color: "rgba(255, 246, 184, 0.96)" });
  hitLineEnemies(state.player.x, state.player.y, dir, length, 24, damage, 16, "solar_cell");
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {
    const px = state.player.x + Math.cos(dir) * (80 + i * 70);
    const py = state.player.y + Math.sin(dir) * (80 + i * 70);
    explodeEnergy(px, py, 34, 12 * state.stats.damage, "solar_cell");
  }
  state.particles.push({ kind: "energy_burst", x: state.player.x + Math.cos(dir) * 90, y: state.player.y + Math.sin(dir) * 90, radius: 88, life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28 });
  addScreenShake(0.18);
}

function findStrongestEnemy() {
  let best = null;
  let bestHp = -1;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (e.hp <= 0) continue;
    const score = e.hp + (e.boss ? 5000 : e.elite ? 800 : 0);
    if (score > bestHp) {
      best = e;
      bestHp = score;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

function getNextXpRequirementMultiplier() {
  if (state.runMode !== "infinite" || state.elapsed < 600) return 1;
  if (state.elapsed < 900) return 1.06;
  if (state.elapsed < 1200) return 1.1;
  return 1.14;
}

function openLevelUp() {
  // Pause gameplay and show only the research choice cards.
  state.mode = "levelup";
  playAudioCue("levelup");
  state.particles.push({ kind: "levelup_flash", x: W / 2, y: H / 2, radius: 120, life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55 });
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: W / 2, y: H / 2 - 72, text: "Lv Up", color: "#8ee8ff", life: 0.7, maxLife: 0.7, size: 20 });
  renderChoiceCards(buildLevelUpChoices(3), "연구 선택");
  syncHud(true);
}

function openRewardChoice() {
  state.mode = "reward";
  const title = state.rewardSelectionCount > 1 ? `상자 보상 선택 · ${state.rewardSelectionCount}회 남음` : "상자 보상 선택";
  renderChoiceCards(buildLevelUpChoices(3), title);
  syncHud(true);
}

function getChoiceHint(choice) {
  if (choice.type === "evolution") return "진화 완료 선택지";
  if (choice.type === "fusion") return "특수 합성 선택지";
  if (choice.type === "weapon") {
    const def = getWeaponDef(choice.id);
    if (!def?.evolvesWith || !def.evolvesTo) return "";
    const evolvedName = getWeaponName(def.evolvesTo);
    const passiveName = passiveDefs.find(p => p.id === def.evolvesWith)?.name || "연결 패시브";
    const owned = getChoiceOwnedWeapon(choice.id);
    const hasPassive = getPassiveLevel(def.evolvesWith) > 0;
    if (owned && owned.level >= def.max - 1 && hasPassive) return `${evolvedName} 진화 준비`;
    if (owned && owned.level >= def.max - 1) return `${passiveName} 보유 시 ${evolvedName}`;
    if (hasPassive) return `Lv.5 달성 시 ${evolvedName}`;
  }
  if (choice.type === "passive") {
    const linked = state.weapons
      .map(w => getWeaponDef(w.id))
      .filter(def => def?.evolvesWith === choice.id && def.evolvesTo)
      .map(def => getWeaponName(def.evolvesTo))
      .slice(0, 3);
    if (linked.length > 0) return `연결 진화: ${linked.join(", ")}`;
  }
  return "";
}

function getItemGrantedWeaponChoice(id) {
  const stats = state?.avatarItemStats || {};
  if (id === "dog" && stats.itemDogStart && !state.weapons.some(w => w.id === "dog" || w.id === "pavlov_dog")) {
    return { id: "dog", level: 1, cooldown: 0, itemGranted: true };
  }
  if (id === "schrodinger_cat" && stats.itemCatStart && !state.weapons.some(w => w.id === "schrodinger_cat" || w.id === "quantum_cat")) {
    return { id: "schrodinger_cat", level: 1, cooldown: 0, itemGranted: true };
  }
  return null;
}

function getChoiceOwnedWeapon(id) {
  return state.weapons.find(w => w.id === id) || getItemGrantedWeaponChoice(id);
}

function getWeaponChoiceDescription(def, owned) {
  if (!owned) return `신규 획득: ${def.description}`;
  const nextLevel = owned.level + 1;
  return weaponUpgradeDescriptions[def.id]?.[nextLevel] || def.description;
}

function summarizeChoiceDescription(text) {
  const cleaned = String(text || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (!cleaned) return "이번 선택으로 전투 운영이 강화됩니다.";
  const firstSentence = cleaned.split(/(?<=[.!?。]|[.。])\s+|(?<=다\.)\s*/).find(Boolean) || cleaned;
  if (firstSentence.length <= 58) return firstSentence;
  const clipped = firstSentence.slice(0, 58);
  const lastSpace = clipped.lastIndexOf(" ");
  return `${(lastSpace > 24 ? clipped.slice(0, lastSpace) : clipped).trim()}...`;
}

function formatChoiceDamage(value, suffix = "") {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  const scaled = value * (state?.stats?.damage || 1);
  const rounded = scaled >= 100 ? Math.round(scaled).toLocaleString() : scaled >= 10 ? scaled.toFixed(0) : scaled.toFixed(1);
  return `${rounded}${suffix}`;
}

function getWeaponDamageRows(id, level = 1) {
  const rows = [];
  const add = (label, value, suffix = "") => rows.push([label, formatChoiceDamage(value, suffix)]);
  const addRaw = (label, value, suffix = "") => {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) rows.push([label, "-"]);
    else {
      const rounded = value >= 100 ? Math.round(value).toLocaleString() : value >= 10 ? value.toFixed(0) : value.toFixed(1);
      rows.push([label, `${rounded}${suffix}`]);
    }
  };
  if (id === "flask") add("장판 피해", level >= 2 ? 7 : 3.5, "/틱");

  else if (id === "apple") add("낙하 피해", level >= 2 ? 46 : 36);

  else if (id === "pure_cross") add("식물 탄 피해", 24);
  else if (id === "fault_shift") { add("균열 피해", level >= 2 ? 34 : 26); add("지층 불안정", level >= 5 ? 2 : 1, "갈래"); }
  else if (id === "earthquake") { add("균열 피해", 42); add("지층 불안정", 2, "중첩/타격"); }
  else if (id === "continental_shift") { add("충격파 피해", 9); add("지층 붕괴", 7, "x중첩"); }
  else if (id === "volcano") { add("충격파 피해", 18); add("장판 피해", 9, "/틱"); add("지층 붕괴", 9, "x중첩"); }
  else if (id === "current") add("전류 피해", level >= 2 ? 18 : 14);
  else if (id === "lightning") add("번개 피해", 20);
  else if (id === "magnet") add("자기장 피해", 1.45, "/틱");
  else if (id === "magnetic_storm") add("폭풍 피해", 6.5, "/틱");
  else if (id === "germ") add("감염 피해", level >= 4 ? 4.2 : 2.8, "/틱");
  else if (id === "pandemic") add("감염 피해", 5, "/틱");
  else if (id === "vaccine" || id === "immune") add("반응 피해", 8);
  else if (id === "telescope") add("관측선 피해", level >= 4 ? 40 : 30);
  else if (id === "celestial_telescope") add("관측선 피해", 54);
  else if (id === "wave") {
    const attackSize = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
    add("마루 피해", level >= 5 ? 5.5 : level >= 2 ? 4.5 : 3.5);
    addRaw("마루 폭", (level >= 3 ? 112 : 94) * attackSize, "px");
    addRaw("진행 길이", (level >= 4 ? 700 : 600) * attackSize, "px");
