      pixelRect(-8, -8, 16, 6, "#4f3827");
      const ratio = plant.growing ? clamp(plant.grow / plant.growTime, 0, 1) : 0;
      if (ratio > 0.18) pixelRect(-3, -15, 6, 10, "#72c85b");
      if (ratio > 0.55) {
        pixelRect(-8, -18, 7, 5, "#8be36b");
        pixelRect(2, -18, 7, 5, "#8be36b");
      }
      if (plant.growing) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
        ctx.fillRect(-14, 14, 28, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#9be35c";
        ctx.fillRect(-14, 14, 28 * ratio, 4);
      }
    } else {
      pixelRect(-10, -2, 20, 12, plant.evolved ? "#ab7b3d" : "#8a6845");
      pixelRect(-4, -28, 8, 26, plant.evolved ? "#4fad4f" : "#3f9447");
      pixelCircle(-9, -23, plant.evolved ? 9 : 7, plant.evolved ? "#d0f56b" : "#82dd63", "#2f6c34");
      pixelCircle(9, -22, plant.evolved ? 9 : 7, plant.evolved ? "#d0f56b" : "#82dd63", "#2f6c34");
      pixelCircle(0, -34, plant.evolved ? 11 : 8, plant.evolved ? "#f0ff8e" : "#9be35c", "#2f6c34");
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawFallingObjects() {
  const attackSizeMultiplier = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  for (const fall of state.falls) {
    const scale = 1 + (fall.maxLife - fall.life) * 0.35;
    const radius = fall.radius * attackSizeMultiplier;
    const shadow = Math.max(10, radius * 0.42);
    const radioactive = fall.kind === "radioactive_material" || fall.kind === "fallout";
    const warningPulse = radioactive
      ? 0.42 + Math.sin(state.elapsed * (fall.life < 0.5 ? 34 : 18)) * 0.22
      : 0.2 + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 10) * 0.08;
    ctx.strokeStyle = radioactive ? `rgba(255, 86, 72, ${warningPulse})` : `rgba(255, 214, 111, ${warningPulse})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = radioactive ? 3 : 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(fall.x, fall.y, radius + (radioactive ? 4 : 2), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (radioactive && fall.life < 0.5) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 226, 130, 0.38)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(fall.x, fall.y, radius + 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(fall.x, fall.y + 3, shadow, shadow * 0.38, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    const y = fall.y - fall.height;
    if (radioactive) {
      const blink = 0.55 + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 18) * 0.25;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 96, 76, ${blink})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(fall.x, fall.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      pixelCircle(fall.x, y, (fall.kind === "fallout" ? 18 : 15) * scale * attackSizeMultiplier, fall.kind === "fallout" ? "#ff5a4d" : "#d74b4b", "#5e1f2d");
      pixelRect(fall.x - 5, y - 4, 10, 8, "#ffd27a");
    } else {
      pixelCircle(fall.x, y, (fall.kind === "gravity" ? 26 : 15) * scale * attackSizeMultiplier, fall.kind === "gravity" ? "#d84545" : "#e44343", "#6e2020");
      pixelRect(fall.x - 3, y - (fall.kind === "gravity" ? 28 : 17) * scale, 6, 8, "#7c5a2e");
    }
  }
}

function drawAreas() {
  const attackSizeMultiplier = getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  for (const a of state.areas) {
    if (a.kind === "afterglow") {
      const alpha = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife) * 0.32;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(a.x - Math.cos(a.dir) * a.length * 0.5, a.y - Math.sin(a.dir) * a.length * 0.5);
      ctx.rotate(a.dir);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(130, 230, 255, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.fillRect(8, -a.width / 2, a.length, a.width);
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "condition_wave") {
      if ((a.delay || 0) > 0) continue;
      const t = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife);
      const hypnosis = a.source === "hypnosis";
      ctx.strokeStyle = hypnosis ? `rgba(172, 132, 255, ${0.18 + t * 0.34})` : `rgba(109, 231, 255, ${0.16 + t * 0.32})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = hypnosis ? 5 : 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(238, 250, 255, ${t * 0.24})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, Math.max(0, a.radius - a.width * 0.65), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      if (hypnosis) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i += 1) {
          const angle = state.elapsed * 1.8 + i * Math.PI * 2 / 7;
          const r = a.radius + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 5 + i) * 4;
          pixelRect(a.x + Math.cos(angle) * r - 1.5, a.y + Math.sin(angle) * r - 1.5, 3, 3, "#d6b8ff");
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "marking_zone") {
      const t = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 210, 109, ${0.08 + t * 0.06})`;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 210, 109, ${0.25 + t * 0.18})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "element_slow_zone" || a.kind === "element_aura") {
      const t = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife);
      const aura = a.kind === "element_aura";
      const ammonia = a.source === "reaction_ammonia";
      ctx.fillStyle = ammonia
        ? `rgba(216, 247, 155, ${0.1 + t * 0.12})`
        : aura ? `rgba(136, 255, 205, ${0.07 + t * 0.08})` : `rgba(126, 214, 255, ${0.08 + t * 0.08})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius * attackSizeMultiplier, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = ammonia
        ? `rgba(245, 255, 204, ${0.26 + t * 0.28})`
        : aura ? `rgba(180, 255, 220, ${0.2 + t * 0.2})` : `rgba(160, 230, 255, ${0.2 + t * 0.2})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius * attackSizeMultiplier * (0.82 + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 3) * 0.04), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "element_trap") {
      const t = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.rotate(state.elapsed * 0.8 + a.x * 0.01);
      ctx.fillStyle = a.trapType === "glass" ? `rgba(190, 245, 255, ${0.42 + t * 0.28})` : `rgba(255, 245, 210, ${0.36 + t * 0.24})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -a.radius);
      ctx.lineTo(a.radius * 0.7, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(0, a.radius);
      ctx.lineTo(-a.radius * 0.7, 0);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "ancient_sea_wave") {
      const t = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.rotate(Math.sin(a.x * 0.05 + a.y * 0.04) * 0.45);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(65, 210, 198, ${0.045 + t * 0.06})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, a.radius * attackSizeMultiplier, a.radius * 0.5 * attackSizeMultiplier, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(220, 255, 248, ${t * 0.22})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i += 1) {
        const yy = i * a.radius * 0.18 * attackSizeMultiplier;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-a.radius * 0.58 * attackSizeMultiplier, yy);
        for (let s = 0; s <= 5; s += 1) {
          const x = (-0.58 + s * 0.23) * a.radius * attackSizeMultiplier;
          const y = yy + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 4 + s + i) * 3;
          ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "wave" || a.kind === "resonance_wave") {
      const t = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife);
      const age = 1 - t;
      const originX = a.originX ?? (a.x - Math.cos(a.dir) * 40);
      const originY = a.originY ?? (a.y - Math.sin(a.dir) * 40);
      const traveled = Math.hypot(a.x - originX, a.y - originY);
      const reach = Math.min(a.length, Math.max(24, traveled));
      const bands = a.kind === "resonance_wave" ? 5 : 4;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(originX, originY);
      ctx.rotate(a.dir);
      const isResonance = a.kind === "resonance_wave";
      if ((a.reflectionFlash || 0) > 0) {
        const flash = clamp(a.reflectionFlash / 0.42, 0, 1);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.rotate(-a.dir);
        ctx.strokeStyle = isResonance ? `rgba(255, 238, 142, ${flash * 0.72})` : `rgba(214, 184, 255, ${flash * 0.7})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = isResonance ? 5 : 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, a.width * (0.18 + (1 - flash) * 0.34), 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(236, 227, 255, ${flash * 0.5})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        line(-a.width * 0.36, 0, a.width * 0.36, 0);
        line(0, -a.width * 0.36, 0, a.width * 0.36);
        ctx.restore();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = isResonance ? `rgba(166, 124, 255, ${t * 0.1})` : `rgba(166, 124, 255, ${t * 0.075})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      for (let x = 12; x <= reach; x += 20) {
        const grow = Math.min(1, x / Math.max(1, reach));
        const half = a.width * grow * (0.18 + 0.58 * grow);
        ctx.lineTo(x, -half + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 7.5 + x * 0.07) * 5 * grow);
      }
      for (let x = reach; x >= 12; x -= 20) {
        const grow = Math.min(1, x / Math.max(1, reach));
        const half = a.width * grow * (0.18 + 0.58 * grow);
        ctx.lineTo(x, half + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 7.5 + x * 0.07 + Math.PI) * 5 * grow);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      const crestLocalX = Math.max(22, reach - 4);
      const crestHalf = a.width * 0.86;
      const crestPhase = getQuantumWaveCrestPhase(a);
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.lineJoin = "round";
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass += 1) {
        const offset = pass === 0 ? 0 : pass === 1 ? -13 : 13;
        const alpha = pass === 0 ? (isResonance ? 0.9 : 0.78) : 0.24;
        ctx.strokeStyle = pass === 0
          ? (isResonance ? `rgba(255, 238, 142, ${t * alpha})` : `rgba(214, 184, 255, ${t * alpha})`)
          : `rgba(236, 227, 255, ${t * alpha})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = pass === 0 ? (isResonance ? 5 : 4) : 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let y = -crestHalf; y <= crestHalf; y += 9) {
          const px = crestLocalX + offset + getQuantumWaveCrestOffset(a, y, crestPhase, pass);
          if (y === -crestHalf) ctx.moveTo(px, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(px, y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < bands; i += 1) {
        const progress = (i + 1) / bands;
        const x = Math.max(16, reach - progress * 54);
        const grow = Math.min(1, x / Math.max(1, reach));
        const half = a.width * grow * (0.12 + 0.42 * grow);
        const alpha = t * (0.08 + (1 - progress / bands) * 0.12);
        ctx.strokeStyle = isResonance ? `rgba(231, 220, 255, ${alpha})` : `rgba(196, 210, 255, ${alpha})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = isResonance ? 2.4 : 1.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let y = -half; y <= half; y += 12) {
          const wave = Math.sin(state.elapsed * 8 + y * 0.08 + i * 0.9) * (3 + grow * 5);
          const px = x + wave;
          if (y === -half) ctx.moveTo(px, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(px, y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "xray_flash") {
      const t = Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.rotate(a.dir);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(205, 239, 255, ${t * 0.18})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.arc(0, 0, a.range, -a.angle / 2, a.angle / 2);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(235, 250, 255, ${t * 0.66})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (let r = 42; r <= a.range; r += 42) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, r, -a.angle / 2, a.angle / 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${t * 0.28})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let x = 18; x < a.range; x += 24) {
        line(x, -Math.tan(a.angle / 2) * x * 0.72, x, Math.tan(a.angle / 2) * x * 0.72);
      }
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "fault") {
      const warning = !a.triggered;
      const alpha = warning ? 0.42 + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 18) * 0.12 : Math.max(0, a.life / a.maxLife) * 0.72;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.rotate(a.dir);
      ctx.fillStyle = warning ? `rgba(190, 151, 100, ${alpha * 0.36})` : `rgba(255, 216, 130, ${alpha * 0.55})`;
      ctx.fillRect(8, -a.width / 2, a.length, a.width);
      ctx.strokeStyle = warning ? `rgba(255, 234, 171, ${alpha})` : `rgba(255, 242, 196, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = warning ? 2 : 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(8, 0);
      for (let x = 18; x < a.length; x += 18) {
        ctx.lineTo(x, (x % 36 === 0 ? -1 : 1) * a.width * 0.28);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(a.length, 0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "shift_delay") continue;
    if (a.kind === "magnetic_field") {
      const t = a.life / a.maxLife;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.rotate(a.dir);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(90, 210, 255, ${t * 0.12})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -18);
      ctx.lineTo(a.length, -(26 + a.length * a.width));
      ctx.lineTo(a.length, 26 + a.length * a.width);
      ctx.lineTo(0, 18);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(155, 236, 255, ${t * 0.32})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (let y = -14; y <= 14; y += 14) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(14, y);
        ctx.lineTo(a.length, y + Math.sign(y || 1) * a.length * a.width * 0.5);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "magnetic_storm") {
      const t = a.life / a.maxLife;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(128, 233, 255, ${t * 0.58})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(215, 251, 255, ${t * 0.36})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.58, state.elapsed * 8, state.elapsed * 8 + Math.PI * 1.5);
      ctx.stroke();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "quantum_cloud") {
      const alpha = Math.max(0.12, a.life / a.maxLife * 0.28);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(174, 153, 255, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(a.x, a.y, a.radius, a.radius * 0.62, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(224, 214, 255, ${alpha + 0.16})`;
      ctx.stroke();
      continue;
    }
    if (a.kind === "radiation_exposure") {
      const alpha = Math.max(0.08, a.life / a.maxLife * 0.24);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 72, 82, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const radius = a.radius * attackSizeMultiplier;
      ctx.ellipse(a.x, a.y, radius, radius * 0.58, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 154, 124, ${alpha + 0.18})`;
      ctx.stroke();
      continue;
    }
    const alpha = Math.max(0.12, a.life / a.maxLife * 0.34);
    const hotArea = a.kind === "flammable" || a.kind === "combustion" || a.kind === "lava";
    const oxygenArea = a.kind === "oxygen" || a.kind === "gas_mask_field";
    const flaskArea = a.kind === "flask";
    ctx.fillStyle = hotArea
      ? `rgba(255, 112, 51, ${alpha})`
      : oxygenArea
        ? `rgba(204, 243, 255, ${alpha * 0.58})`
        : flaskArea
          ? `rgba(36, 220, 164, ${alpha * 0.92})`
          : `rgba(130, 255, 150, ${alpha * 0.82})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
      const radius = a.radius * attackSizeMultiplier;
      ctx.ellipse(a.x, a.y, radius, radius * 0.62, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = hotArea
      ? "rgba(255,218,128,0.54)"
      : oxygenArea
        ? "rgba(226,252,255,0.76)"
        : flaskArea
          ? "rgba(34,255,194,0.68)"
          : "rgba(158,255,122,0.44)";
    ctx.stroke();
    if (oxygenArea) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.72, 0.38 + alpha);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(235, 254, 255, 0.72)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(a.x, a.y, radius * 0.52, radius * 0.28, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(235, 254, 255, 0.68)";
      pixelRect(a.x - 3, a.y - 11, 6, 22, "rgba(235,254,255,0.68)");
      pixelRect(a.x - 11, a.y - 3, 22, 6, "rgba(235,254,255,0.68)");
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (flaskArea) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.68, 0.34 + alpha);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(217, 255, 230, 0.64)";
      const bubblePhase = Math.floor(state.elapsed * 4) % 3;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
        const angle = i * Math.PI * 2 / 3 + bubblePhase * 0.28;
        const bx = a.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius * 0.33;
        const by = a.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius * 0.18;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(bx, by, 2.2 + i * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(34, 255, 194, 0.5)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(a.x, a.y, radius * 0.72, radius * 0.42, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
}

function drawNotebook() {
  const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "notebook" || w.id === "exam_cheatsheet");
  if (!owned) return;
  const p = state.player;
  const evolved = owned.id === "exam_cheatsheet";
  const count = evolved ? 4 + state.stats.projectiles : 1 + (owned.level >= 2 ? 1 : 0) + (owned.level >= 5 ? 1 : 0) + state.stats.projectiles;
  const orbit = evolved ? 96 : owned.level >= 3 ? 88 : 74;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const a = state.notebookAngle + (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count;
    const x = p.x + Math.cos(a) * orbit;
    const y = p.y + Math.sin(a) * orbit;
    pixelRect(x - 9, y - 11, 18, 22, evolved ? "#ffe89c" : "#f2e7bd");
    pixelRect(x - 5, y - 6, 10, 2, evolved ? "#c27036" : "#6d8ab7");
    pixelRect(x - 5, y, 10, 2, evolved ? "#c27036" : "#6d8ab7");
  }
}

function drawFossilSite() {
  const fossil = state.fossil;
  const sites = fossil?.sites?.length ? fossil.sites : (fossil?.site ? [fossil.site] : []);
  if (!fossil?.active || !sites.length) return;
  for (const site of sites) {
    if (!site?.active) continue;
    const d = dist(state.player, site);
    const reveal = site.revealLevel || 0;
    const boost = fossil.hintBoostTimer > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    const alpha = clamp(0.16 + reveal * 0.12 + boost * 0.22, 0.12, 0.72);
    const pulse = Math.sin((site.pulseTimer || 0) * 7) * 0.12 + 0.88;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.strokeStyle = fossil.targetPieces >= 5 ? "#ffd76a" : fossil.targetPieces === 4 ? "#69e7d3" : "#e8d2a2";
    ctx.fillStyle = fossil.targetPieces >= 5 ? "rgba(255, 215, 106, 0.12)" : "rgba(232, 210, 162, 0.1)";
    ctx.lineWidth = reveal >= 2 ? 2 : 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(site.x, site.y, 22 * pulse, 11 * pulse, -0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    pixelRect(site.x - 9, site.y - 2, 18, 3, `rgba(232,210,162,${Math.min(0.8, alpha + 0.12)})`);
    pixelRect(site.x - 2, site.y - 7, 4, 13, `rgba(232,210,162,${Math.min(0.8, alpha + 0.12)})`);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(232, 210, 162, ${alpha * 0.56})`;
    line(site.x - 20, site.y + 11, site.x + 17, site.y + 8);
    line(site.x - 15, site.y - 10, site.x + 19, site.y - 13);
    if (reveal >= 2 || d < 140 || boost) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 236, 181, ${alpha * 0.68})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(site.x, site.y, reveal >= 3 ? 42 : 32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawFossilAllies() {
  for (const ally of state.fossil?.allies || []) {
    const t = clamp(ally.life / ally.maxLife, 0, 1);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, 0.45 + t * 0.55);
    ctx.translate(Math.round(ally.x), Math.round(ally.y));
    if (ally.vx || ally.vy) ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(ally.vy || 0, ally.vx || 0));
    const scale = ally.visualScale || 1;
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);
    const drawRadius = ally.radius / scale;
    if (ally.kind === "ginkgo") {
      ctx.rotate(0);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(165, 231, 128, ${0.09 + t * 0.08})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, drawRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      pixelRect(-7, -20, 14, 40, "#8a6845");
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {
        const a = i * Math.PI * 2 / 8;
        pixelCircle(Math.cos(a) * 22, -20 + Math.sin(a) * 18, 13, "#d4c86a", "#768f48");
      }
    } else if (ally.kind === "triceratops") {
      pixelCircle(-7, 0, 25, "#9a9fa8", "#454a52");
      pixelRect(-23, -13, 31, 26, "#828892");
      pixelRect(2, -19, 22, 38, "#b8bec8");
      pixelRect(20, -6, 19, 12, "#d8dde6");
      pixelRect(22, -21, 7, 18, "#f5f6ef");
      pixelRect(22, 3, 7, 18, "#f5f6ef");
      pixelRect(32, -4, 17, 8, "#fffaf0");
      pixelRect(-16, 13, 8, 10, "#555b63");
      pixelRect(4, 13, 8, 10, "#555b63");
    } else if (ally.kind === "tyrannosaurus") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4f9a58";
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#254b2c";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-4, 2, 20, 32, -0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      pixelRect(-20, -21, 24, 35, "#3f7f45", "#254b2c");
      pixelRect(7, -35, 31, 24, "#74b96f", "#254b2c");
      pixelRect(26, -24, 26, 13, "#d9f0b0", "#254b2c");
      pixelRect(41, -30, 5, 4, "#102014");
      pixelRect(31, -10, 5, 9, "#fff4ce");
      pixelRect(42, -10, 5, 9, "#fff4ce");
      pixelRect(32, -3, 16, 5, "#bfe69d");
      pixelRect(-12, 23, 10, 25, "#2d5d34", "#18351d");
      pixelRect(6, 21, 11, 27, "#2d5d34", "#18351d");
      pixelRect(-17, 44, 18, 6, "#254b2c");
      pixelRect(5, 44, 20, 6, "#254b2c");
      pixelRect(4, -2, 15, 5, "#2d5d34", "#18351d");
      pixelRect(12, 2, 10, 4, "#2d5d34", "#18351d");
      pixelRect(-45, 9, 30, 8, "#356f3d", "#1b3f23");
    } else if (ally.kind === "brachiosaurus") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#a97b4f";
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#533722";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-8, 9, 43, 20, 0.03, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      pixelRect(-47, 2, 76, 23, "#a97b4f", "#533722");
      pixelRect(14, -38, 12, 56, "#b98959", "#604026");
      pixelRect(20, -48, 12, 23, "#c99a66", "#604026");
      pixelCircle(31, -51, 12, "#c99a66", "#604026");
      pixelRect(37, -53, 16, 7, "#d8b07a", "#604026");
      pixelRect(-63, 9, 26, 8, "#7b5635", "#533722");
      pixelRect(-25, 19, 8, 18, "#68452c");
      pixelRect(8, 19, 8, 18, "#68452c");
      pixelRect(23, 17, 8, 19, "#68452c");
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(186,142,87,0.42)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-8, 9, 44, 21, 0.03, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (ally.kind === "ichthyosaur") {
      pixelRect(-22, -7, 34, 14, "#9adbd4");
      pixelRect(9, -10, 18, 20, "#c9e8df");
      pixelRect(-31, -12, 10, 9, "#49b7aa");
      pixelRect(-31, 3, 10, 9, "#49b7aa");
      pixelRect(-2, -17, 9, 10, "#6cc9c0");
      pixelRect(-2, 7, 9, 10, "#6cc9c0");
      pixelRect(19, -3, 4, 3, "#1a2d34");
    } else if (ally.kind === "pterosaur") {
      pixelRect(-7, -5, 20, 10, "#d8c49a");
      pixelRect(8, -8, 15, 12, "#efe1b8");
      pixelRect(-36, -2, 30, 5, "#bda77c");
      pixelRect(13, -2, 34, 5, "#bda77c");
      pixelRect(-35, 3, 18, 4, "#8d6c45");
      pixelRect(25, 3, 20, 4, "#8d6c45");
      pixelRect(18, -4, 3, 3, "#30251a");
    } else if (ally.kind === "dragonfly") {
      pixelRect(-24, -3, 48, 6, "#69e7d3");
      pixelRect(18, -5, 10, 10, "#c9fff4");
      pixelRect(-9, -21, 18, 16, "rgba(170,240,255,0.72)");
      pixelRect(-9, 5, 18, 16, "rgba(170,240,255,0.72)");
      pixelRect(3, -18, 21, 13, "rgba(170,240,255,0.5)");
      pixelRect(3, 5, 21, 13, "rgba(170,240,255,0.5)");
      pixelRect(23, -3, 2, 2, "#263943");
    } else if (ally.kind === "ammonite_swarm") {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
        const a = i * Math.PI * 2 / 3 + state.elapsed * 2.2;
        const x = Math.cos(a) * 16;
        const y = Math.sin(a) * 12;
        pixelCircle(x, y, 9, "#d8c49a", "#8d6c45");
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(95, 67, 39, 0.75)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 1.65);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(232,210,162,0.48)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, drawRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (ally.kind === "trilobite_swarm") {
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {
        const x = -20 + i * 13;
        const y = (i % 2) * 8 - 4;
        pixelRect(x - 6, y - 5, 12, 10, "#c6ad79");
        pixelRect(x - 4, y - 9, 8, 4, "#e0d09a");
        pixelRect(x - 8, y + 5, 16, 3, "#8d6c45");
        pixelRect(x - 9, y - 2, 3, 3, "#6d5638");
        pixelRect(x + 6, y - 2, 3, 3, "#6d5638");
      }
    } else {
      pixelCircle(0, 0, ally.radius * 0.55, "#d8c49a", "#8d6c45");
      pixelRect(-ally.radius * 0.6, -4, ally.radius * 1.2, 8, "#c0a77d");
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawOrbitSystem() {
  const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === "planet" || w.id === "solar_system");
  if (!owned) return;
  const planets = getOrbitPlanets(owned);
  const orbits = [...new Set(planets.map(p => p.orbitRadius))];
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = owned.id === "solar_system" ? "rgba(185, 220, 255, 0.18)" : "rgba(185, 220, 255, 0.12)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (const orbit of orbits) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(state.player.x, state.player.y, orbit, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (const planet of planets) {
    pixelCircle(planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius, planet.color, "#243142");
    pixelRect(planet.x - 2, planet.y - planet.radius * 0.45, 4, 3, "#f5f3d2");
    if (planet.jupiter) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 232, 178, 0.72)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      line(planet.x - planet.radius * 0.72, planet.y - 4, planet.x + planet.radius * 0.72, planet.y - 3);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 196, 126, 0.64)";
      line(planet.x - planet.radius * 0.68, planet.y + 3, planet.x + planet.radius * 0.68, planet.y + 2);
    }
    if (planet.ring) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 230, 156, 0.72)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius + 8, 4, -0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawElementOrbitals() {
  const orbitals = state.elements?.activeOrbitals || [];
  if (!orbitals.length) return;
  const p = state.player;
  ctx.save();
  const orbitRadii = [...new Set(orbitals.map(orbital => Math.round(orbital.radius)))];
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (const radius of orbitRadii) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (const orbital of orbitals) {
    const t = clamp(orbital.life / orbital.maxLife, 0, 1);
    const x = p.x + Math.cos(orbital.angle) * orbital.radius;
    const y = p.y + Math.sin(orbital.angle) * orbital.radius;
    const size = orbital.symbol.length >= 2 ? 10 : 11;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, 0.45 + t * 0.55);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)";
    ctx.strokeStyle = orbital.color || "#8fe7ff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#10202a";
    ctx.font = `900 ${size}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(orbital.symbol, x, y + 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = orbital.color || "#8fe7ff";
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.8, 0.22 + t * 0.4);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSlashes() {
  for (const s of state.slashes) {
    const t = s.life / s.maxLife;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
    ctx.rotate(s.dir);
    ctx.globalAlpha = t;
    if (s.kind === "carbon_bond") {
      if (s.outlineColor) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.outlineColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = s.width + 6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(8, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(s.length, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color || "rgba(35, 42, 48, 0.92)";
      ctx.lineWidth = s.width;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(8, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(s.length, 0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.outlineColor ? "rgba(255, 238, 166, 0.8)" : "rgba(220, 235, 240, 0.58)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (let x = 18; x < s.length; x += 18) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x - 5, -5);
        ctx.lineTo(x + 5, 5);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    } else if (s.kind === "line" || s.kind === "laser" || s.kind === "flame") {
      ctx.fillStyle = s.color || "rgba(255, 219, 103, 0.72)";
      ctx.fillRect(8, -s.width / 2, s.length, s.width);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28)";
      ctx.fillRect(18, -2, s.length - 16, 4);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 219, 103, 0.72)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(8, -10);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s.range, -32, s.range, 0);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s.range, 32, 8, 10);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    const t = p.life / p.maxLife;
    if (p.kind === "levelup_flash" || p.kind === "evolution_flash") {
      const gold = p.kind === "evolution_flash";
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = gold ? `rgba(255, 230, 112, ${t * 0.82})` : `rgba(142, 232, 255, ${t * 0.72})`;
      ctx.fillStyle = gold ? `rgba(255, 210, 90, ${t * 0.1})` : `rgba(142, 232, 255, ${t * 0.08})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = gold ? 5 : 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius * (1.15 - t * 0.25), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = gold ? `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${t * 0.42})` : `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${t * 0.34})`;
      line(p.x - p.radius * 0.5, p.y, p.x + p.radius * 0.5, p.y);
      line(p.x, p.y - p.radius * 0.5, p.x, p.y + p.radius * 0.5);
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.kind === "boss_pulse") {
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 72, 88, ${t * 0.76})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius * (1.25 - t * 0.2), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 42, 58, ${t * 0.12})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius * 0.72, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.kind === "hit_ring") {
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.evolved ? `rgba(255, 226, 106, ${t * 0.78})` : p.boss ? `rgba(255, 210, 128, ${t * 0.7})` : `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${t * 0.58})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = p.evolved || p.boss ? 3 : 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius * (1.35 - t * 0.28), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.kind === "aura") {
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(150, 255, 190, ${t * 0.42})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.kind === "veil") {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160, 255, 190, ${t * 0.18})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(204, 255, 215, ${t * 0.46})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.kind === "chem_warfare_aura") {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(207, 176, 126, ${0.12 * t})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    } else if (p.kind === "gas_mask" || p.kind === "air") {

      const mx = (p.x + p.x2) * 0.5 + rand(-jitter, jitter);
      const my = (p.y + p.y2) * 0.5 + rand(-jitter, jitter);
      ctx.lineTo(mx, my);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x2, p.y2);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = pause ? `rgba(180, 220, 255, ${t * 0.76})` : phase ? `rgba(201, 164, 255, ${t * 0.72})` : `rgba(109, 255, 208, ${t * 0.82})`;
      ctx.fillStyle = pause ? `rgba(70, 132, 255, ${t * 0.08})` : phase ? `rgba(201, 164, 255, ${t * 0.08})` : `rgba(109, 255, 208, ${t * 0.08})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = pause ? 4 : 3;
      const pulseRadius = (p.radius || 24) * (1.04 - t * 0.22);
      if (p.kind === "ada_debug_burst") {
        const s = pulseRadius * 2;
        ctx.fillRect(p.x - s / 2, p.y - s / 2, s, s);
        ctx.strokeRect(p.x - s / 2, p.y - s / 2, s, s);
        const inner = s * 0.68;
        ctx.globalAlpha *= 0.72;
        ctx.strokeRect(p.x - inner / 2, p.y - inner / 2, inner, inner);
        ctx.globalAlpha /= 0.72;
      } else {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, pulseRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      if (p.kind === "ada_code_cross") {
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        line(p.x - (p.radius || 24) * 0.36, p.y, p.x + (p.radius || 24) * 0.36, p.y);
        line(p.x, p.y - (p.radius || 24) * 0.36, p.x, p.y + (p.radius || 24) * 0.36);
      } else if (p.kind === "ada_debug_burst") {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(109, 255, 208, ${t})`;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {
          const a = i * Math.PI * 2 / 8 + state.elapsed;
          pixelRect(p.x + Math.cos(a) * (p.radius || 24) * 0.45 - 2, p.y + Math.sin(a) * (p.radius || 24) * 0.45 - 2, 4, 4, ctx.fillStyle);
        }
      }
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.kind === "ada_code_arc") {
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(109, 255, 208, ${t * 0.9})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      const mx = (p.x + p.x2) * 0.5 + rand(-5, 5);
      const my = (p.y + p.y2) * 0.5 + rand(-5, 5);
      ctx.lineTo(mx, my);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x2, p.y2);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.kind === "chemical_formula") {
      drawChemicalFormulaParticle(p, t);
    } else if (p.kind === "text") {
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color ? p.color.replace(")", `, ${t})`).replace("rgb", "rgba") : `rgba(128, 233, 255, ${t})`;
      ctx.font = `bold ${p.size || 13}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(cleanDisplayText(p.text), p.x, p.y - (1 - t) * 18);
    } else {
      pixelRect(p.x, p.y, 3, 3, "#ffdf77");
    }
  }
}

function drawChemicalFormulaParticle(p, t) {
  const alpha = clamp(t, 0, 1);
  const mainSize = 25;
  const subSize = Math.round(mainSize * 0.5);
  const formula = String(p.formula || "");
  const parts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < formula.length; i += 1) {
    const ch = formula[i];
    if (/\d/.test(ch)) {
      parts.push({ text: ch, sub: true });
    } else {
      const next = formula[i + 1];
      if (next && /[a-z]/.test(next)) {
        parts.push({ text: ch + next, sub: false });
        i += 1;
      } else {
        parts.push({ text: ch, sub: false });
      }
    }
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  let width = 0;
  for (const part of parts) {
    ctx.font = `900 ${part.sub ? subSize : mainSize}px sans-serif`;
    width += ctx.measureText(part.text).width;
  }
  const y = p.y - (1 - t) * 18;
  let x = p.x - width / 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.46)";
  ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y - mainSize - 8, width + 20, mainSize + 26);
  ctx.strokeStyle = `${hexToRgba(p.color || "#8fe7ff", 0.58 * alpha)}`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x - 10, y - mainSize - 8, width + 20, mainSize + 26);
  for (const part of parts) {
    ctx.font = `900 ${part.sub ? subSize : mainSize}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillStyle = part.sub ? hexToRgba(p.color || "#8fe7ff", 0.92 * alpha) : `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
    const yy = part.sub ? y + subSize * 0.32 : y;
    ctx.fillText(part.text, x, yy);
    x += ctx.measureText(part.text).width;
  }
  if (p.label) {
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "900 12px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba(p.color || "#8fe7ff", 0.9 * alpha);
    ctx.fillText(cleanDisplayText(p.label), p.x, y + 18);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function hexToRgba(color, alpha) {
  if (typeof color !== "string") return `rgba(142, 231, 255, ${alpha})`;
  if (color.startsWith("rgba")) return color.replace(/rgba\(([^)]+),\s*[\d.]+\)/, `rgba($1, ${alpha})`);
  if (color.startsWith("rgb(")) return color.replace("rgb(", "rgba(").replace(")", `, ${alpha})`);
  const hex = color.replace("#", "");
  const full = hex.length === 3 ? hex.split("").map(ch => ch + ch).join("") : hex;
  const n = Number.parseInt(full, 16);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return `rgba(142, 231, 255, ${alpha})`;
  return `rgba(${(n >> 16) & 255}, ${(n >> 8) & 255}, ${n & 255}, ${alpha})`;
}

function cleanDisplayText(text) {
  if (text == null) return "";
  return String(text)
    .replace(/\u5A9B\uBA2F\uC7FE/g, "감전")
    .replace(/\uFFFD/g, "");
}

function findTarget() {
  return findTargetFrom(state.player.x, state.player.y);
}

function findTargetFrom(x, y) {
  if (state.enemies.length === 0) return null;
  let best = null;
  let bestD = Infinity;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    if (isElementScanPhasedEnemy(e)) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.y - y);
    if (d < bestD) {
      best = e;
      bestD = d;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

function getEnemyAggroTarget(e) {
  let best = getQuantumCatAggro(e);
  let bestD = best ? Math.hypot(e.x - best.x, e.y - best.y) : Infinity;
  const candidates = [
    ...(state.pavlovDogs || []).filter(dog => dog.hp > 0),
    ...(state.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally.hp > 0),
    ...(state.fossil?.allies || []).filter(ally => ally.hp > 0),
  ];
  for (const target of candidates) {
    const d = Math.hypot(e.x - target.x, e.y - target.y);
    const range = target.aggroRange || (target.allied ? 118 : 92);
    if (d <= range && d < bestD) {
      best = target;
      bestD = d;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

function getAimDirection() {
  const target = findTarget();
  if (target) return Math.atan2(target.y - state.player.y, target.x - state.player.x);
  return Math.atan2(state.player.facingY, state.player.facingX);
}

function isNewtonCharacter() {
  return state?.characterId === "newton";
}

function isPlayerMoving() {
  return Boolean(state?.player?.moving);
}

function getMovementDirection() {
  const p = state.player;
  const speed = Math.hypot(p.velocityX, p.velocityY);
  if (speed > 18) return { x: p.velocityX / speed, y: p.velocityY / speed };
  return { x: p.moveDirX, y: p.moveDirY };
}

function calculateDirectionalBonus(attackDir) {
  if (!isNewtonCharacter()) return { multiplier: 1, label: "", color: "#ffffff" };
  const p = state.player;
  let multiplier = 1;
  let label = "";
  let color = "#ffffff";
  if (isPlayerMoving()) multiplier *= 1.1;
  if (p.stillTime >= 1) multiplier *= 0.9;

  if (Number.isFinite(attackDir)) {
    const move = getMovementDirection();
    const dot = Math.cos(attackDir) * move.x + Math.sin(attackDir) * move.y;
    if (dot > 0.65) {
      multiplier *= 1.2;
      label = "F = ma!";
      color = "#9ef7c5";
    } else if (dot < -0.65) {
      multiplier *= 0.7;
      label = "역가속";
      color = "#ff7777";
    }
  }
  return { multiplier, label, color };
}

function applyNewtonPassive(baseDamage, attackDir = null, x = state.player.x, y = state.player.y) {
  const bonus = calculateDirectionalBonus(attackDir);
  if (bonus.label && Math.random() < 0.35) {
    state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x, y: y - 18, text: bonus.label, color: bonus.color, life: 0.55, maxLife: 0.55 });
  }
  return baseDamage * bonus.multiplier;
}

function hitLineEnemies(x, y, dir, length, width, damage, knock, source) {
  const ux = Math.cos(dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(dir);
  const effectiveWidth = width * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - x;
    const dy = e.y - y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    if (forward < 0 || forward > length + e.radius) continue;
    const side = Math.abs(dx * uy - dy * ux);
    if (side <= effectiveWidth + e.radius) {
      hitEnemy(e, damage, knock, ux, uy, source);
    }
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function hitLineEnemiesLimited(x, y, dir, length, width, damage, knock, source, pierce = 999) {
  const ux = Math.cos(dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(dir);
  const effectiveWidth = width * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  const hits = [];
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - x;
    const dy = e.y - y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    if (forward < 0 || forward > length + e.radius) continue;
    const side = Math.abs(dx * uy - dy * ux);
    if (side <= effectiveWidth + e.radius) hits.push({ e, forward });
  }
  hits.sort((a, b) => a.forward - b.forward);
  for (const hit of hits.slice(0, pierce)) {
    hitEnemy(hit.e, damage, knock, ux, uy, source);
  }
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function hitTelescopeEnemies(area) {
  const ux = Math.cos(area.dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(area.dir);
  const effectiveWidth = area.width * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  const hits = [];
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - area.x;
    const dy = e.y - area.y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    if (forward < 0 || forward > area.length + e.radius) continue;
    const side = Math.abs(dx * uy - dy * ux);
    if (side <= effectiveWidth + e.radius) hits.push({ e, forward });
  }
  hits.sort((a, b) => a.forward - b.forward);
  const selected = hits.slice(0, area.pierce || 999);
  for (const hit of selected) {
    hitEnemy(hit.e, area.damage, 8, ux, uy, area.source);
    applyTelescopeMagnify(hit.e, area.magnifyScale, area.source === "celestial_telescope" ? 4.8 : 3.6);
    const focusX = area.x + ux * hit.forward;
    const focusY = area.y + uy * hit.forward;
    magnifyAlliesNear(focusX, focusY, area.magnifyRadius, Math.max(1.5, area.magnifyScale * 0.92), area.source === "celestial_telescope" ? 4.2 : 3.0);
    for (const other of state.enemies) {
      if (other.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (other === hit.e) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(other.x - focusX, other.y - focusY) <= area.magnifyRadius + other.radius) {
        applyTelescopeMagnify(other, Math.max(1.5, area.magnifyScale * 0.92), area.source === "celestial_telescope" ? 4.2 : 3.0);
      }
    }
    state.particles.push({ kind: "scope", x: focusX, y: focusY, radius: area.magnifyRadius, life: 0.34, maxLife: 0.34 });
  }
  magnifyAlliesOnTelescopeLine(area, effectiveWidth, area.magnifyScale, area.source === "celestial_telescope" ? 4.8 : 3.6);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
}

function magnifyAlliesOnTelescopeLine(area, effectiveWidth, scale, duration) {
  const ux = Math.cos(area.dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(area.dir);
  for (const actor of getTelescopeMagnifiableAllies()) {
    const dx = actor.x - area.x;
    const dy = actor.y - area.y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    if (forward < 0 || forward > area.length + (actor.radius || 0)) continue;
    const side = Math.abs(dx * uy - dy * ux);
    if (side <= effectiveWidth + (actor.radius || 0)) {
      applyTelescopeAllyMagnify(actor, scale, duration);
    }
  }
}

function magnifyAlliesNear(x, y, radius, scale, duration) {
  for (const actor of getTelescopeMagnifiableAllies()) {
    if (Math.hypot(actor.x - x, actor.y - y) <= radius + (actor.radius || 0)) {
      applyTelescopeAllyMagnify(actor, scale, duration);
    }
  }
}

function getTelescopeMagnifiableAllies() {
  return [
    ...(state.quantumCats || []),
    ...(state.pavlovDogs || []).filter(dog => dog.hp > 0),
    ...(state.alliedEnemies || []).filter(ally => ally.hp > 0),
    ...(state.fossil?.allies || []).filter(ally => ally.hp > 0),
    ...(state.plants || []),
    ...(state.ada?.robots || []),
  ];
}

function hitFirstLineEnemy(x, y, dir, length, width, damage, knock, source) {
  const ux = Math.cos(dir);
  const uy = Math.sin(dir);
  const effectiveWidth = width * getAttackSizeMultiplier();
  let target = null;
  let bestForward = Infinity;
  for (const e of state.enemies) {
    const dx = e.x - x;
    const dy = e.y - y;
    const forward = dx * ux + dy * uy;
    if (forward < 0 || forward > length + e.radius) continue;
    const side = Math.abs(dx * uy - dy * ux);
    if (side <= effectiveWidth + e.radius && forward < bestForward) {
      target = e;
      bestForward = forward;
    }
  }
  if (!target) return null;
  hitEnemy(target, damage, knock, ux, uy, source);
  sweepDeadEnemies();
  return {
    enemy: target,
    x: x + ux * Math.max(10, bestForward),
    y: y + uy * Math.max(10, bestForward),
  };
}

// Utility helpers are loaded from js/core/utils.js.

function pixelRect(x, y, w, h, color, stroke) {
  x = Math.round(x);
  y = Math.round(y);
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  if (stroke) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
  }
}

function pixelCircle(x, y, r, color, stroke) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  if (stroke) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function pixelDiamond(x, y, r, color, stroke) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x - r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function codeToAdaDir(code) {
  if (code === "ArrowUp" || code === "KeyW") return "up";
  if (code === "ArrowDown" || code === "KeyS") return "down";
  if (code === "ArrowLeft" || code === "KeyA") return "left";
  if (code === "ArrowRight" || code === "KeyD") return "right";
  return null;
}

function getAdaDirectionFromVector(x, y) {
  if (Math.hypot(x, y) < 0.48) return null;
  if (Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y)) return x < 0 ? "left" : "right";
  return y < 0 ? "up" : "down";
}

window.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
  if (["KeyW", "KeyA", "KeyS", "KeyD", "ArrowUp", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowDown", "ArrowRight"].includes(event.code)) {
    const adaDir = codeToAdaDir(event.code);
    if (adaDir && !event.repeat) handleAdaDirectionInput(adaDir);
    keys.add(event.code);
    event.preventDefault();
  }
  if (event.code === "Space" && state?.mode === "play") {
    setPauseMode(true);
  } else if (event.code === "Space" && state?.mode === "paused") {
    setPauseMode(false);
  }
});

window.addEventListener("keyup", event => keys.delete(event.code));

let deferredInstallPrompt = null;

function updateInstallAppButton() {

  deferredInstallPrompt = null;

async function lockLandscapeFullscreen() {
  if (!screen.orientation?.lock) return;
  try {
    await screen.orientation.lock("landscape");
  } catch {
    // Some mobile browsers do not allow orientation lock from fullscreen.
  }
}

function unlockScreenOrientation() {
  if (!screen.orientation?.unlock) return;
  try {
    screen.orientation.unlock();
  } catch {
    // Ignore browsers that do not support orientation unlock.
  }
}

function getActiveFullscreenElement() {
  return document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement || document.msFullscreenElement;
}

ui.fullscreenButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try {
    if (!getActiveFullscreenElement()) {
      const target = ui.fullscreenButton.closest(".app") || ui.fullscreenButton.closest(".game-shell") || document.documentElement;
      const request = target.requestFullscreen || target.webkitRequestFullscreen || target.msRequestFullscreen;
      if (!request) return;
      await request.call(target);
      await lockLandscapeFullscreen();
      ui.fullscreenButton.textContent = "▣";
    } else {
      unlockScreenOrientation();
      const exit = document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen || document.msExitFullscreen;
      if (exit) await exit.call(document);
      ui.fullscreenButton.textContent = "⛶";
    }
  } catch {
    // Some mobile browsers restrict fullscreen from local files.
  }
});

document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", () => {
  const active = Boolean(getActiveFullscreenElement());
  ui.fullscreenButton.textContent = active ? "▣" : "⛶";
  if (active) lockLandscapeFullscreen();
  else unlockScreenOrientation();
});

document.addEventListener("webkitfullscreenchange", () => {
  const active = Boolean(getActiveFullscreenElement());
  ui.fullscreenButton.textContent = active ? "▣" : "⛶";
  if (active) lockLandscapeFullscreen();
  else unlockScreenOrientation();
});

ui.joystick.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
  touchMove.active = true;
  touchMove.id = event.pointerId;
  ui.joystick.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  updateStick(event);
});

ui.joystick.addEventListener("pointermove", event => {
  if (touchMove.active && event.pointerId === touchMove.id) updateStick(event);
});

ui.joystick.addEventListener("pointerup", resetStick);
ui.joystick.addEventListener("pointercancel", resetStick);

function updateStick(event) {
  const rectBox = ui.joystick.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = rectBox.left + rectBox.width / 2;
  const cy = rectBox.top + rectBox.height / 2;
  const max = rectBox.width * 0.34;
  let dx = event.clientX - cx;
  let dy = event.clientY - cy;
  const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  if (len > max) {
    dx = (dx / len) * max;
    dy = (dy / len) * max;
  }
  touchMove.x = dx / max;
  touchMove.y = dy / max;
  ui.stick.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${dx}px), calc(-50% + ${dy}px))`;
  const adaDir = getAdaDirectionFromVector(touchMove.x, touchMove.y);
  if (adaDir && adaDir !== touchMove.lastCommandDir) handleAdaDirectionInput(adaDir);
  touchMove.lastCommandDir = adaDir;
}

function resetStick(event) {
  if (event && event.pointerId !== touchMove.id) return;
  touchMove.active = false;
  touchMove.id = null;
  touchMove.x = 0;
  touchMove.y = 0;
  touchMove.lastCommandDir = null;
  ui.stick.style.transform = "translate(-50%, -50%)";
}

  } catch {
    return "";
  }

function getSupabaseLeaderboardConfig() {
  try {

      url: String(window.SCHOOL_SURVIVORS_SUPABASE_URL || "").trim().replace(/\/+$/, ""),
      anonKey: String(window.SCHOOL_SURVIVORS_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || "").trim(),
      table: String(window.SCHOOL_SURVIVORS_SUPABASE_TABLE || "leaderboard_scores").trim() || "leaderboard_scores",
    };

function hasSupabaseLeaderboard() {
  const config = getSupabaseLeaderboardConfig();
  return /^https:\/\/.+\.supabase\.co$/i.test(config.url) && config.anonKey.length > 20;
}

function hasRemoteLeaderboard() {
  return hasSupabaseLeaderboard() || /^https?:\/\//i.test(getLeaderboardApiUrl());
}

function getLeaderboardPlayerKey() {
  const key = "school_survivors_leaderboard_player_key";
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (saved) return saved;
    const random = crypto?.getRandomValues
      ? Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(3))).map(n => n.toString(36)).join("")
      : `${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
    const playerKey = `P-${random.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "").slice(0, 18)}`;
    localStorage.setItem(key, playerKey);
    return playerKey;
  } catch {
    return "P-LOCAL";
  }
}

function getLeaderboardSeasonStart(date = new Date()) {
  const start = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate());
  start.setDate(start.getDate() - start.getDay());
  start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return start;
}

function getLeaderboardSeasonKey(date = new Date()) {
  const start = getLeaderboardSeasonStart(date);
  const year = start.getFullYear();
  const month = String(start.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(start.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function isCurrentLeaderboardSeason(entry) {
  const seasonKey = getLeaderboardSeasonKey();
  if (entry?.seasonKey || entry?.season_key) return String(entry.seasonKey || entry.season_key) === seasonKey;
  const recordedAt = Number(entry?.recordedAt || entry?.recorded_at || entry?.createdAt || 0);
  if (!recordedAt) return false;
  const start = getLeaderboardSeasonStart();
  const end = new Date(start);
  end.setDate(end.getDate() + 7);
  return recordedAt >= start.getTime() && recordedAt < end.getTime();
}

}

function mergeMetaProgress(saved) {
  const base = defaultMetaProgress();
  if (!saved || typeof saved !== "object") return base;
  const defaultUnlocks = base.scientistUnlocks;
  const mergedStats = normalizeMetaStats(saved.stats, saved);
  const unlockedCharacters = {
    ...base.unlockedCharacters,
    ...(saved.unlockedCharacters || {}),
  };
  if (saved.scientistUnlocks) {
    for (const [id, unlocked] of Object.entries(saved.scientistUnlocks)) {
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(unlockedCharacters, id)) unlockedCharacters[id] = Boolean(unlocked);
    }
  }
  unlockedCharacters.default = true;
  const fiveMinuteCleared = Boolean(saved.fiveMinuteCleared);
  const tenMinuteCleared = Boolean(saved.tenMinuteCleared);
  return {
    ...base,
    ...saved,
    fiveMinuteCleared,
    tenMinuteModeUnlocked: Boolean(saved.tenMinuteModeUnlocked || fiveMinuteCleared),
    tenMinuteCleared,
    endlessModeUnlocked: Boolean(saved.endlessModeUnlocked || tenMinuteCleared),
    researchFunds: Number.isFinite(saved.researchFunds) ? saved.researchFunds : base.researchFunds,
    ownedAvatarItems: Array.isArray(saved.ownedAvatarItems)
      ? saved.ownedAvatarItems
      : Array.isArray(saved.ownedItems) ? saved.ownedItems : [],
    equippedAvatarItems: normalizeEquippedAvatarItems(saved.equippedAvatarItems || saved.equippedItems),
    equippedItems: normalizeEquippedAvatarItems(saved.equippedAvatarItems || saved.equippedItems),
    ownedItems: Array.isArray(saved.ownedItems) ? saved.ownedItems : [],
    evolvedWeaponsObtained: Array.isArray(saved.evolvedWeaponsObtained) ? saved.evolvedWeaponsObtained : [],
    weaponKillCounts: { ...base.weaponKillCounts, ...(saved.weaponKillCounts || {}) },
    unlockedCharacters,
    stats: mergedStats,
    achievements: normalizeAchievements(saved.achievements, saved.activeAchievementEffects),
    activeAchievementEffects: normalizeActiveAchievementEffects(saved.activeAchievementEffects, saved.achievements),
    characterTenMinuteClears: normalizeCharacterTenMinuteClears(saved.characterTenMinuteClears, saved.collegeDoanMajors),
    collegeDoanMajors: normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(saved.collegeDoanMajors),
    selectedCollegeDoanMajors: normalizeSelectedCollegeDoanMajors(saved.selectedCollegeDoanMajors, saved.collegeDoanMajors),
    scientistUnlocks: { ...defaultUnlocks, ...(saved.scientistUnlocks || {}) },
    perRunRecords: { ...base.perRunRecords, ...(saved.perRunRecords || {}) },
  };
}

function normalizeAchievementSource(saved, activeEffects = {}) {
  const source = saved && typeof saved === "object" ? { ...saved } : {};
  const active = activeEffects && typeof activeEffects === "object" ? activeEffects : {};
  const migrate = (from, to) => {
    if (!source[from] && !active[from]) return;
    const previous = source[from] && typeof source[from] === "object" ? source[from] : {};
    const current = source[to] && typeof source[to] === "object" ? source[to] : {};
    const currentHasEnabled = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(current, "enabled");
    source[to] = {
      ...current,
      unlocked: Boolean(current.unlocked || previous.unlocked),
      enabled: currentHasEnabled ? Boolean(current.enabled) : Boolean(previous.enabled || active[from] || active[to]),
    };
  };
  migrate("polymath", "all_round_doctor");
  migrate("master_trainer", "best_trainer");
  return source;
}

function normalizeAchievements(saved, activeEffects = {}) {
  const base = defaultAchievements();
  const source = normalizeAchievementSource(saved, activeEffects);
  const active = activeEffects && typeof activeEffects === "object" ? activeEffects : {};
  const result = {};
  for (const id of Object.keys(base)) {
    const current = source[id] && typeof source[id] === "object" ? source[id] : {};
    const unlocked = Boolean(current.unlocked);
    const hasEnabledFlag = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(current, "enabled");
    result[id] = {
      ...base[id],
      ...current,
      unlocked,
      enabled: Boolean(unlocked && (hasEnabledFlag ? current.enabled : active[id])),
    };
  }
  return result;
}

function normalizeActiveAchievementEffects(saved, savedAchievements) {
  const achievements = normalizeAchievements(savedAchievements, saved);
  const source = saved && typeof saved === "object" ? saved : {};
  const result = {};
  for (const id of Object.keys(ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS)) {
    const rawAchievement = savedAchievements?.[id];
    const hasEnabledFlag = rawAchievement && typeof rawAchievement === "object" && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rawAchievement, "enabled");
    result[id] = Boolean(achievements[id]?.unlocked && (hasEnabledFlag ? achievements[id]?.enabled : source[id]));
  }
  return result;
}

function normalizeCharacterTenMinuteClears(saved, savedMajors = null) {
  const source = saved && typeof saved === "object" ? saved : {};
  const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(savedMajors);
  const result = {};
  for (const id of getPlayableAchievementCharacterIds()) result[id] = Boolean(source[id] || majors[id]?.tenMinuteClear);
  return result;
}

function getPlayableAchievementCharacterIds() {
  return Object.keys(characters || {}).filter(id => characters[id]);
}

function normalizeMetaStats(savedStats, savedRoot = {}) {
  const base = defaultMetaStats();
  const source = savedStats && typeof savedStats === "object" ? savedStats : {};
  const stats = { ...base, ...source };
  stats.totalKills = Math.max(Number(stats.totalKills) || 0, Number(savedRoot.totalKills) || 0);
  stats.bestInfiniteTime = Math.max(Number(stats.bestInfiniteTime) || 0, Number(savedRoot.bestInfiniteTime) || 0);
  stats.totalSummonAllyKills = Math.max(Number(stats.totalSummonAllyKills) || 0, getSummonAllyKillCount(savedRoot.weaponKillCounts || {}));
  for (const key of Object.keys(base)) stats[key] = Number.isFinite(Number(stats[key])) ? Number(stats[key]) : base[key];
  return stats;
}

function normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(saved) {
  const base = defaultCollegeDoanMajors();
  const source = saved && typeof saved === "object" ? saved : {};
  const result = {};
  for (const [majorId, majorBase] of Object.entries(base)) {
    const current = source[majorId] && typeof source[majorId] === "object" ? source[majorId] : {};
    result[majorId] = {
      ...majorBase,
      ...current,
      evolvedWeapons: { ...majorBase.evolvedWeapons, ...(current.evolvedWeapons || {}) },
    };
    result[majorId].unlocked = isCollegeMajorComplete(result[majorId]);
  }
  return result;
}

function normalizeSelectedCollegeDoanMajors(saved, savedMajors) {
  const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(savedMajors);
  if (!Array.isArray(saved)) return [];
  return [...new Set(saved)].filter(id => majors[id]).slice(0, Object.keys(majors).length);
}

function normalizeEquippedAvatarItems(saved) {
  const base = defaultMetaProgress().equippedAvatarItems;
  const source = saved && typeof saved === "object" ? saved : {};
  return {
    ...base,
    head: normalizeAvatarItemId(source.head) || null,
    body: normalizeAvatarItemId(source.body) || null,
    accessory: normalizeAvatarItemId(source.accessory || source.prop) || null,
  };
}

function saveMetaProgress() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem("metaProgress", JSON.stringify(metaProgress));
  } catch {
    // Continue the current run if storage is unavailable.
  }
}

function resetResearchProgress() {
  metaProgress = defaultMetaProgress();
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem("selectedCharacter");
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage errors; the in-memory reset still applies.
  }
  saveMetaProgress();
  return metaProgress;
}

function isAchievementUnlocked(id) {
  return Boolean(metaProgress?.achievements?.[id]?.unlocked);
}

function isAchievementEffectActive(id) {
  return Boolean(isAchievementUnlocked(id) && metaProgress?.achievements?.[id]?.enabled);
}

function toggleAchievementEffect(id) {
  if (!ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS[id] || !isAchievementUnlocked(id)) return;
  metaProgress.achievements = normalizeAchievements(metaProgress.achievements);
  metaProgress.achievements[id].enabled = !metaProgress.achievements[id].enabled;
  metaProgress.activeAchievementEffects = normalizeActiveAchievementEffects(metaProgress.activeAchievementEffects, metaProgress.achievements);
  if (id === "all_round_doctor") reconcileSelectedCollegeDoanMajors();
  saveMetaProgress();
}

function getActiveAchievementEffectStats() {
  const stats = {};
  if (typeof metaProgress === "undefined" || !metaProgress) return stats;
  const achievements = normalizeAchievements(metaProgress.achievements);
  for (const [id, achievement] of Object.entries(achievements)) {
    if (!achievement.unlocked || !achievement.enabled) continue;
    for (const effect of ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS[id]?.effects || []) {
      if (!effect?.type || !Number.isFinite(effect.value)) continue;
      stats[effect.type] = (stats[effect.type] || 0) + effect.value;
    }
  }
  return stats;
}

function getAchievementProgress(id) {
  const stats = metaProgress?.stats || defaultMetaStats();
  if (id === "graduation_thesis") {
    const ids = getPlayableAchievementCharacterIds();
    const current = ids.filter(isCharacterUnlocked).length;
    return { current, target: ids.length, text: `${current}/${ids.length}` };
  }
  if (id === "all_round_doctor") {
    const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(metaProgress?.collegeDoanMajors);
    const values = Object.values(majors);
    const current = values.filter(major => major.unlocked).length;
    return { current, target: values.length, text: `${current}/${values.length}` };
  }
  if (id === "best_trainer") {
    const current = Math.min(500, Math.floor(stats.totalSummonAllyKills || 0));
    return { current, target: 500, text: `${current}/500` };
  }
  if (id === "zombie") {
    const current = Math.min(300, Math.floor(stats.bestSingleRunHealing || 0));
    return { current, target: 300, text: `${current}/300` };
  }
  if (id === "desk_scientist") return { current: isAchievementUnlocked(id) ? 1 : 0, target: 1, text: isAchievementUnlocked(id) ? "완료" : "특수 클리어 필요" };
  if (id === "empty_wallet_warrior") {
    const current = Math.min(900, Math.floor(stats.bestItemlessSurvival || 0));
    return { current, target: 900, text: formatTime(current) };
  }
  if (id === "i_am_tree") {
    const current = Math.min(180, Math.floor(stats.bestStationaryStreak || 0));
    return { current, target: 180, text: formatTime(current) };
  }
  return { current: 0, target: 1, text: "" };
}

function isDeveloperMode() {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem("developerMode") === "true";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function setDeveloperMode(enabled) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem("developerMode", enabled ? "true" : "false");
  } catch {
    // Developer mode is a convenience toggle; storage failure should not break the run.
  }
}

function getSafeSelectedCharacter(id = selectedCharacter) {
  if (!characters[id]) return "default";
  if (isCharacterUnlocked(id)) return id;
  return "default";
}
