```js
function startRun(mode = selectedMode) {
  selectedMode = normalizeRunMode(mode);
  state = newState(mode);
  rebuildStats(false);
  state.mode = "play";
  ui.startOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  ui.endOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  ui.researchOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  ui.leaderboardOverlay?.classList.remove("active");
  ui.evolutionGuideOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  if (ui.avatarShopOverlay) ui.avatarShopOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  ui.characterOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  ui.levelOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  document.querySelector(".game-shell").classList.remove("paused-info");
  ui.itemInfoBox.hidden = true;
  syncHud(true);
  lastTime = performance.now();
  cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function normalizeRunMode(mode) {
  return mode === "endless" ? "infinite" : mode;
}

function endRun(clear) {
  const result = buildRunResult(clear);
  const reviveRatio = getNextReviveRatio();
  const canRevive = !clear && reviveRatio > 0;
  if (canRevive) {
    state.pendingResult = result;
  } else {
    state.pendingResult = null;
    updateMetaProgress(result);
  }
  state.mode = clear ? "clear" : "gameover";
  ui.endKicker.textContent = result.modeLabel;
  ui.endTitle.textContent = clear ? "실험 성공" : "실험 종료";
  ui.endMessage.textContent = clear
    ? (state.runMode === "ten_hard" ? "방과후 야간 실험 기록이 완성되었습니다." : state.runMode === "ten" ? "심화 실험 기록이 완성되었습니다." : "기본 생존 실험을 완료했습니다.")
    : state.runMode === "infinite" ? "무한 실험 기록이 멈췄다."
    : "이번 실험은 여기서 멈췄습니다.";
  const resultBadges = [];
  if (result.newBestSurvival) resultBadges.push("최고 생존 기록");
  if (result.newBestInfinite) resultBadges.push("무한 모드 최고 기록");
  if (result.evolvedWeapons.length >= 2) resultBadges.push("빌드 완성도 높음");
  if (result.kills >= 500) resultBadges.push("대량 처치");
  if (result.unlockMessages?.length) resultBadges.push(...result.unlockMessages);
  ui.resultStats.innerHTML = `
    <div><span>생존 시간</span><strong>${formatTime(result.survivalTime)}</strong></div>
    <div><span>랭킹 점수</span><strong>${(result.score || getRunScore(result)).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
    <div><span>도달 레벨</span><strong>Lv.${result.level}</strong></div>
    <div><span>처치 수</span><strong>${result.kills}</strong></div>
    <div><span>보스 처치</span><strong>${result.bossKills || 0}</strong></div>
    <div><span>이번 판 연구비</span><strong>+${(result.researchFundsEarned || 0).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
    <div class="wide funds-breakdown"><span>정산 항목</span><strong>${formatFundsBreakdown(result.researchFundsBreakdown)}</strong></div>
    <div class="wide"><span>획득한 진화 무기</span><strong>${result.evolvedWeapons.length ? result.evolvedWeapons.map(getWeaponName).join(", ") : "없음"}</strong></div>
    <div class="wide damage-report-panel"><button class="secondary-button damage-report-button" type="button" onclick="showDamageReport()">기술별 피해 분석</button><div id="damageReportContent" class="damage-report-content" hidden></div></div>
    ${resultBadges.length ? `<div class="wide"><span>이번 판 평가</span><strong>${resultBadges.join(" · ")}</strong></div>` : ""}
  `;
  ui.reviveButton.hidden = !canRevive;
  if (canRevive) ui.reviveButton.textContent = `체력 ${Math.round(reviveRatio * 100)}%로 부활하기`;
  if (ui.rankRegisterButton) ui.rankRegisterButton.hidden = false;
  renderMainMenu();
  ui.endOverlay.classList.add("active");
}

function getLeaderboardEntries() {
  try {
    const entries = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LEADERBOARD_STORAGE_KEY) || "[]");
    return Array.isArray(entries)
      ? entries.filter(entry => entry && typeof entry === "object").map(normalizeLeaderboardEntry).filter(isCurrentLeaderboardSeason)
      : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveLeaderboardEntries(entries) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(LEADERBOARD_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(entries
      .map(normalizeLeaderboardEntry)
      .filter(isCurrentLeaderboardSeason)
      .slice(0, LEADERBOARD_MAX_ENTRIES)
    ));
  } catch {
    // Ranking is optional and should never block normal game progress.
  }
}

async function fetchRemoteLeaderboardEntries() {
  if (hasSupabaseLeaderboard()) return fetchSupabaseLeaderboardEntries();
  if (!hasRemoteLeaderboard()) return [];
  const response = await fetch(getLeaderboardApiUrl(), {
    method: "GET",
    headers: { "Accept": "application/json" },
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Leaderboard fetch failed: ${response.status}`);
  const data = await response.json();
  const entries = Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.entries) ? data.entries : [];
  return entries.map(normalizeLeaderboardEntry);
}

async function submitRemoteLeaderboardEntry(entry) {
  if (hasSupabaseLeaderboard()) return submitSupabaseLeaderboardEntry(entry);
  if (!hasRemoteLeaderboard()) return null;
  const response = await fetch(getLeaderboardApiUrl(), {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Accept": "application/json",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ entry: normalizeLeaderboardEntry(entry) }),
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Leaderboard submit failed: ${response.status}`);
  const data = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  return normalizeLeaderboardEntry(data?.entry || data || entry);
}

function entryToSupabaseRow(entry) {
  const normalized = normalizeLeaderboardEntry(entry);
  return {
    player_key: normalized.playerKey || getLeaderboardPlayerKey(),
    season_key: normalized.seasonKey || getLeaderboardSeasonKey(),
    initials: normalized.initials,
    survival_time_seconds: normalized.survivalTime,
    score: normalized.score,
    character_id: normalized.characterId,
    character_name: normalized.characterName,
    equipped_items: normalized.itemIds || [],
    weapons: normalized.weaponBuild || [],
    recorded_at: normalized.recordedAt,
    payload: normalized,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

function supabaseRowToEntry(row) {
  return normalizeLeaderboardEntry(row?.payload || {
    entryId: row?.id ? `SUPABASE-${row.id}` : undefined,
    playerKey: row?.player_key,
    seasonKey: row?.season_key,
    initials: row?.initials,
    survivalTime: row?.survival_time_seconds ?? row?.survival_time,
    score: row?.score,
    characterId: row?.character_id,
    characterName: row?.character_name,
    itemIds: Array.isArray(row?.equipped_items) ? row.equipped_items : [],
    weaponBuild: Array.isArray(row?.weapons) ? row.weapons : [],
    recordedAt: row?.recorded_at || (row?.updated_at ? Date.parse(row.updated_at) : row?.created_at ? Date.parse(row.created_at) : Date.now()),
  });
}

async function fetchSupabaseLeaderboardEntries() {
  const config = getSupabaseLeaderboardConfig();
  const seasonKey = encodeURIComponent(getLeaderboardSeasonKey());
  const url = `${config.url}/rest/v1/${encodeURIComponent(config.table)}?select=*&season_key=eq.${seasonKey}&order=survival_time_seconds.desc,score.desc,recorded_at.asc&limit=${LEADERBOARD_MAX_ENTRIES}`;
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers: {
      "Accept": "application/json",
      "apikey": config.anonKey,
      "Authorization": `Bearer ${config.anonKey}`,
    },
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Supabase leaderboard fetch failed: ${response.status} ${await readResponseText(response)}`);
  const rows = await response.json();
  return Array.isArray(rows) ? rows.map(supabaseRowToEntry).filter(isCurrentLeaderboardSeason) : [];
}

async function submitSupabaseLeaderboardEntry(entry) {
  const config = getSupabaseLeaderboardConfig();
  const row = entryToSupabaseRow(entry);
  const response = await fetch(`${config.url}/rest/v1/${encodeURIComponent(config.table)}?on_conflict=season_key,player_key`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Accept": "application/json",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "apikey": config.anonKey,
      "Authorization": `Bearer ${config.anonKey}`,
      "Prefer": "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=representation",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(row),
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Supabase leaderboard submit failed: ${response.status} ${await readResponseText(response)}`);
  const rows = await response.json().catch(() => []);
  return supabaseRowToEntry(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows[0] : rows);
}

async function readResponseText(response) {
  try {
    return await response.text();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

function getLeaderboardFailureMessage(error) {
  const message = String(error?.message || error || "");
  if (message.includes("season_key") || message.includes("survival_time_seconds") || message.includes("recorded_at") || message.includes("payload") || message.includes("schema cache")) {
    return "공유 랭킹 테이블 구조가 아직 최신 버전이 아닙니다. Supabase SQL Editor에서 andro/SUPABASE_LEADERBOARD_SETUP.sql 전체를 다시 실행한 뒤 재시도해 주세요.";
  }
  if (message.includes("Failed to fetch") || message.includes("NetworkError")) {
    return "공유 랭킹 서버에 연결하지 못했습니다. 인터넷 연결 또는 Supabase 프로젝트 상태를 확인해 주세요.";
  }
  return "공유 랭킹 서버에 등록하지 못해 이 기기에만 저장했습니다.";
}

function mergeLeaderboardEntries(...groups) {
  const byId = new Map();
  for (const group of groups) {
    for (const entry of group || []) {
      const normalized = normalizeLeaderboardEntry(entry);
      if (!isCurrentLeaderboardSeason(normalized)) continue;
      const key = normalized.playerKey && normalized.playerKey !== "P-LOCAL"
        ? normalized.playerKey
        : normalized.entryId || `${normalized.initials}-${normalized.integrityHash}`;
      const previous = byId.get(key);
      if (!previous || (normalized.survivalTime || 0) > (previous.survivalTime || 0)
        || ((normalized.survivalTime || 0) === (previous.survivalTime || 0) && (normalized.score || 0) > (previous.score || 0))) {
        byId.set(key, normalized);
      }
    }
  }
  return sortLeaderboardEntries([...byId.values()]);
}

async function loadLeaderboardEntries() {
  const localEntries = getLeaderboardEntries();
  if (!hasRemoteLeaderboard()) {
    lastLeaderboardStatus = `이번 주 로컬 랭킹 · ${getLeaderboardSeasonKey()} 시작`;
    return localEntries;
  }
  try {
    const remoteEntries = await fetchRemoteLeaderboardEntries();
    lastLeaderboardStatus = `이번 주 공유 랭킹 · 일요일 00:00 리셋`;
    return mergeLeaderboardEntries(remoteEntries, localEntries);
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(error);
    lastLeaderboardStatus = "공유 랭킹 연결 실패 · 이번 주 로컬 랭킹 표시";
    return localEntries;
  }
}

function getRunScore(result) {
  return Math.round(
    (result.survivalTime || 0) * 10
    + (result.kills || 0) * 2
    + (result.bossKills || 0) * 300
  );
}

function summarizeEquippedAvatarItems() {
  const items = getEquippedAvatarItems().map(item => item.name);
  return items.length ? items.join(", ") : "없음";
}

function summarizeRunSkills(result) {
  const weaponNames = (result.weaponBuild || []).map(w => `${getWeaponName(w.id)} Lv.${w.level}`);
  const passiveNames = (result.passiveBuild || []).map(p => {
    const def = passiveDefs.find(passive => passive.id === p.id);
    return `${def?.name || p.id} Lv.${p.level}`;
  });
  const names = [...weaponNames, ...passiveNames];
  return names.length ? names.join(", ") : "없음";
}

function getLeaderboardPayloadHash(payload) {
  const text = JSON.stringify(payload);
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
  }
  return (hash >>> 0).toString(36).toUpperCase();
}

function normalizeLeaderboardEntry(entry) {
  const safe = entry || {};
  const payload = {
    schemaVersion: safe.schemaVersion || LEADERBOARD_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    playerKey: String(safe.playerKey || safe.player_key || "").slice(0, 32),
    seasonKey: String(safe.seasonKey || safe.season_key || "").slice(0, 16),
    initials: String(safe.initials || "AAA").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "").slice(0, 3).padEnd(3, "A"),
    survivalTime: Math.max(0, Math.floor(safe.survivalTime || 0)),
    score: Math.max(0, Math.floor(safe.score || 0)),
    mode: normalizeRunMode(safe.mode || ""),
    characterId: safe.characterId || "",
    itemIds: Array.isArray(safe.itemIds) ? safe.itemIds : [],
    weaponBuild: Array.isArray(safe.weaponBuild) ? safe.weaponBuild : [],
    passiveBuild: Array.isArray(safe.passiveBuild) ? safe.passiveBuild : [],
    evolvedWeaponIds: Array.isArray(safe.evolvedWeaponIds) ? safe.evolvedWeaponIds : [],
    kills: Math.max(0, Math.floor(safe.kills || 0)),
    bossKills: Math.max(0, Math.floor(safe.bossKills || 0)),
    level: Math.max(1, Math.floor(safe.level || 1)),
    researchFundsEarned: Math.max(0, Math.floor(safe.researchFundsEarned || 0)),
  };
  const recordedAt = Number(safe.recordedAt || safe.createdAt || Date.now());
  const integrityHash = safe.integrityHash || getLeaderboardPayloadHash(payload);
  return {
    ...safe,
    ...payload,
    entryId: safe.entryId || `LOCAL-${integrityHash}-${recordedAt}`,
    characterName: safe.characterName || characters[payload.characterId]?.name || payload.characterId || "알 수 없음",
    modeLabel: safe.modeLabel || safe.mode || "",
    items: safe.items || "없음",
    skills: safe.skills || "없음",
    evolvedWeapons: safe.evolvedWeapons || "없음",
    recordedAt,
    createdAt: recordedAt,
    integrityHash,
  };
}

function buildLeaderboardEntry(initials, result) {
  const itemIds = Object.values(typeof getEquippedAvatarItemIds === "function" ? getEquippedAvatarItemIds() : {}).filter(Boolean);
  const payload = {
    schemaVersion: LEADERBOARD_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    playerKey: getLeaderboardPlayerKey(),
    seasonKey: getLeaderboardSeasonKey(),
    initials,
    survivalTime: result.survivalTime || 0,
    score: result.score || getRunScore(result),
    mode: normalizeRunMode(result.mode),
    characterId: result.characterId,
    itemIds,
    weaponBuild: result.weaponBuild || [],
    passiveBuild: result.passiveBuild || [],
    evolvedWeaponIds: result.evolvedWeapons || [],
    kills: result.kills || 0,
    bossKills: result.bossKills || 0,
    level: result.level || 1,
    researchFundsEarned: result.researchFundsEarned || 0,
  };
  const recordedAt = Date.now();
  const integrityHash = getLeaderboardPayloadHash(payload);
  return normalizeLeaderboardEntry({
    ...payload,
    entryId: `LOCAL-${integrityHash}-${recordedAt}`,
    characterName: characters[result.characterId]?.name || result.characterId || "알 수 없음",
    items: result.equippedItemsText || "없음",
    skills: summarizeRunSkills(result),
    evolvedWeapons: result.evolvedWeapons?.length ? result.evolvedWeapons.map(getWeaponName).join(", ") : "없음",
    modeLabel: result.modeLabel || result.mode || "",
    recordedAt,
    createdAt: recordedAt,
    integrityHash,
  });
}

function sortLeaderboardEntries(entries) {
  return [...entries]
    .map(normalizeLeaderboardEntry)
    .sort((a, b) => (b.survivalTime || 0) - (a.survivalTime || 0) || (b.score || 0) - (a.score || 0) || (a.recordedAt || 0) - (b.recordedAt || 0));
}

async function registerCurrentRunToLeaderboard() {
  const result = state?.pendingResult || (state && state.mode !== "start" ? buildRunResult(state.mode === "clear") : null);
  if (!result) return;
  const raw = prompt("랭킹에 등록할 영어 이니셜 3글자를 입력하세요.", "AAA");
  if (raw == null) return;
  const initials = raw.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "").slice(0, 3);
  if (initials.length !== 3) {
    alert("영어 대문자 이니셜 3글자로 입력해 주세요.");
    return;
  }
  const entry = buildLeaderboardEntry(initials, result);
  const entries = getLeaderboardEntries();
  const previousIndex = entries.findIndex(item => item.initials === initials);
  if (previousIndex >= 0) {
    const previous = entries[previousIndex];
    const better = entry.survivalTime > (previous.survivalTime || 0)
      || (entry.survivalTime === (previous.survivalTime || 0) && entry.score > (previous.score || 0));
    if (!better && !hasRemoteLeaderboard()) {
      alert("기존 등록 기록보다 높지 않아 갱신하지 않았습니다.");
      return;
    }
    entries[previousIndex] = entry;
  } else {
    entries.push(entry);
  }
  saveLeaderboardEntries(sortLeaderboardEntries(entries));
  if (hasRemoteLeaderboard()) {
    try {
      const savedEntry = await submitRemoteLeaderboardEntry(entry);
      if (savedEntry) saveLeaderboardEntries(mergeLeaderboardEntries(getLeaderboardEntries(), [savedEntry]));
      lastLeaderboardStatus = "공유 랭킹 등록 완료";
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(error);
      lastLeaderboardStatus = "공유 랭킹 등록 실패 · 로컬에만 저장됨";
      alert(getLeaderboardFailureMessage(error));
    }
  }
  renderLeaderboard();
  ui.leaderboardOverlay?.classList.add("active");
}

async function renderLeaderboard() {
  const box = ui.leaderboardContent;
  if (!box) return;
  box.innerHTML = `<div class="leaderboard-empty">랭킹을 불러오는 중입니다...</div>`;
  const entries = sortLeaderboardEntries(await loadLeaderboardEntries()).slice(0, LEADERBOARD_MAX_ENTRIES);
  const statusHtml = `<div class="leaderboard-empty leaderboard-status">${lastLeaderboardStatus || "로컬 랭킹"}</div>`;
  if (entries.length === 0) {
    box.innerHTML = `${statusHtml}<div class="leaderboard-empty">아직 등록된 랭킹이 없습니다.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  box.innerHTML = `${statusHtml}<div class="leaderboard-list">${entries.map((entry, index) => `
    <article class="leaderboard-entry ${index === 0 ? "top-rank" : ""}">
      <div class="leaderboard-rank"><b>${index + 1}</b><strong>${entry.initials}</strong></div>
      <div class="leaderboard-main">
        <div><span>생존 시간</span><strong>${formatTime(entry.survivalTime || 0)}</strong></div>
        <div><span>점수</span><strong>${(entry.score || 0).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
        <div><span>등록 시간</span><strong>${formatLeaderboardDateTime(entry.recordedAt || entry.createdAt)}</strong></div>
        <div><span>캐릭터</span><strong>${entry.characterName || "알 수 없음"}</strong></div>
        <div><span>아이템</span><strong>${entry.items || "없음"}</strong></div>
        <div class="wide"><span>기술</span><strong>${entry.skills || entry.weapons || "없음"}</strong></div>
        <div class="wide"><span>진화</span><strong>${entry.evolvedWeapons || "없음"}</strong></div>
      </div>
    </article>`).join("")}</div>`;
}

function formatLeaderboardDateTime(value) {
  const timestamp = Number(value || 0);
  if (!timestamp) return "-";
  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "-";
  return date.toLocaleString("ko-KR", {
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  }).replace(/\.\s?/g, ". ").trim();
}

function formatFundsBreakdown(breakdown = {}) {
  const rows = [
    ["생존", breakdown.survival || 0],
    ["처치", breakdown.kills || 0],
    ["보스", breakdown.bosses || 0],
    ["진화", breakdown.evolutions || 0],
    ["모드", breakdown.mode || 0],
    ["장착 보너스", breakdown.bonus || 0],
  ].filter(([, value]) => value > 0);
  return rows.length ? rows.map(([label, value]) => `${label} +${value.toLocaleString()}`).join(" · ") : "기본 보상 없음";
}

function showDamageReport() {
  const box = document.getElementById("damageReportContent");
  if (!box || !state?.pendingResult && !state) return;
  const result = state.pendingResult || buildRunResult(state.mode === "clear");
  const entries = Object.entries(result.weaponDamageCounts || {})
    .filter(([, damage]) => damage > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .slice(0, 12);
  if (entries.length === 0) {
    box.hidden = false;
    box.innerHTML = `<p>아직 기록된 피해량이 없습니다.</p>`;
    return;
  }
  const windowSeconds = Math.max(1, result.damageWindowSeconds || Math.min(60, result.survivalTime || 1));
  const lastMinuteCounts = result.lastMinuteDamageCounts || {};
  box.hidden = !box.hidden;
  box.innerHTML = `<div class="damage-report-list">${entries.map(([id, damage]) => {
    const recentDamage = lastMinuteCounts[id] || 0;
    const dps = recentDamage / windowSeconds;
    return `<div><span>${getDamageSourceName(id)}</span><strong>${Math.round(damage).toLocaleString()} 누적 피해</strong><em>마지막 ${Math.round(windowSeconds)}초 ${dps.toFixed(1)}/초</em></div>`;
  }).join("")}</div>`;
}

function getDamageSourceName(id) {
  const aliases = {
    burn: "화상",
    radiation: "방사능",
    radiation_internal: "방사능 붕괴",
    radioactive_corpse: "피폭 폭발",
    explosion: "폭발",
    combustion_explosion: "연소 폭발",
    flammable_explosion: "가연성 폭발",
    mass_explosion: "질량체 폭발",
    quantum_cloud: "양자 구름",
    marking_zone: "영역표시",
    chem_warfare: "화생방",
    immune: "면역자",
    vaccine: "백신",
    unknown: "기타",
  };
  return aliases[id] || getWeaponName(id);
}

function buildRunResult(clear) {
  const survivalTime = Math.floor(Number.isFinite(state.runConfig.duration) ? Math.min(state.elapsed, state.runConfig.duration) : state.elapsed);
  const damageWindowSeconds = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, survivalTime || 1));
  const damageWindowStart = Math.max(0, survivalTime - damageWindowSeconds);
  const lastMinuteDamageCounts = {};
  for (const event of state.run.weaponDamageEvents || []) {
    if (event.time < damageWindowStart) continue;
    lastMinuteDamageCounts[event.source] = (lastMinuteDamageCounts[event.source] || 0) + event.damage;
  }
  const researchFundsBreakdown = getResearchFundsBreakdown({
    clear,
    survivalTime,
    level: state.player.level,
    kills: state.run.kills,
    bossKills: state.run.bossKills || 0,
    evolvedCount: state.run.evolvedWeapons.length,
    mode: state.runMode,
  });
  const result = {
    clear,
    mode: state.runMode,
    modeLabel: state.runConfig.label,
    survivalTime,
    level: state.player.level,
    kills: state.run.kills,
    evolvedWeapons: [...state.run.evolvedWeapons],
    weaponBuild: state.weapons.map(w => ({ id: w.id, level: w.level || 1 })),
    passiveBuild: state.passives.map(p => ({ id: p.id, level: p.level || 1 })),
    equippedItemsText: summarizeEquippedAvatarItems(),
    weaponKillCounts: { ...state.run.weaponKillCounts },
    weaponDamageCounts: { ...state.run.weaponDamageCounts },
    lastMinuteDamageCounts,
    damageWindowSeconds,
    reachedLevel15: state.run.reachedLevel15 || state.player.level >= 15,
    bossKills: state.run.bossKills || 0,
    midBossKills: state.run.midBossKills || 0,
    areaWeaponKills: state.run.areaWeaponKills || 0,
    summonAllyKills: getSummonAllyKillCount(state.run.weaponKillCounts),
    distanceMoved: Math.floor(state.run.distanceMoved || 0),
    attackCasts: state.run.attackCasts || 0,
    chestsOpened: state.run.chestsOpened || 0,
    tripleChestRewards: state.run.tripleChestRewards || 0,
    totalHealingReceived: Math.floor(state.run.totalHealingReceived || 0),
    newWeaponPickCount: state.run.newWeaponPickCount || 0,
    startedWithoutAvatarItems: Boolean(state.run.startedWithoutAvatarItems),
    bestStationaryStreak: state.run.bestStationaryStreak || 0,
    finalHp: Math.floor(state.player.hp || 0),
    characterId: state.characterId,
    researchFundsBreakdown,
    researchFundsEarned: researchFundsBreakdown.total,
    newBestSurvival: survivalTime > (metaProgress.bestSurvivalTime || 0),
    newBestInfinite: state.runMode === "infinite" && survivalTime > (metaProgress.bestInfiniteTime || 0),
  };
  result.score = getRunScore(result);
  return result;
}

function getSummonAllyKillCount(killCounts = {}) {
  const summonSources = ["schrodinger_cat", "quantum_cat", "dog", "pavlov_dog", "allied_enemy", "fossil_ally", "planting", "pure_cross"];
  return summonSources.reduce((total, id) => total + (Number(killCounts[id]) || 0), 0);
}

function getResearchFundsBreakdown(result) {
  const survival = Math.floor((result.survivalTime || 0) / 10) * 5;
  const kills = Math.floor((result.kills || 0) / 50) * 10;
  const bosses = (result.bossKills || 0) * 80;
  const evolutions = (result.evolvedCount || 0) * 100;
  let mode = 0;
  if (result.clear && result.mode === "five") mode += 150;
  if (result.clear && result.mode === "ten") mode += 350;
  if (result.clear && result.mode === "ten_hard") mode += 520;
  if (result.mode === "infinite") {
    if (result.survivalTime >= 600) mode += 300;
    if (result.survivalTime >= 900) mode += 500;
    if (result.survivalTime >= 1200) mode += 1000;
  }
  const subtotal = survival + kills + bosses + evolutions + mode;
  const bonusRate = getAvatarItemStats().researchFunds || 0;
  const bonus = Math.floor(subtotal * bonusRate);
  return {
    survival,
    kills,
    bosses,
    evolutions,
    mode,
    bonus,
    total: subtotal + bonus,
  };
}

function finalizePendingRun() {
  if (!state?.pendingResult) return;
  updateMetaProgress(state.pendingResult);
  state.pendingResult = null;
}

function reviveRun() {
  const reviveRatio = getNextReviveRatio();
  if (state.mode !== "gameover" || reviveRatio <= 0 || !state.pendingResult) return;
  state.pendingResult = null;
  state.run.reviveCount += 1;
  const p = state.player;
  const before = p.hp;
  p.hp = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(p.maxHp * reviveRatio));
  if (typeof recordPlayerHealing === "function") recordPlayerHealing(p, before);
  p.invuln = 1.6;
  state.hurtTimer = 1.6;
  state.enemies = state.enemies.filter(e => e.boss || dist(p, e) > p.radius + e.radius + 34);
  state.particles.push({ kind: "text", x: p.x, y: p.y - 30, text: "부활!", color: "#9ef7c5", life: 0.8, maxLife: 0.8, size: 18 });
  ui.endOverlay.classList.remove("active");
  state.mode = "play";
  lastTime = performance.now();
  syncHud(true);
}

function getNextReviveRatio() {
  const count = state?.run?.reviveCount || 0;
  const itemRevive = (state?.avatarItemStats || {}).reviveRatio || 0;
  if (count === 0 && itemRevive > 0) return itemRevive;
  return 0;
}

function setPauseMode(paused) {
  if (!state || state.mode === "start" || state.mode === "levelup") return;
  if (paused) {
    state.mode = "paused";
    ui.itemInfoBox.hidden = false;
    ui.itemInfoBox.classList.remove("periodic-table-info");
    ui.itemInfoBox.innerHTML = `
      <strong>일시정지</strong>
      <p>무기와 패시브를 터치하면 설명을 볼 수 있습니다.</p>
      <button id="pauseEvolutionGuideButton" class="pause-guide-button" type="button">진화 조건 보기</button>
    `;
  } else {
    state.mode = "play";
    ui.itemInfoBox.hidden = true;
    lastTime = performance.now();
  }
  document.querySelector(".game-shell").classList.toggle("paused-info", paused);
}

function getAdaCommandGuideHtml(evolved = false) {
  const arrow = { up: "↑", down: "↓", left: "←", right: "→" };
  const commands = [
    ["emergency_patch", "응급 패치", ["down", "up", "down"], ["down", "up", "down", "right"], "체력 4 회복. 체력 80% 이상이면 보호막 8."],
    ["code_bullet", "코드 탄환", ["up", "right", "down"], ["up", "right", "down", "left"], "피해 50 코드 탄환. 반복 검증으로 탄환 수 증가."],
    ["robot_summon", "로봇 소환", ["left", "up", "right"], ["left", "up", "right", "down"], "10초 로봇 1기. 0.5초마다 레이저 피해 14. 쿨타임/소환 보정 적용."],
    ["phase_shift", "위상이탈", ["down", "left", "up", "right", "down"], ["down", "left", "up", "right"], "5초 무적/어그로 해제. 종료 1초 전 깜빡임."],
    ["piercing_code", "관통 코드", ["up", "right", "down", "right", "up"], ["up", "right", "down", "right"], "관통 코드 탄환 3발. 각 피해 40. 반복 검증으로 탄환 수 증가."],
    ["pause_command", "정지 명령", ["right", "up", "left", "down", "right"], ["right", "up", "left", "down"], "반경 240. 일반 적 3초 정지, 정예 1.5초, 보스 3초 감속."],
    ["emergency_move", "긴급 이동", ["left", "down", "right", "up", "left", "down", "right"], ["left", "down", "right", "up"], "반경 200 안 적을 해당 방향의 화면 끝으로 순간이동."],
    ["hacking", "해킹", ["down", "up", "left", "right", "down", "up", "down"], ["down", "up", "left", "right"], "일반 적 1명을 아군화. 최대 5명, 체력 3배."],
    ["error_field", "오류 장판", ["right", "down", "left", "up", "right", "up", "down"], ["right", "down", "left", "up"], "반경 200, 8초. 0.5초마다 피해 14, 종료 시 1초 정지."],
  ];
  const rows = commands.map(([, name, codingSeq, programSeq, effect]) => {
    const seq = evolved ? programSeq : codingSeq;
    return `<li><b>${name}</b><span>${seq.map(dir => arrow[dir] || dir).join(" ")}</span><em>${effect}</em></li>`;
  }).join("");
  return `
    <div class="ada-command-guide">
      <strong>${evolved ? "프로그램 커맨드" : "코딩 커맨드"}</strong>
      <p>${evolved ? "4칸 완성 입력은 100% 발동합니다. 커맨드가 안 떠 있어도 프로그램 쿨타임이 준비되면 같은 4칸 입력으로 완전 발동할 수 있습니다." : "진화 전 코딩은 표시된 커맨드를 끝까지 정확히 입력해야 발동합니다. 3회 연속 무실수 성공 시 [콤보]로 랜덤 코드가 추가 발동합니다."}</p>
      <ul>${rows}</ul>
    </div>
  `;
}

function getAdaDebugGuideHtml(evolved = false) {
  return `
    <div class="ada-command-guide">
      <strong>${evolved ? "시스템 패치 반응" : "디버깅 반응"}</strong>
      <ul>
        <li><b>표식 유지</b><span>${evolved ? "10초" : "8초"}</span><em>한 번 발동할 때 주변 적 묶음에 버그를 심습니다.</em></li>
        <li><b>오류 피해</b><span>${evolved ? "58" : "18~42"}</span><em>보스에게는 70% 피해로 적용됩니다.</em></li>
        <li><b>1회 표식</b><span>${evolved ? "5명" : "2~4명"}</span><em>표식 중심 근처 적에게 함께 적용됩니다.</em></li>
        <li><b>동시 표식</b><span>${evolved ? "8명" : "2~5명"}</span><em>후반 적 무리에서도 버그를 여러 곳에 유지합니다.</em></li>
        <li><b>오류 확산</b><span>${evolved ? "반경 82" : "반경 44~68"}</span><em>버그 발동 시 주변 적에게 파편 피해가 튑니다.</em></li>
        <li><b>전송</b><span>${evolved ? "2~3명" : "1명"}</span><em>Lv.4부터 받은 피해 일부를 주변 적에게 전달합니다.</em></li>
        <li><b>처치 폭발</b><span>${evolved ? "52" : "32"}</span><em>Lv.5 또는 진화 후 버그 적 처치 시 오류 파편이 폭발합니다.</em></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  `;
}

function showItemInfo(type, id) {
  if (state?.mode !== "paused") return;
  let title = "";
  let meta = "";
  let description = "";
  if (type === "weapon") {
    const def = getWeaponDef(id);
    const owned = state.weapons.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!def) return;
    title = def.name;
    meta = `${def.kind} · ${def.evolved ? "완성" : `Lv.${owned?.level || 1}`}`;
    description = def.description;
    if (id === "coding" || id === "program") description += getAdaCommandGuideHtml(id === "program");
    if (id === "debugging" || id === "system_patch") description += getAdaDebugGuideHtml(id === "system_patch");
  } else if (type === "passive") {
    const def = passiveDefs.find(p => p.id === id);
    const owned = state.passives.find(p => p.id === id);
    if (!def) return;
    title = def.name;
    meta = `${def.kind} · Lv.${owned?.level || 1}`;
    description = def.description;
  } else {
    if (id === "mendeleev" && typeof showPeriodicTableInfoBox === "function") {
      showPeriodicTableInfoBox();
      return;
    }
    const specials = {
      student: ["학생", "고유 패시브", "공부하는 사람. 기본 과학력 획득량이 30% 증가합니다."],
      newton: ["F = ma", "고유 패시브", "이동 중 공격력이 오르고 이동 방향 공격이 강화됩니다."],
      lavoisier: ["질량보존법칙", "고유 패시브", "장판, 화상, 회전 등 지속 효과 시간이 30% 증가합니다."],
      mendel: ["우성 유전", "고유 패시브", "직전에 선택한 무기 또는 패시브가 다음 선택지에 반드시 등장합니다."],
      wegener: ["판게아", "고유 패시브", "넉백된 적 주변의 다른 적들이 함께 끌려와 군집화됩니다. 균열로 지층 불안정을 쌓고 대륙 이동/화산으로 붕괴시킬 수 있습니다."],
      faraday: ["전자기 유도", "고유 패시브", "짧은 시간 안에 여러 이동 효과를 받은 적이 추가 전기 피해를 받습니다."],
      pasteur: ["저온 살균", "고유 패시브", "레벨 15까지 받는 피해가 50% 감소하고 이후 효과가 종료됩니다."],
      galileo: ["지동설", "고유 패시브", "투사체가 더 빠르게 날아가 원거리 압박과 관측 공격이 강화됩니다."],
      schrodinger: ["중첩 상태", "고유 패시브", "일정 확률로 다른 위치의 가능성 속 플레이어가 보조 공격을 발동합니다."],
      curie: ["방사능", "고유 패시브", "퀴리의 공격에 노출된 적은 방사능 단계가 올라가며 점점 붕괴됩니다."],
      pavlov: ["조건반사", "고유 패시브", "같은 적에게 3회 이상 피해를 주면 낮은 확률로 적이 아군화됩니다. 피해 횟수가 늘수록 확률이 조금씩 증가합니다."],
      einstein: ["상대성", "고유 패시브", "움직이는 동안 일반 적과 엘리트 적의 시간이 느려집니다. 이동속도가 빠를수록 감속 효과가 강해집니다."],
      mary_anning: ["생명의 흔적", "고유 패시브", "적 처치 시 1% 확률로 화석 조각을 발견합니다. 화석 조각이 모이면 고대 생물 또는 고대 식물이 아군으로 발현됩니다."],
      mendeleev: ["원소주기율표", "고유 패시브", "1~20번 원소의 최초 등록 상태를 기록합니다. 특정 주기, 족, 전체 표가 완성되면 이번 판 동안 유지되는 누적 리워드를 얻습니다."],
      ada_lovelace: ["알고리즘", "고유 패시브", "현재 체력, 적 밀도, 버그 표식, 보스 상황을 분석해 다음 코딩 커맨드의 등장 확률을 조정합니다."],
      fossil_count: ["화석 복원", "특수 자원", "화석 망치, 화석 복원, 발굴 붓 또는 메리 애닝으로 활성화됩니다. 목표 조각 수가 많을수록 더 희귀한 화석 아군이 발현됩니다."],
      element_count: ["원소 등록", "특수 자원", "원소 분석 계열 무기로 원소를 수집하면 등록됩니다. 멘델레예프는 등록된 원소에 따라 주기율표 리워드를 얻습니다."],
      carbon_count: ["탄소 누적", "성장 자원", "C 원소를 누적 획득할수록 탄소결합의 길이가 증가합니다. 조합 반응으로 C를 소비해도 누적 길이는 줄어들지 않습니다."],
    };
    const data = specials[id];
    if (!data) return;
    [title, meta, description] = data;
  }
  ui.itemInfoBox.hidden = false;
  ui.itemInfoBox.classList.remove("periodic-table-info");
  const descriptionHtml = /<\s*(div|ul|ol|section|article|table)\b/i.test(description)
    ? `<div class="item-info-description">${description}</div>`
    : `<p>${description}</p>`;
  ui.itemInfoBox.innerHTML = `<strong>${title}</strong><span>${meta}</span>${descriptionHtml}`;
}

function updateMetaProgress(result) {
  metaProgress = mergeMetaProgress(metaProgress);
  const prevUnlockedCharacters = { ...(metaProgress.unlockedCharacters || {}) };
  const prevMajorUnlocked = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors || {}).map(([id, major]) => [id, Boolean(major.unlocked)]));
  const prevAchievementUnlocked = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(metaProgress.achievements || {}).map(([id, achievement]) => [id, Boolean(achievement.unlocked)]));
  metaProgress.totalRuns += 1;
  metaProgress.totalKills += result.kills;
  metaProgress.researchFunds = (metaProgress.researchFunds || 0) + (result.researchFundsEarned || 0);
  metaProgress.bestSurvivalTime = Math.max(metaProgress.bestSurvivalTime, result.survivalTime);
  metaProgress.bestLevel = Math.max(metaProgress.bestLevel, result.level);
  const stats = metaProgress.stats;
  stats.totalKills += result.kills || 0;
  stats.bestSingleRunKills = Math.max(stats.bestSingleRunKills || 0, result.kills || 0);
  stats.areaWeaponKills += result.areaWeaponKills || 0;
  stats.bestSingleRunAreaWeaponKills = Math.max(stats.bestSingleRunAreaWeaponKills || 0, result.areaWeaponKills || 0);
  if ((result.level || 1) >= 25) stats.runsLevel25OrHigher += 1;
  if (result.clear && result.mode === "five") stats.fiveMinuteClears += 1;
  if (result.clear && result.mode === "five" && (result.finalHp || 0) >= 100) stats.fiveMinuteClearsHp100Plus += 1;
  if (result.clear && (result.mode === "ten" || result.mode === "ten_hard")) stats.tenMinuteClears += 1;
  stats.totalDistanceMoved += result.distanceMoved || 0;
  stats.bestSingleRunDistanceMoved = Math.max(stats.bestSingleRunDistanceMoved || 0, result.distanceMoved || 0);
  stats.totalAttackCasts += result.attackCasts || 0;
  stats.bestSingleRunAttackCasts = Math.max(stats.bestSingleRunAttackCasts || 0, result.attackCasts || 0);
  stats.totalMidBossKills += result.midBossKills || 0;
  stats.totalBossKills += result.bossKills || 0;
  stats.totalChestsOpened += result.chestsOpened || 0;
  stats.totalTripleChestRewards += result.tripleChestRewards || 0;
  stats.bestSingleRunTripleChestRewards = Math.max(stats.bestSingleRunTripleChestRewards || 0, result.tripleChestRewards || 0);
  stats.totalSummonAllyKills += result.summonAllyKills || 0;
  stats.bestSingleRunHealing = Math.max(stats.bestSingleRunHealing || 0, result.totalHealingReceived || 0);
  if (result.startedWithoutAvatarItems) {
    stats.bestItemlessSurvival = Math.max(stats.bestItemlessSurvival || 0, result.survivalTime || 0);
  }
  stats.bestStationaryStreak = Math.max(stats.bestStationaryStreak || 0, result.bestStationaryStreak || 0);

  if (result.clear && result.mode === "five") {
    metaProgress.fiveMinuteCleared = true;
    metaProgress.tenMinuteModeUnlocked = true;
  }
  if (result.clear && (result.mode === "ten" || result.mode === "ten_hard")) {
    metaProgress.tenMinuteCleared = true;
    metaProgress.endlessModeUnlocked = true;
    metaProgress.characterTenMinuteClears = normalizeCharacterTenMinuteClears(metaProgress.characterTenMinuteClears);
    if (metaProgress.characterTenMinuteClears[result.characterId] !== undefined) {
      metaProgress.characterTenMinuteClears[result.characterId] = true;
    }
  }
  if (result.mode === "infinite" || result.mode === "endless") {
    metaProgress.bestInfiniteTime = Math.max(metaProgress.bestInfiniteTime || 0, result.survivalTime);
    stats.bestInfiniteTime = Math.max(stats.bestInfiniteTime || 0, result.survivalTime);
  }

  for (const id of result.evolvedWeapons) {
    if (!metaProgress.evolvedWeaponsObtained.includes(id)) {
      metaProgress.evolvedWeaponsObtained.push(id);
    }
  }
  for (const [id, count] of Object.entries(result.weaponKillCounts)) {
    metaProgress.weaponKillCounts[id] = (metaProgress.weaponKillCounts[id] || 0) + count;
  }

  metaProgress.perRunRecords = {
    reachedLevel15: metaProgress.perRunRecords.reachedLevel15 || result.reachedLevel15,
    obtainedEvolutionThisRun: result.evolvedWeapons,
  };

  updateCollegeDoanMajorProgress(result);
  checkScientistUnlocks();
  updateCollegeDoanMajorUnlocks();
  checkAchievementUnlocks(result);
  checkScientistUnlocks();
  result.unlockMessages = getNewUnlockMessages(prevUnlockedCharacters, prevMajorUnlocked, prevAchievementUnlocked);
  saveMetaProgress();
}

function getNewUnlockMessages(prevCharacters, prevMajors, prevAchievements = {}) {
  const messages = [];
  const characterUnlockMessages = {
    newton: "수많은 충돌 속에서 힘의 법칙을 발견했습니다. 뉴턴 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    lavoisier: "반복되는 반응 속에서 화학의 흐름을 발견했습니다. 라부아지에 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    mendel: "충분히 성장한 기록이 반복되었습니다. 멘델 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    wegener: "수많은 이동 끝에 거대한 변화를 발견했습니다. 베게너 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    faraday: "끊임없는 흐름이 전류처럼 이어졌습니다. 패러데이 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    pasteur: "위험 속에서도 몸을 온전히 지켜냈습니다. 파스퇴르 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    galileo: "오래 버티며 더 먼 곳을 바라보았습니다. 갈릴레이 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    schrodinger: "한 번의 실험 안에서 불확실한 결과가 두 번 겹쳤습니다. 슈뢰딩거 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    curie: "위험한 실험을 견뎌낼 준비가 되었습니다. 마리 퀴리 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    pavlov: "조건화 실험의 길이 열렸습니다. 파블로프 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    einstein: "빠르게 움직이는 순간, 시간이 다르게 흐르기 시작했습니다. 아인슈타인 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    mary_anning: "바닥에 남은 흔적이 오래된 생명의 기록으로 보이기 시작했습니다. 메리 애닝 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    mendeleev: "흩어진 원소들이 하나의 표로 정리되기 시작했습니다. 멘델레예프 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    ada_lovelace: "전장의 흐름이 코드로 읽히기 시작했습니다. 에이다 계승 학생이 해금되었습니다.",
    college_doan: "학사모와 졸업가운을 갖춘 정도안이 새로운 전공의 길을 선택했습니다. 대학생 정도안이 해금되었습니다.",
  };
  for (const [id, unlocked] of Object.entries(metaProgress.unlockedCharacters || {})) {
    if (unlocked && !prevCharacters[id] && characters[id]) {
      messages.push(characterUnlockMessages[id] || `${characters[id].name} 해금!`);
    }
  }
  const majorNames = {
    newton: "뉴턴", lavoisier: "라부아지에", mendel: "멘델", wegener: "베게너", faraday: "패러데이",
    pasteur: "파스퇴르", galileo: "갈릴레이", schrodinger: "슈뢰딩거", curie: "마리 퀴리", pavlov: "파블로프", einstein: "아인슈타인", mary_anning: "메리 애닝", mendeleev: "멘델레예프", ada_lovelace: "에이다",
  };
  for (const [id, major] of Object.entries(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors || {})) {
    if (major.unlocked && !prevMajors[id]) messages.push(`${majorNames[id] || id} 이론 전공 해금!`);
  }
  for (const [id, achievement] of Object.entries(metaProgress.achievements || {})) {
    if (achievement.unlocked && !prevAchievements[id]) messages.push(ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS[id]?.unlockMessage || `${ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS[id]?.name || id} 달성!`);
  }
  return messages;
}

function checkAchievementUnlocks(result = null) {
  metaProgress.achievements = normalizeAchievements(metaProgress.achievements);
  metaProgress.activeAchievementEffects = normalizeActiveAchievementEffects(metaProgress.activeAchievementEffects, metaProgress.achievements);
  const unlock = id => {
    if (!ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS[id] || metaProgress.achievements[id]?.unlocked) return;
    metaProgress.achievements[id].unlocked = true;
    metaProgress.achievements[id].enabled = true;
    metaProgress.activeAchievementEffects[id] = true;
  };
  if (getPlayableAchievementCharacterIds().every(id => isCharacterUnlocked(id))) unlock("graduation_thesis");
  const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors);
  if (Object.values(majors).every(major => major.unlocked)) unlock("all_round_doctor");
  const stats = metaProgress.stats || defaultMetaStats();
  if ((stats.totalSummonAllyKills || 0) >= 500) unlock("best_trainer");
  if ((result?.totalHealingReceived || 0) >= 300 || (stats.bestSingleRunHealing || 0) >= 300) unlock("zombie");
  if (result?.clear && result.mode === "five" && (result.newWeaponPickCount || 0) === 0) unlock("desk_scientist");
  if ((result?.startedWithoutAvatarItems && (result.survivalTime || 0) >= 900) || (stats.bestItemlessSurvival || 0) >= 900) unlock("empty_wallet_warrior");
  if ((result?.bestStationaryStreak || 0) >= 180 || (stats.bestStationaryStreak || 0) >= 180) unlock("i_am_tree");
  metaProgress.activeAchievementEffects = normalizeActiveAchievementEffects(metaProgress.activeAchievementEffects, metaProgress.achievements);
}

function checkScientistUnlocks() {
  metaProgress.unlockedCharacters = {
    ...defaultUnlockedCharacters(),
    ...(metaProgress.unlockedCharacters || {}),
  };
  metaProgress.unlockedCharacters.default = true;
  metaProgress.scientistUnlocks = {
    ...defaultMetaProgress().scientistUnlocks,
    ...(metaProgress.scientistUnlocks || {}),
  };
  for (const scientist of scientistDefs) {
    const unlocked = scientist.conditions.every(condition => getConditionProgress(condition).done);
    metaProgress.scientistUnlocks[scientist.id] = unlocked;
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(metaProgress.unlockedCharacters, scientist.id)) {
      metaProgress.unlockedCharacters[scientist.id] = unlocked;
    }
  }
}

function isScientistUnlocked(id) {
  return isCharacterUnlocked(id);
}

function isCharacterUnlocked(id) {
  if (id === "default") return true;
  if (isDeveloperMode()) return true;
  const unlocks = metaProgress?.unlockedCharacters || {};
  return Boolean(unlocks[id]);
}

function isCollegeMajorComplete(major) {
  if (!major) return false;
  return Boolean(major.tenMinuteClear) && Object.values(major.evolvedWeapons || {}).every(Boolean);
}

function updateCollegeDoanMajorUnlocks() {
  metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors);
}

function updateCollegeDoanMajorProgress(result) {
  const majorId = result.characterId;
  const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors);
  if (!majors[majorId] || majorId === "college_doan" || majorId === "default") {
    metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors = majors;
    return;
  }
  if (result.clear && (result.mode === "ten" || result.mode === "ten_hard")) majors[majorId].tenMinuteClear = true;
  for (const evolvedId of result.evolvedWeapons || []) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(majors[majorId].evolvedWeapons, evolvedId)) {
      majors[majorId].evolvedWeapons[evolvedId] = true;
    }
  }
  majors[majorId].unlocked = isCollegeMajorComplete(majors[majorId]);
  metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors = majors;
}

function getSelectedCollegeDoanMajors() {
  const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors);
  const selected = Array.isArray(metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors) ? metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors : [];
  const limit = getCollegeDoanMajorLimit();
  return selected.filter(id => isDeveloperMode() ? majors[id] : majors[id]?.unlocked).slice(0, limit);
}

function setSelectedCollegeDoanMajors(ids) {
  const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors);
  const limit = getCollegeDoanMajorLimit();
  metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors = [...new Set(ids)].filter(id => isDeveloperMode() ? majors[id] : majors[id]?.unlocked).slice(0, limit);
  saveMetaProgress();
}

function reconcileSelectedCollegeDoanMajors() {
  if (!metaProgress) return;
  const before = Array.isArray(metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors) ? metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors.join("|") : "";
  const majors = normalizeCollegeDoanMajors(metaProgress.collegeDoanMajors);
  const limit = getCollegeDoanMajorLimit();
  metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors = [...new Set(metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors || [])]
    .filter(id => isDeveloperMode() ? majors[id] : majors[id]?.unlocked)
    .slice(0, limit);
  const after = Array.isArray(metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors) ? metaProgress.selectedCollegeDoanMajors.join("|") : "";
  if (before !== after) saveMetaProgress();
}

function getCollegeDoanMajorWeaponIds() {
  const map = {
    newton: ["apple", "laser"],
    lavoisier: ["alcohol_lamp", "oxygen_tank"],
    mendel: ["pea", "planting"],
    wegener: ["fault_shift", "continental_shift"],
    faraday: ["current", "magnet"],
    pasteur: ["germ", "vaccine"],
    galileo: ["planet", "telescope"],
    schrodinger: ["wave", "schrodinger_cat"],
    curie: ["xray", "radioactive_material"],
    pavlov: ["bell_sound", "dog"],
    einstein: ["photoelectric_effect", "mass_conversion"],
    mary_anning: ["fossil_hammer", "ammonite"],
    mendeleev: ["element_analysis", "carbon_bond"],
    ada_lovelace: ["coding", "debugging"],
  };
  return getSelectedCollegeDoanMajors().flatMap(id => map[id] || []);
}

const AVATAR_ITEM_EFFECT_CAPS = {
  xpGain: 0.2,
  scienceGain: 0.05,
  researchFunds: 0.4,
  damage: 0.1,
  cooldown: 0.15,
  maxHp: 0.2,
  damageReduction: 0.2,
  earlyDamageReduction: 0.5,
  range: 0.1,
  pickupRange: 0.3,
  statusDamage: 0.12,
  statusDuration: 0.15,
  duration: 0.2,
  projectileSpeed: 0.2,
  orbitSpeed: 0.2,
  healing: 0.2,
  summonPower: 0.55,
  summonDuration: 0.05,
  summonDamage: 0.3,
  installDamage: 0.12,
  installGrowthSpeed: 0.15,
  orbitDamage: 0.12,
  bossDamage: 0.3,
  impactDamage: 0.12,
  reviveRatio: 0.5,
  playerSize: 0.5,
  attackSize: 0.5,
  itemCatStart: 1,
  conditionChanceMax: 0.02,
  conditionOnHitChance: 0.15,
  summonMoveSpeed: 0.3,
  alliedMoveSpeed: 0.3,
  miniOrbOnHitChance: 0.2,
  combatChanceMultiplier: 2,
  itemDogStart: 1,
  collegeMajorSlots: 1,
  fossilPieceOnKillChance: 0.02,
  startWeaponNotebook: 1,
  passiveEffectMultiplier: 0.03,
  stationaryDamageReduction: 0.05,
};

function normalizeAvatarItemId(id) {
  if (id === "dog_ears") return "dog_tail";
  return id || null;
}

function getAvatarItemDef(id) {
  const normalizedId = normalizeAvatarItemId(id);
  if (!normalizedId) return null;
  return avatarItemDefs?.[normalizedId] || accessoryDefs.find(item => item.id === normalizedId) || null;
}

function normalizeAvatarSlot(slot) {
  return slot === "prop" ? "accessory" : slot;
}

function syncAvatarCompatibilityFields() {
  metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems = normalizeEquippedAvatarItems(metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems || metaProgress.equippedItems);
  metaProgress.equippedItems = { ...metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems };
  metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems = Array.isArray(metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems) ? [...new Set(metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems.map(normalizeAvatarItemId).filter(Boolean))] : [];
  metaProgress.ownedItems = Array.isArray(metaProgress.ownedItems) ? [...new Set(metaProgress.ownedItems.map(normalizeAvatarItemId).filter(Boolean))] : [];
}

function getEquippedAvatarItemIds() {
  syncAvatarCompatibilityFields();
  return { ...defaultMetaProgress().equippedAvatarItems, ...metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems };
}

function hasNoEquippedAvatarItems() {
  const equipped = getEquippedAvatarItemIds();
  return !equipped.head && !equipped.body && !equipped.accessory;
}

function getEquippedAvatarItems() {
  return Object.values(getEquippedAvatarItemIds()).map(getAvatarItemDef).filter(Boolean);
}

function getAvatarItemStats() {
  const stats = {};
  const items = typeof metaProgress === "undefined" ? [] : getEquippedAvatarItems();
  for (const item of items) {
    for (const effect of item.effects || []) {
      if (!effect?.type || !Number.isFinite(effect.value)) continue;
      stats[effect.type] = (stats[effect.type] || 0) + effect.value;
    }
  }
  const achievementStats = getActiveAchievementEffectStats();
  for (const [type, value] of Object.entries(achievementStats)) {
    stats[type] = (stats[type] || 0) + value;
  }
  for (const [key, cap] of Object.entries(AVATAR_ITEM_EFFECT_CAPS)) {
    if (stats[key] != null) stats[key] = clamp(stats[key], -cap, cap);
  }
  return stats;
}

function getCollegeDoanMajorLimit() {
  if (getActiveAchievementEffectStats().collegeMajorUnlimited > 0) return Object.keys(defaultCollegeDoanMajors()).length;
  return 2 + Math.floor((getAvatarItemStats().collegeMajorSlots || 0));
}

function equipAvatarItem(id) {
  const item = getAvatarItemDef(id);
  if (!item) return;
  syncAvatarCompatibilityFields();
  const freeUnlock = AVATAR_SHOP_TEST_MODE || isDeveloperMode();
  if (!freeUnlock && !metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems.includes(id) && !metaProgress.ownedItems.includes(id)) return;
  const slot = normalizeAvatarSlot(item.slot);
  metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems[slot] = id;
  metaProgress.equippedItems[slot] = id;
  if (freeUnlock) {
    if (!metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems.includes(id)) metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems.push(id);
    if (!metaProgress.ownedItems.includes(id)) metaProgress.ownedItems.push(id);
  }
  checkScientistUnlocks();
  reconcileSelectedCollegeDoanMajors();
  saveMetaProgress();
}

function buyAvatarItem(id) {
  const item = getAvatarItemDef(id);
  if (!item) return false;
  syncAvatarCompatibilityFields();
  if (metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems.includes(id) || metaProgress.ownedItems.includes(id)) return true;
  const freeUnlock = AVATAR_SHOP_TEST_MODE || isDeveloperMode();
  if (!freeUnlock && (metaProgress.researchFunds || 0) < item.price) return false;
  if (!freeUnlock) metaProgress.researchFunds = Math.max(0, (metaProgress.researchFunds || 0) - item.price);
  metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems.push(id);
  metaProgress.ownedItems.push(id);
  checkScientistUnlocks();
  saveMetaProgress();
  return true;
}

function unequipAvatarItem(slot) {
  syncAvatarCompatibilityFields();
  const normalized = normalizeAvatarSlot(slot);
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(defaultMetaProgress().equippedAvatarItems, normalized)) return;
  metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems[normalized] = null;
  metaProgress.equippedItems[normalized] = null;
  reconcileSelectedCollegeDoanMajors();
  saveMetaProgress();
}

function clearAvatarItems() {
  metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems = { ...defaultMetaProgress().equippedAvatarItems };
  metaProgress.equippedItems = { ...metaProgress.equippedAvatarItems };
  reconcileSelectedCollegeDoanMajors();
  saveMetaProgress();
}

function getAccessoryDef(id) {
  return getAvatarItemDef(id);
}

function getEquippedAccessoryIds() {
  return getEquippedAvatarItemIds();
}

function getEquippedAccessories() {
  return getEquippedAvatarItems();
}

function equipAccessory(id) {
  equipAvatarItem(id);
}

function unequipAccessory(slot) {
  unequipAvatarItem(slot);
}

function getConditionProgress(condition) {
  if (isDeveloperMode()) {
    const target = Number(condition.target || 1);
    return { current: target, target, done: true, text: "개발자 모드" };
  }
  if (condition.type === "stat") {
    const current = Number(metaProgress.stats?.[condition.key] || 0);
    const target = Number(condition.target || 1);
    const done = current >= target;
    const currentText = condition.formatter === "time" ? formatTime(current) : Math.min(Math.floor(current), target).toLocaleString();
    const targetText = condition.formatter === "time" ? formatTime(target) : target.toLocaleString();
    return { current, target, done, text: `${currentText}/${targetText}` };
  }
  if (condition.type === "hasAvatarItems") {
    const owned = new Set([...(metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems || []), ...(metaProgress.ownedItems || [])]);
    const current = (condition.ids || []).filter(id => owned.has(id)).length;
    const target = condition.target || (condition.ids || []).length || 1;
    return { current, target, done: current >= target, text: `${current}/${target}` };
  }
  if (condition.type === "characterTenMinuteClear") {
    const current = metaProgress.characterTenMinuteClears?.[condition.id] ? 1 : 0;
    const target = Number(condition.target || 1);
    return { current, target, done: current >= target, text: current >= target ? "완료" : "미완료" };
  }
  if (condition.type === "flag") {
    const done = Boolean(metaProgress[condition.key]);
    return { current: done ? 1 : 0, target: 1, done, text: done ? "완료" : "미완료" };
  }
  if (condition.type === "runFlag") {
    const done = Boolean(metaProgress.perRunRecords[condition.key]);
    return { current: done ? 1 : 0, target: 1, done, text: done ? "완료" : "미완료" };
  }
  if (condition.type === "evolved") {
    const current = condition.ids.some(id => metaProgress.evolvedWeaponsObtained.includes(id)) ? 1 : 0;
    return { current, target: condition.target, done: current >= condition.target, text: `${current}/${condition.target}` };
  }
  if (condition.type === "evolvedCollection") {
    const current = new Set(metaProgress.evolvedWeaponsObtained || []).size;
    const target = Number(condition.target || 1);
    return { current, target, done: current >= target, text: `${Math.min(current, target)}/${target}` };
  }
  if (condition.type === "weaponKills") {
    const current = metaProgress.weaponKillCounts[condition.id] || 0;
    return { current, target: condition.target, done: current >= condition.target, text: `${Math.min(current, condition.target)}/${condition.target}` };
  }
  return { current: 0, target: 1, done: false, text: "미완료" };
}
```

```js
function renderCollegeDoanMajorSelector(unlocked) {

  const selected = new Set(getSelectedCollegeDoanMajors());
  const majorNames = {
    newton: "뉴턴", lavoisier: "라부아지에", mendel: "멘델", wegener: "베게너", faraday: "패러데이",
    pasteur: "파스퇴르", galileo: "갈릴레이", schrodinger: "슈뢰딩거", curie: "마리 퀴리", pavlov: "파블로프", einstein: "아인슈타인", mary_anning: "메리 애닝", mendeleev: "멘델레예프", ada_lovelace: "에이다",
  };
  const weaponNames = {
    newton: "사과, 레이져", lavoisier: "알코올램프, 산소통", mendel: "완두콩, 식물 심기",
    wegener: "지각 변동, 대륙 이동", faraday: "전류, 자석", pasteur: "세균, 백신",
    galileo: "행성, 망원경", schrodinger: "파동, 고양이", curie: "X-ray, 방사성 물질",
    pavlov: "종소리, 개", einstein: "광전효과, 질량 변환", mary_anning: "화석 망치, 암모나이트",
    mendeleev: "원소 분석, 탄소결합", ada_lovelace: "코딩, 디버깅",
  };
  const count = selected.size;
  const maxMajors = getCollegeDoanMajorLimit();
  const unlimitedMajors = getActiveAchievementEffectStats().collegeMajorUnlimited > 0;
  return `<section class="college-major-panel">
    <div class="college-major-head"><strong>전공 선택</strong><span>${unlimitedMajors ? `${count}/무제한` : `${count}/${maxMajors}`}</span></div>
    ${count === 0 ? `<p class="major-warning">전공을 선택하지 않으면 공용 무기만 등장합니다.</p>` : ""}
    <div class="major-grid">
      ${Object.entries(majors).map(([id, major]) => {
        const majorUnlocked = devMode || major.unlocked;
        const disabled = !unlocked || !majorUnlocked || (!selected.has(id) && count >= maxMajors);
        const doneCount = Object.values(major.evolvedWeapons || {}).filter(Boolean).length;
        const status = majorUnlocked ? weaponNames[id] : `10분 클리어 ${major.tenMinuteClear ? "완료" : "미완료"} · 전용 진화 ${doneCount}/2`;
        return `<label class="major-card ${majorUnlocked ? "unlocked" : "locked"} ${selected.has(id) ? "selected" : ""}">
          <input type="checkbox" data-major-toggle value="${id}" ${selected.has(id) ? "checked" : ""} ${disabled ? "disabled" : ""}>
          <span>${majorNames[id]}</span>
          <em>${status}</em>
        </label>`;
      }).join("")}
    </div>
  </section>`;
}

const AVATAR_SLOT_LABELS = { head: "머리", body: "몸", accessory: "소품" };
const AVATAR_SLOT_ORDER = { head: 0, body: 1, accessory: 2 };
const AVATAR_RARITY_LABELS = { common: "일반", rare: "희귀", experiment: "실험", legend: "전설" };

function renderAvatarShop(filter = "all") {
  const content = ui.avatarShopContent;
  if (!content) return;
  const previousListScrollTop = content.querySelector(".avatar-shop-list")?.scrollTop || 0;
  const devMode = isDeveloperMode();
  const equipped = getEquippedAvatarItemIds();
  const items = Object.values(avatarItemDefs)
    .filter(item => !item.hidden)
    .filter(item => filter === "all" || item.slot === filter)
    .sort((a, b) => (AVATAR_SLOT_ORDER[a.slot] ?? 99) - (AVATAR_SLOT_ORDER[b.slot] ?? 99) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ko"));
  const slotSummary = Object.entries(AVATAR_SLOT_LABELS).map(([slot, label]) => {
    const item = getAvatarItemDef(equipped[slot]);
    return `<button class="avatar-slot ${item ? "equipped" : ""}" data-avatar-unequip="${slot}" type="button">
      <span>${label}</span>
      <strong>${item ? item.name : "비어 있음"}</strong>
    </button>`;
  }).join("");
  const selectedCharacterDef = characters[selectedCharacter] || characters.default;
  const equippedPreviewItems = Object.entries(AVATAR_SLOT_LABELS).map(([slot, label]) => {
    const item = getAvatarItemDef(equipped[slot]);
    return `<span><b>${label}</b>${item ? item.name : "없음"}</span>`;
  }).join("");
  content.innerHTML = `
    <section class="avatar-shop-top">
      <div>
        <span>보유 연구비</span>
        <strong>${(metaProgress.researchFunds || 0).toLocaleString()}</strong>
      </div>
      <p>${AVATAR_SHOP_TEST_MODE || devMode ? "개발자 모드: 가격은 표시되지만 모든 아이템을 자유롭게 장착할 수 있습니다." : "연구비로 아이템을 구매한 뒤 장착할 수 있습니다."}</p>
    </section>
    <section class="avatar-equipped">
      <div class="avatar-equipped-head">
        <strong>장착 현황</strong>
        <button class="secondary-button" data-avatar-clear type="button">전체 해제</button>
      </div>
      <div class="avatar-slots">${slotSummary}</div>
    </section>
    <div class="avatar-filter-tabs">
      ${[["all", "전체"], ["head", "머리"], ["body", "몸"], ["accessory", "소품"]].map(([id, label]) => (
        `<button class="${filter === id ? "active" : ""}" data-avatar-filter="${id}" type="button">${label}</button>`
      )).join("")}
    </div>
    <section class="avatar-shop-layout">
      <section class="avatar-shop-list">
        <section class="avatar-shop-grid">
          ${items.map(item => {
            const owner = characters[item.owner]?.name || "정도안";
            const isEquipped = equipped[item.slot] === item.id;
            const isOwned = AVATAR_SHOP_TEST_MODE || devMode || isEquipped || (metaProgress.ownedAvatarItems || []).includes(item.id) || (metaProgress.ownedItems || []).includes(item.id);
            const canBuy = (metaProgress.researchFunds || 0) >= item.price;
            const actionAttr = isOwned ? `data-avatar-equip="${item.id}"` : `data-avatar-buy="${item.id}"`;
            const actionLabel = isEquipped ? "해제" : isOwned ? "장착" : "구매";
            const actionDisabled = !isOwned && !canBuy ? "disabled" : "";
            return `<article class="avatar-item-card rarity-${item.rarity} ${isEquipped ? "equipped" : ""}">
              <div class="avatar-item-preview" aria-hidden="true">
                <span class="avatar-item-icon avatar-item-image" style="background-image: url('assets/items/${item.id}.png?v=2')"></span>
              </div>
              <div class="avatar-item-title">
                <span>${AVATAR_SLOT_LABELS[item.slot]} · ${AVATAR_RARITY_LABELS[item.rarity] || item.rarity}</span>
                <strong>${item.name}</strong>
              </div>
              <p class="avatar-owner">상징: ${owner}</p>
              <p class="avatar-test-badge">${AVATAR_SHOP_TEST_MODE || devMode ? "자유 사용 가능" : isEquipped ? "장착 중" : isOwned ? "보유 중" : canBuy ? "구매 가능" : "연구비 부족"}</p>
              <p class="avatar-effect">${item.effectText}</p>
              <div class="avatar-item-bottom">
                <em>${item.price.toLocaleString()} 연구비</em>
                <button class="${isEquipped ? "secondary-button" : "primary-button"}" ${actionAttr} type="button" ${actionDisabled}>${actionLabel}</button>
              </div>
            </article>`;
          }).join("")}
        </section>
      </section>
      <aside class="avatar-shop-preview-panel">
        <span>착용 미리보기</span>
        <canvas class="character-preview-canvas avatar-shop-preview-canvas" width="180" height="180" data-character-id="${selectedCharacter}"></canvas>
        <strong>${selectedCharacterDef?.name || "정도안"}</strong>
        <div class="avatar-shop-preview-items">${equippedPreviewItems}</div>
      </aside>
    </section>`;
  if (typeof renderCharacterPreviewCanvases === "function") renderCharacterPreviewCanvases();
  const listEl = content.querySelector(".avatar-shop-list");
  if (listEl) listEl.scrollTop = previousListScrollTop;

  content.querySelectorAll("[data-avatar-filter]").forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener("click", () => renderAvatarShop(button.dataset.avatarFilter));
  });
  content.querySelectorAll("[data-avatar-equip]").forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const item = getAvatarItemDef(button.dataset.avatarEquip);
      const equippedNow = item && getEquippedAvatarItemIds()[item.slot] === item.id;
      if (equippedNow) unequipAvatarItem(item.slot);
      else equipAvatarItem(button.dataset.avatarEquip);
      renderAvatarShop(filter);
      renderCharacterSelection();
      renderMainMenu();
    });
  });
  content.querySelectorAll("[data-avatar-buy]").forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      buyAvatarItem(button.dataset.avatarBuy);
      renderAvatarShop(filter);
      renderCharacterSelection();
      renderMainMenu();
    });
  });
  content.querySelectorAll("[data-avatar-unequip]").forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      unequipAvatarItem(button.dataset.avatarUnequip);
      renderAvatarShop(filter);
      renderCharacterSelection();
      renderMainMenu();
    });
  });
  content.querySelector("[data-avatar-clear]")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    clearAvatarItems();
    renderAvatarShop(filter);
    renderCharacterSelection();
    renderMainMenu();
  });
}

function renderResearchLog() {
  const content = ui.researchContent;
  if (!content) return;
  checkScientistUnlocks();
  checkAchievementUnlocks();
  saveMetaProgress();
  const achievements = normalizeAchievements(metaProgress.achievements);
  const achievementCards = Object.entries(ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS).map(([id, def]) => {
    const unlocked = Boolean(achievements[id]?.unlocked);
    const active = Boolean(achievements[id]?.enabled);
    const progress = getAchievementProgress(id);
    const progressPercent = progress.target ? clamp((progress.current / progress.target) * 100, 0, 100) : 0;
    return `<article class="achievement-card ${unlocked ? "unlocked" : "locked"} ${active ? "active" : ""}">
      <div>
        <strong>${def.name}</strong>
        <span>${unlocked ? active ? "효과 ON" : "효과 OFF" : "미달성"}</span>
      </div>
      <p>${def.condition}</p>
      <small>진행도 ${progress.text}</small>
      <i class="achievement-progress" aria-hidden="true"><b style="width:${progressPercent}%"></b></i>
      <em>${def.effect}</em>
      <button type="button" data-achievement-toggle="${id}" ${unlocked ? "" : "disabled"}>${active ? "끄기" : "켜기"}</button>
    </article>`;
  }).join("");
  const progressCards = scientistDefs.map(scientist => {
    const rows = scientist.conditions.map(condition => {
      const progress = getConditionProgress(condition);
      const percent = clamp((progress.current / progress.target) * 100, 0, 100);
      return `<li class="${progress.done ? "done" : ""}">
        <span>${condition.label}</span>
        <b>${progress.text}</b>
        <i><em style="width:${percent}%"></em></i>
      </li>`;
    }).join("");
    const unlocked = Boolean(metaProgress.scientistUnlocks[scientist.id]);
    const completed = scientist.conditions.reduce((count, condition) => {
      const progress = getConditionProgress(condition);
      return count + (progress.done ? 1 : 0);
    }, 0);
    const total = Math.max(1, scientist.conditions.length);
    const totalPercent = Math.round((completed / total) * 100);
    const statusLabel = unlocked ? "연구 완료" : completed > 0 ? "연구 중" : "미달성";
    return `<article class="scientist-card ${unlocked ? "unlocked" : ""}">
      <div class="scientist-title">
        <div><strong>${scientist.name}</strong><span>${scientist.field}</span></div>
        <em>${statusLabel}</em>
      </div>
      <div class="progress-bar" aria-hidden="true"><span style="width:${totalPercent}%"></span></div>
      <ul>${rows}</ul>
    </article>`;
  }).join("");

  content.innerHTML = `
    <section class="research-admin-actions">
      <button type="button" class="danger-button" data-research-reset>연구 기록 삭제</button>
      <button type="button" class="success-button ${isDeveloperMode() ? "active" : ""}" data-research-dev-mode>
        개발자 모드 ${isDeveloperMode() ? "OFF" : "ON"}
      </button>
    </section>
    <section class="progress-grid">
      <div><span>5분 클리어</span><strong>${metaProgress.fiveMinuteCleared ? "완료" : "미완료"}</strong></div>
      <div><span>10분 해금</span><strong>${metaProgress.tenMinuteModeUnlocked ? "해금" : "잠김"}</strong></div>
      <div><span>최고 생존</span><strong>${formatTime(metaProgress.bestSurvivalTime || 0)}</strong></div>
      <div><span>무한 최고</span><strong>${formatTime(metaProgress.bestInfiniteTime || 0)}</strong></div>
      <div><span>최고 레벨</span><strong>Lv.${metaProgress.bestLevel || 1}</strong></div>
      <div><span>총 처치</span><strong>${metaProgress.totalKills || 0}</strong></div>
      <div><span>총 플레이</span><strong>${metaProgress.totalRuns || 0}</strong></div>
    </section>
    <section class="progress-section achievement-section">
      <h3>업적 효과</h3>
      <div class="achievement-grid">${achievementCards}</div>
    </section>
    <section class="scientist-grid">${progressCards}</section>`;

  content.querySelectorAll("[data-achievement-toggle]").forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      toggleAchievementEffect(button.dataset.achievementToggle);
      renderResearchLog();
      renderCharacterSelection();
      renderMainMenu();
    });
  });
  content.querySelector("[data-research-reset]")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const ok = confirm("지금까지의 연구 기록, 해금 상태, 업적, 보유 아이템, 연구비를 모두 제거하고 처음 상태로 돌아갑니다. 정말 삭제할까요?");
    if (!ok) return;
    resetResearchProgress();
    setDeveloperMode(false);
    selectedCharacter = "default";
    saveSelectedCharacter();
    renderResearchLog();
    renderCharacterSelection();
    renderMainMenu();
  });
  content.querySelector("[data-research-dev-mode]")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const next = !isDeveloperMode();
    const ok = confirm(next
      ? "개발자 모드를 켜서 해금되지 않은 캐릭터, 아이템, 모드를 임시로 사용할 수 있게 합니다. 켤까요?"
      : "개발자 모드를 끕니다. 해금되지 않은 항목은 다시 잠긴 상태로 보입니다. 끌까요?");
    if (!ok) return;
    setDeveloperMode(next);
    if (!isCharacterUnlocked(selectedCharacter)) {
      selectedCharacter = "default";
      saveSelectedCharacter();
    }
    renderResearchLog();
    renderCharacterSelection();
    renderMainMenu();
  });
}

function guideRow(tag, name, formula, description) {
  return { tag, name, formula, description };
}

    ] },
  ];
}

function renderEvolutionGuide() {
  if (!ui.evolutionGuideContent) return;
  const rules = [
    "일반 진화: 무기 Lv.5 + 연결 패시브 Lv.1 이상 필요",
    "합성 진화: 특정 무기 Lv.5 + 재료 무기 Lv.1 이상 필요",
    "조건 만족 시 다음 레벨업 선택지에 진화 카드가 우선 등장",
    "일반 진화는 기본 무기가 진화 무기로 대체됩니다",
    "연소 반응은 알코올램프와 플라스크가 모두 사라지고 무기 슬롯이 하나 비게 됩니다",
  ];
  const sections = getEvolutionGuideSections().map(section => `
    <section class="evolution-section">
      <h3>${section.title}</h3>
      <p class="evolution-section-note">${section.description}</p>
      <div class="evolution-row-list">
        ${section.rows.map(row => {
          const cardClass = row.tag === "화학 합성" ? "fusion-card" : row.tag === "특수 진화" ? "special-card" : "";
          return `<article class="evolution-guide-card ${cardClass}">
          <span>${row.tag}</span>
          <strong>${row.name}</strong>
          <em>${row.formula}</em>
          <p>${row.description}</p>
        </article>`;
        }).join("")}
      </div>
    </section>`).join("");

  ui.evolutionGuideContent.innerHTML = `
    <div class="evolution-rule-grid">
      ${rules.map(rule => `<div>${rule}</div>`).join("")}
    </div>
    ${sections}`;
}

```

# 다른 게임에 구현하는 순서

1. character ID와 시작 무기, 전용 무기, 고유 패시브를 캐릭터 정의로 등록합니다.
2. 런 시작 시 newState의 상태값과 rebuildStats의 보정값을 초기화합니다.
3. 원본 update 호출 순서에 맞춰 입력, 적, 상태이상, 무기, 소환수, 투사체, 장판, 획득물, 피해 처리를 연결합니다. dt는 초입니다.
4. 공통 hitEnemy와 처치 처리를 연결해 디버깅, 아군화, 자원 드롭, 보상 중복 방지까지 보존합니다.
5. draw 계열 함수와 스프라이트 크롭·장착 레이어를 연결합니다. 화면 좌표는 원본 canvas 크기를 기준으로 변환합니다.
6. 아래 내장 파일은 path별로 base64를 디코딩하면 원본 바이트로 복원됩니다. sha256으로 복원 결과를 확인할 수 있습니다.

이 파일은 구현 명세와 원본 자료를 함께 전달하는 파일입니다. 다른 게임 엔진에 자동 설치되는 플러그인은 아니며 해당 엔진의 입력·좌표·렌더링·저장 API에 연결하는 작업이 필요합니다.

# 내장 원본 파일

온라인 랭킹 연결 설정은 캐릭터 구현에 필요하지 않아 제외했습니다. 복원 실행 시 index.html의 js/leaderboard-config.js 로드를 제거하거나 대상 프로젝트 설정을 사용합니다.
